Key Performance Areas and Main Responsibilities:

ICT Strategy and Governance

Develop, implement, and update SOS Rwanda's ICT strategy — aligned with SOS Strategy 2030, MA Strategic Plan 2023–2027, and global SOS ICT standards.

Define national ICT budgets, procurement plans, and multi-year ICT investment roadmaps.

Develop and implement ICT policies and standards — covering architecture, security, disaster recovery, procurement, and service provision.

Participate in regional ICT knowledge-sharing processes and coordinate with the SOS ESAF ICT Advisor on global standards and initiatives.

Lead ICT governance — including vendor management, service level agreements, and ICT committee oversight.

Programmes Digitalisation & Digital Case Management

Implement and manage a secure, cloud-based digital case management platform for tracking child progress — ensuring data privacy and compliance with Rwanda data protection laws and SOS-KDI data protection rules.

Lead the digitalisation of SOS Rwanda's programme functions — introducing digital case management, beneficiary tracking, and electronic documentation workflows across all four locations.

Equip field staff with mobile tools for real-time community reporting — reducing the 'paperwork lag' and improving data quality.

Drive paperless operations across all locations — designing change management plans that support staff adoption of new digital tools.

Collaborate with the Director of Strategy and Programme Implementation and the MEAL function to align digitalisation initiatives with programme quality and RBM needs.

Explore, evaluate, and pilot AI adoption and knowledge management tools that enhance programme decision-making and organisational efficiency.

 ERP, HRIS and Operational Systems

Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of SOS Rwanda's ERP system — ensuring integration across finance, procurement, HR, and programme functions.

Manage the HRIS system — ensuring data integrity, user access management, and alignment with HR processes.

Lead the digitisation of procurement and supply chain systems in coordination with the Senior Manager, Procurement and Logistics.

Ensure all ICT systems are properly integrated, reducing data silos and enabling organisation-wide reporting and analytics.

Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Business Continuity

Manage SOS Rwanda's IT network and server infrastructure across all locations — ensuring 99%+ system uptime, reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness.

Develop and implement a comprehensive cybersecurity framework — including data protection, access control, threat monitoring, and incident response — ensuring the cybersecurity audit score meets SOS-KDI standards.

Ensure compliance with SOS-KDI data protection rules and Rwanda data protection regulations, including the privacy of child and family records.

Design and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans — ensuring operational resilience in the event of system failures.

Digital Literacy & Capacity Building

Build digital literacy across SOS Rwanda — designing and delivering ICT training programmes for staff at all levels and locations.

Supervise the ICT Administrator and provide technical oversight to location ICT focal points.

Coach programme and operations staff on effective use of digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and case management.

Train community partners and staff on using technology for education, health monitoring, and economic strengthening.

Formal qualifications and Experiencerequirements:

Education & Professional Qualifications

Master’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred for Grade 5).

ITIL, PMP, or relevant technical certifications required (Grade 5 requirement).

Cybersecurity certification (CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

Professional Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive ICT experience; 3+ years in senior ICT leadership or digital transformation role.

Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation initiatives in an INGO, NGO, or complex multi-site organisation.

Proven experience with ERP systems (SOS ERP, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent) and HRIS platforms.

Strong track record in cybersecurity management, data protection, and ICT governance.

Experience with ICT4D tools — digital case management, mobile data collection, cloud platforms.

Experience working across multiple sites and geographically dispersed teams.

Skills & Competencies

Digital Transformation Strategy and Programme Digitisation.

ICT Infrastructure Management and Systems Architecture.

Data Governance and Cybersecurity.

ERP Systems Management and Integration.

Vendor Management and contract administration.

Strong change management and adult learning facilitation skills.

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

Good understanding of programme monitoring, MEAL, and data analytics.

Fluent English; Kinyarwanda and/or French is an advantage.

Commitment to SOS values and ethical use of data and technology in child-related programmes.

How to apply 

The interested Candidates in this position should send a detailed Curriculum Vitae with three (3) traceable professional references, application letter , Rwandan national Identity Card and academic certificates/degrees to sos.recruitment@sos-rwanda.org and properly fill the application form found via the followingLINKby not later than 27th September, 2026 at 5:00 pm Kigali time. 

Please mention in the subject of your email “Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalization”.

Female candidates are encouraged to apply, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Children, young people, families, and other programme participants visiting the organization

Maintain a professional, clean, and welcoming reception environment.

Manage general front-office email inquiries and ensure that correspondence is directed to the relevant departments.

Manage visitor access in accordance with organizational security and safeguarding procedures.

Coordinate appointments and meeting arrangements as required.

Receive and distribute incoming correspondence, documents, and deliveries.

Maintain an organized filing system for front-office records.

Support the preparation and coordination of meetings, events, and official visits.

Assist with photocopying, scanning, printing, document distribution, and other routine administrative tasks.

Support the coordination of office supplies and other front-office requirements.

Maintain confidentiality of organizational, staff, visitor, and programme-related information.

Immediately report any safeguarding, security, or other concerns through the appropriate channels.

Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and health and safety requirements.

Maintain professional conduct and demonstrate respect, integrity, and courtesy in all interactions.

Build positive working relationships with staff, visitors, partners, government representatives, and other stakeholders.

Monitor and report issues affecting the smooth operation of the reception area.

Perform any other duties relevant to the position as assigned by the supervisor.

Report any child safeguarding concerns immediately in accordance with the organizational’s Child Protection Policy

Promote and uphold the organisation’s values and child safeguarding principles in all interactions and decision – making

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Strong customer service and reception skills

Good organizational and time-management skills

Professional, courteous, and welcoming attitude

Good telephone and email communication skills

Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information

Good computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications

Ability to work effectively with people from diverse backgrounds

Problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

Formal qualifications 

Education: Diploma in Front Office Management, Business Admin, or related field

Professional Qualification: Customer Service certification preferred

 Experience requirements 

Experience: 3+ years reception/front office experience; corporate environment

Skills & Competencies: Reception Management, Telephone Etiquette, Visitor Management, Mail Handling, Office Administration, Professional Presentation, Customer Service Orientation, English & Kinyarwanda fluency.

The interested Candidates in this position should send a detailed Curriculum Vitae with three (3) traceable professional references, application letter , Rwandan national Identity Card and academic certificates/degrees to sos.recruitment@sos-rwanda.org and properly fill the application form found via the followingLINK by not later than 27th September, 2026 at 5:00 pm Kigali time.

This role involves developing and implementing institutional partnership plans, developing funding proposals to expand the organization’s programs and contributing to donor compliance.

Main clients: 

Internal – National Director, Deputy National Director – Operations, Director of Program Quality, Safeguarding and Partnership Development, Head of Fund Development and Partnerships, Program Managers, Project teams, finance team, and PSA staff

Key Performance Areas and Main Responsibilities:

Fundraising and Donor Liaison

Develop and implement annual IPD plans in line with the national organizational strategy annual set targets.

Ensure IPD annual targets are met according to the national organizational strategy.

Identify monthly IPD funding opportunities from in-country, bilateral, multilateral, international donors, embassies, diplomatic missions and foundations to meet annual targets.

Develop and write program ideas, concept notes, expression of interests, grant applications, technical project proposals for IPD projects while ensuring they are provisioned with available information prior to involving additional teams.

Conduct comprehensive background research on relevant policies, political, economic, environmental factors, and existing strategies at national, sub-national, regional, and global levels to contextualize project proposal descriptions.

Develop different project proposal sections, including risk factors, mitigation measures, sustainable development impacts, paradigm shifts, result frameworks, impact matrices, problem and objective trees, stakeholder analyses and others.

Ensure the timely collection of content needed from program teams for high quality and competitive proposal development.

Facilitate the development of project proposals and organize proposal development workshops with program team, partners and/or stakeholders, serving as the focal point for coordination and logistics.

Together with the Head of Fund Development and Partnership and program team identify suitable lead applications, co-applicants and implementing partners to increase competitiveness in bid applications.

Update IPD project grant compliance matrices to ensure adherence to donor requirements.

Ensure that project one-pagers and program summaries are always current and accurate.

Maintain an up-to-date master list of IPD grants, including grant descriptions.

Facilitate project start following funding approvals.

Monitor changes in IPD projects, advise the Program Team on documenting amendments, and communicate risks effectively.

Monitor donor grant requirements to ensure compliance, providing advice on cost extensions, non-cost extensions, agreement addendums, and other contractual issues.

Monitor project spending to prevent overspending or underspending and advise project teams accordingly.

Oversee project implementation from compliance perspective, advising teams on contractual clauses, amendments, risk management, and supporting timely project delivery.

Ensure proper documentation of all project amendments, and donor correspondence.

Train project team on donor grant compliance, funding policies, donor relations, donor reporting, contract management, etc

Prepare and submit IPD weekly, monthly updates and quarterly IPD reports

Prepare, coordinate, and develop partner due diligence reports and maintain filing systems.

Develop and maintain a mechanism for management of IPD Partnership agreements and signature processes, including contract/partnership agreement preparation, and preparation of consortium agreements.

Ensure all funding files (electronic, system and paper) are complete, filed and kept up to date.

Register and update SOS Rwanda project proposal development information in ProDIGI software

Partnership Development and Networking 

Establish and maintain regular contact with donors, attend donor forums, conferences etc

Identify and engage with in-country donors, foundation, embassies, diplomatic mission, bilateral, multilateral, international donors, to proactively explore and secure funding opportunities for IPD initiatives.

Develop partnerships and consortiums with other like-minded organizations and donors for purposes of bidding for large donor project proposals 

Represent SOS Rwanda in sector level meetings (development and humanitarian/emergency) and other networking forums and use this to develop funding partnerships

Organize partnership roundtable meetings and networking meetings

Participate in regional IPD networking and training forums and contribute to development of new IPD strategies to improve practice

Main clients: 

  • Internal – National Director, Deputy National Director – Operations, Director of Program Quality, Safeguarding and Partnership Development, Head of Fund Development and Partnerships, Program Managers, Project teams, finance team, and PSA staff

Fundraising and Donor Liaison

  • Develop and implement annual IPD plans in line with the national organizational strategy annual set targets.

  • Conduct comprehensive background research on relevant policies, political, economic, environmental factors, and existing strategies at national, sub-national, regional, and global levels to contextualize project proposal descriptions.

  • Prepare and submit IPD weekly, monthly updates and quarterly IPD reports

  • Develop and maintain a mechanism for management of IPD Partnership agreements and signature processes, including contract/partnership agreement preparation, and preparation of consortium agreements.
  • Ensure all funding files (electronic, system and paper) are complete, filed and kept up to date.
  • Register and update SOS Rwanda project proposal development information in ProDIGI software

Partnership Development and Networking 

  • Establish and maintain regular contact with donors, attend donor forums, conferences etc
  • Identify and engage with in-country donors, foundation, embassies, diplomatic mission, bilateral, multilateral, international donors, to proactively explore and secure funding opportunities for IPD initiatives.
  • Develop partnerships and consortiums with other like-minded organizations and donors for purposes of bidding for large donor project proposals 
  • Represent SOS Rwanda in sector level meetings (development and humanitarian/emergency) and other networking forums and use this to develop funding partnerships
  • Organize partnership roundtable meetings and networking meetings
  • Participate in regional IPD networking and training forums and contribute to development of new IPD strategies to improve practice

  • Excellent English language written skills are required for development of proposals
  • A holder of a bachelor’s degree in Sociology, Development studies, Economics or related field. Master’s degree will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent know how of project proposal writing skills is required, especially in the sectors of Child Protection, Alternative Care, Youth Empowerment, Livelihoods, Education, Health
  • He/she should have 5-8 years’ extensive experience in planning, securing and managing funds from institutional donors as well as a thorough understanding of writing of project proposal

  • A thorough understanding of Project Cycle Management is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Results-Based Management (RBM) approach is an additional asset
  • The post holder should have the following competencies flexibility, self-drive, attention to detail, respecting tight deadlines, ability to work with different teams in a fast-paced environment and ability to work independently. 
  • He/she should be highly proficient in MS Word, Excel, Power-point and the use of Internet for research.

Develop different project proposal sections, including risk factors, mitigation measures, sustainable development impacts, paradigm shifts, result frameworks, impact matrices, problem and objective trees, stakeholder analyses and others.

Ensure the timely collection of content needed from program teams for high quality and competitive proposal development.

Facilitate the development of project proposals and organize proposal development workshops with program team, partners and/or stakeholders, serving as the focal point for coordination and logistics.

Together with the Head of Fund Development and Partnership and program team identify suitable lead applications, co-applicants and implementing partners to increase competitiveness in bid applications.

Donor Compliance Monitoring 

Regularly update the master partner landscape and partner mapping to reflect current information.

Update IPD project grant compliance matrices to ensure adherence to donor requirements.

Ensure that project one-pagers and program summaries are always current and accurate.

Maintain an up-to-date master list of IPD grants, including grant descriptions.

Facilitate project start following funding approvals.

Monitor changes in IPD projects, advise the Program Team on documenting amendments, and communicate risks effectively.

Monitor donor grant requirements to ensure compliance, providing advice on cost extensions, non-cost extensions, agreement addendums, and other contractual issues.

Monitor project spending to prevent overspending or underspending and advise project teams accordingly.

Oversee project implementation from compliance perspective, advising teams on contractual clauses, amendments, risk management, and supporting timely project delivery.

Track donor monitoring network meetings, maintain detailed minutes, and keep records of donor interactions and follow-ups.

Ensure proper documentation of all project amendments, and donor correspondence.

Train project team on donor grant compliance, funding policies, donor relations, donor reporting, contract management, etc

Prepare and submit IPD weekly, monthly updates and quarterly IPD reports

Donor Contract Management

Prepare, coordinate, and develop partner due diligence reports and maintain filing systems.

Develop and maintain a mechanism for management of IPD Partnership agreements and signature processes, including contract/partnership agreement preparation, and preparation of consortium agreements.

Ensure all funding files (electronic, system and paper) are complete, filed and kept up to date.

Register and update SOS Rwanda project proposal development information in ProDIGI software

Partnership Development and Networking 

Establish and maintain regular contact with donors, attend donor forums, conferences etc

Identify and engage with in-country donors, foundation, embassies, diplomatic mission, bilateral, multilateral, international donors, to proactively explore and secure funding opportunities for IPD initiatives.

Develop partnerships and consortiums with other like-minded organizations and donors for purposes of bidding for large donor project proposals 

Represent SOS Rwanda in sector level meetings (development and humanitarian/emergency) and other networking forums and use this to develop funding partnerships

Organize partnership roundtable meetings and networking meetings

Participate in regional IPD networking and training forums and contribute to development of new IPD strategies to improve practice

Formal qualifications and Experiencerequirements:

Excellent English language written skills are required for development of proposals

A holder of a bachelor’s degree in Sociology, Development studies, Economics or related field. Master’s degree will be an added advantage.

Excellent know how of project proposal writing skills is required, especially in the sectors of Child Protection, Alternative Care, Youth Empowerment, Livelihoods, Education, Health

He/she should have 5-8 years’ extensive experience in planning, securing and managing funds from institutional donors as well as a thorough understanding of writing of project proposal 

Potential candidates should demonstrate evidence of medium/large proposals they have developed and won (0.5 – 2M USD)

A thorough understanding of Project Cycle Management is an asset.

Knowledge of Results-Based Management (RBM) approach is an additional asset

The post holder should have the following competencies flexibility, self-drive, attention to detail, respecting tight deadlines, ability to work with different teams in a fast-paced environment and ability to work independently. 

He/she should be highly proficient in MS Word, Excel, Power-point and the use of Internet for research. 

How to apply 

The interested Candidates in this position should send a detailed Curriculum Vitae with three (3) traceable professional references, application letter , Rwandan national Identity Card and academic certificates/degrees to sos.recruitment@sos-rwanda.org and properly fill the application form found via the followingLINKby not later than 27th September, 2026 at 5:00 pm Kigali time. 

Please mention in the subject of your email “IPD Specialist”.

item.description:
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Position: Front Office Officer

Vacant positions: One (01)

Type of contract: Fixed term

Working location: National Office

Supervisor: Head of HR and Organisational Development

Deadline: 27th September 2026

Context of the position: 

SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is an independent member association affiliated to the SOS Federation. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda leverages existing community resources to strengthen quality childcare and protection through a holistic continuum of care tailored to orphans, vulnerable children, and their families. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda actively advocates for the promotion of childcare and child protection. In Rwanda, SOS Children’s Villages operates in four Program Areas based in Gasabo, Gicumbi, Kayonza and Nyamagabe. To further fulfil the above-mentioned responsibilities, SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is seeking for a competent Front Office Officer, to base at its National Office Kigali, Kinyinya.

JOB PURPOSE

The main role for this position is to provide professional, efficient, and welcoming front-office and administrative support by managing the reception area, receiving and directing visitors and calls, handling correspondence, and providing timely assistance to staff and external stakeholders. The Front Office Officer ensures effective communication and smooth day-to-day front-office operations while maintaining a professional image of the organization and safeguarding confidential information.

Main clients: 

All SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda staff and departments

All visitors, guests, and members of the public coming to SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda

Children, young people, families, and other programme participants visiting the organization

Government institutions, partners, donors, service providers, and other external stakeholders

Candidates, consultants, and other individuals visiting SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda for official purposes

Key Performance Areas and Main Responsibilities:

The Front Office Officer is responsible for managing the reception area and serving as the first point of contact for visitors, staff, partners, and other stakeholders. The position ensures professional handling of telephone calls, correspondence, visitors, and general inquiries while providing timely administrative support. The officer maintains accurate front-office records, ensures compliance with safeguarding, confidentiality, and security procedures, and contributes to creating a welcoming and professional image of SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda. Below are the details:

 Reception and Customer Service

Receive and welcome all visitors, guests, and stakeholders in a professional and courteous manner.

Identify visitors and direct them to the appropriate staff members or departments.

Ensure that visitors receive timely and accurate information and assistance.

Maintain a professional, clean, and welcoming reception environment.

Handle inquiries and provide appropriate responses or referrals.

Telephone and Communication Management

Receive and manage incoming telephone calls and direct them to the appropriate staff members.

Take and relay messages accurately and promptly.

Manage general front-office email inquiries and ensure that correspondence is directed to the relevant departments.

Support effective communication between staff, visitors, and external stakeholders.

Visitor and Front Office Administration

Maintain accurate records of visitors, appointments, deliveries, and other front-office activities.

Manage visitor access in accordance with organizational security and safeguarding procedures.

Coordinate appointments and meeting arrangements as required.

Receive and distribute incoming correspondence, documents, and deliveries.

Maintain an organized filing system for front-office records.

Administrative Support

Provide general administrative support to the Administration and other departments as assigned.

Support the preparation and coordination of meetings, events, and official visits.

Assist with photocopying, scanning, printing, document distribution, and other routine administrative tasks.

Support the coordination of office supplies and other front-office requirements.

Safeguarding, Confidentiality and Security

Ensure that all visitors and stakeholders are treated in accordance with SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda's safeguarding standards and procedures.

Maintain confidentiality of organizational, staff, visitor, and programme-related information.

Immediately report any safeguarding, security, or other concerns through the appropriate channels.

Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and health and safety requirements.

Professional Representation

Serve as the first point of contact for SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda and promote a professional and positive image of the organization.

Maintain professional conduct and demonstrate respect, integrity, and courtesy in all interactions.

Build positive working relationships with staff, visitors, partners, government representatives, and other stakeholders.

Reporting and Other Responsibilities

Prepare routine front-office reports and maintain relevant records as required.

Monitor and report issues affecting the smooth operation of the reception area.

Perform any other duties relevant to the position as assigned by the supervisor.

Child Protection Policy

At all times, avoid actions or behaviour that could be construed as poor or potentially abusive practice. 

Report any child safeguarding concerns immediately in accordance with the organizational’s Child Protection Policy

Promote and uphold the organisation’s values and child safeguarding principles in all interactions and decision – making

Data Protection Policy.

At all times ensure that personal data of SOS Children’s Villages beneficiaries and their families as well as SOS Children’s Villages in Rwanda co-workers is handled confidentially and in accordance with prevailing SOS Children’s Villages.

item.title_raw: Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalisation at SOS Children's Villages Rwanda: ( Deadline 27-09-2026)
item.description:
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Position: Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalisation

Vacant positions: One (01)

Type of contract: Fixed term

Working location: National Office

Supervisor: Deputy National Director - Operations

Deadline: 27th September 2026

Context of the position: 

SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is an independent member association affiliated to the SOS Federation. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda leverages existing community resources to strengthen quality childcare and protection through a holistic continuum of care tailored to orphans, vulnerable children, and their families. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda actively advocates for the promotion of childcare and child protection. In Rwanda, SOS Children’s Villages operates in four Program Areas based in Gasabo, Gicumbi, Kayonza and Nyamagabe. To further fulfil the above-mentioned responsibilities, SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is seeking for a competent Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalisation, to base at its National Office Kigali, Kinyinya.

JOB PURPOSE

To move ICT from 'fixing laptops' to 'leveraging technology' for social impact. The Senior Manager, ICT and Programmes Digitalisation leads SOS Rwanda's ICT function and drives the organisation's digital transformation agenda, designing and implementing ICT strategy, managing all ICT systems and infrastructure, leading the digitalisation of programme and operational workflows, implementing secure digital case management platforms, ensuring cybersecurity and data protection, and building staff digital literacy across all four Program Areas.

The position is the functional supervisor of the ICT Administrator in Kigali and provides technical oversight to location-level ICT focal points.

Main clients: 

Deputy National Director for Operations

National Director

All National Management Team (NMT) members

Head of Finance — ERP and financial systems

Head of MEAL — digital MEL platforms

Head of HROD — HRIS systems

Senior Manager, Procurement and Logistics — procurement systems

Programme teams across all four area offices

SOS Regional ICT Advisor (ESAF) and SOS International ICT teams

ICT Administrator- Kigali (direct report)

Key Performance Areas and Main Responsibilities:

ICT Strategy and Governance

Develop, implement, and update SOS Rwanda's ICT strategy — aligned with SOS Strategy 2030, MA Strategic Plan 2023–2027, and global SOS ICT standards.

Define national ICT budgets, procurement plans, and multi-year ICT investment roadmaps.

Develop and implement ICT policies and standards — covering architecture, security, disaster recovery, procurement, and service provision.

Participate in regional ICT knowledge-sharing processes and coordinate with the SOS ESAF ICT Advisor on global standards and initiatives.

Lead ICT governance — including vendor management, service level agreements, and ICT committee oversight.

Programmes Digitalisation & Digital Case Management

Implement and manage a secure, cloud-based digital case management platform for tracking child progress — ensuring data privacy and compliance with Rwanda data protection laws and SOS-KDI data protection rules.

Lead the digitalisation of SOS Rwanda's programme functions — introducing digital case management, beneficiary tracking, and electronic documentation workflows across all four locations.

Equip field staff with mobile tools for real-time community reporting — reducing the 'paperwork lag' and improving data quality.

Drive paperless operations across all locations — designing change management plans that support staff adoption of new digital tools.

Collaborate with the Director of Strategy and Programme Implementation and the MEAL function to align digitalisation initiatives with programme quality and RBM needs.

Explore, evaluate, and pilot AI adoption and knowledge management tools that enhance programme decision-making and organisational efficiency.

 ERP, HRIS and Operational Systems

Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of SOS Rwanda's ERP system — ensuring integration across finance, procurement, HR, and programme functions.

Manage the HRIS system — ensuring data integrity, user access management, and alignment with HR processes.

Lead the digitisation of procurement and supply chain systems in coordination with the Senior Manager, Procurement and Logistics.

Ensure all ICT systems are properly integrated, reducing data silos and enabling organisation-wide reporting and analytics.

Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Business Continuity

Manage SOS Rwanda's IT network and server infrastructure across all locations — ensuring 99%+ system uptime, reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness.

Develop and implement a comprehensive cybersecurity framework — including data protection, access control, threat monitoring, and incident response — ensuring the cybersecurity audit score meets SOS-KDI standards.

Ensure compliance with SOS-KDI data protection rules and Rwanda data protection regulations, including the privacy of child and family records.

Design and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans — ensuring operational resilience in the event of system failures.

Digital Literacy & Capacity Building

Build digital literacy across SOS Rwanda — designing and delivering ICT training programmes for staff at all levels and locations.

Supervise the ICT Administrator and provide technical oversight to location ICT focal points.

Coach programme and operations staff on effective use of digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and case management.

Train community partners and staff on using technology for education, health monitoring, and economic strengthening.

Formal qualifications and Experiencerequirements:

Education & Professional Qualifications

Master’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred for Grade 5).

ITIL, PMP, or relevant technical certifications required (Grade 5 requirement).

Cybersecurity certification (CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

Professional Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive ICT experience; 3+ years in senior ICT leadership or digital transformation role.

Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation initiatives in an INGO, NGO, or complex multi-site organisation.

Proven experience with ERP systems (SOS ERP, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent) and HRIS platforms.

Strong track record in cybersecurity management, data protection, and ICT governance.

Experience with ICT4D tools — digital case management, mobile data collection, cloud platforms.

Experience working across multiple sites and geographically dispersed teams.

Skills & Competencies

Digital Transformation Strategy and Programme Digitisation.

ICT Infrastructure Management and Systems Architecture.

Data Governance and Cybersecurity.

ERP Systems Management and Integration.

Vendor Management and contract administration.

Strong change management and adult learning facilitation skills.

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

Good understanding of programme monitoring, MEAL, and data analytics.

Fluent English; Kinyarwanda and/or French is an advantage.

Commitment to SOS values and ethical use of data and technology in child-related programmes.

How to apply 

The interested Candidates in this position should send a detailed Curriculum Vitae with three (3) traceable professional references, application letter , Rwandan national Identity Card and academic certificates/degrees to sos.recruitment@sos-rwanda.org and properly fill the application form found via the followingLINKby not later than 27th September, 2026 at 5:00 pm Kigali time. 

Please mention in the subject of your email “Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalization”.

Female candidates are encouraged to apply, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

“SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda/ International holds strict child safeguarding principles and a zero-tolerance policy for conducts of sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse in the workplace and other places where the organization’s activities are rendered. Parallel to technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring decisions will give due emphasize to assessing candidates value congruence and thorough background checks, police clearance reference check processes”. 

Done in Kigali on 17th September 2026.

Jean Bosco KWIZERA

item.description_text:
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Position: Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalisation

Vacant positions: One (01)

Type of contract: Fixed term

Working location: National Office

Supervisor: Deputy National Director - Operations

Deadline: 27th September 2026

Context of the position: 

SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is an independent member association affiliated to the SOS Federation. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda leverages existing community resources to strengthen quality childcare and protection through a holistic continuum of care tailored to orphans, vulnerable children, and their families. SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda actively advocates for the promotion of childcare and child protection. In Rwanda, SOS Children’s Villages operates in four Program Areas based in Gasabo, Gicumbi, Kayonza and Nyamagabe. To further fulfil the above-mentioned responsibilities, SOS Children’s Villages Rwanda is seeking for a competent Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalisation, to base at its National Office Kigali, Kinyinya.

JOB PURPOSE

To move ICT from 'fixing laptops' to 'leveraging technology' for social impact. The Senior Manager, ICT and Programmes Digitalisation leads SOS Rwanda's ICT function and drives the organisation's digital transformation agenda, designing and implementing ICT strategy, managing all ICT systems and infrastructure, leading the digitalisation of programme and operational workflows, implementing secure digital case management platforms, ensuring cybersecurity and data protection, and building staff digital literacy across all four Program Areas.

The position is the functional supervisor of the ICT Administrator in Kigali and provides technical oversight to location-level ICT focal points.

Main clients: 

Deputy National Director for Operations

National Director

All National Management Team (NMT) members

Head of Finance — ERP and financial systems

Head of MEAL — digital MEL platforms

Head of HROD — HRIS systems

Senior Manager, Procurement and Logistics — procurement systems

Programme teams across all four area offices

SOS Regional ICT Advisor (ESAF) and SOS International ICT teams

ICT Administrator- Kigali (direct report)

Key Performance Areas and Main Responsibilities:

ICT Strategy and Governance

Develop, implement, and update SOS Rwanda's ICT strategy — aligned with SOS Strategy 2030, MA Strategic Plan 2023–2027, and global SOS ICT standards.

Define national ICT budgets, procurement plans, and multi-year ICT investment roadmaps.

Develop and implement ICT policies and standards — covering architecture, security, disaster recovery, procurement, and service provision.

Participate in regional ICT knowledge-sharing processes and coordinate with the SOS ESAF ICT Advisor on global standards and initiatives.

Lead ICT governance — including vendor management, service level agreements, and ICT committee oversight.

Programmes Digitalisation & Digital Case Management

Implement and manage a secure, cloud-based digital case management platform for tracking child progress — ensuring data privacy and compliance with Rwanda data protection laws and SOS-KDI data protection rules.

Lead the digitalisation of SOS Rwanda's programme functions — introducing digital case management, beneficiary tracking, and electronic documentation workflows across all four locations.

Equip field staff with mobile tools for real-time community reporting — reducing the 'paperwork lag' and improving data quality.

Drive paperless operations across all locations — designing change management plans that support staff adoption of new digital tools.

Collaborate with the Director of Strategy and Programme Implementation and the MEAL function to align digitalisation initiatives with programme quality and RBM needs.

Explore, evaluate, and pilot AI adoption and knowledge management tools that enhance programme decision-making and organisational efficiency.

 ERP, HRIS and Operational Systems

Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of SOS Rwanda's ERP system — ensuring integration across finance, procurement, HR, and programme functions.

Manage the HRIS system — ensuring data integrity, user access management, and alignment with HR processes.

Lead the digitisation of procurement and supply chain systems in coordination with the Senior Manager, Procurement and Logistics.

Ensure all ICT systems are properly integrated, reducing data silos and enabling organisation-wide reporting and analytics.

Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and Business Continuity

Manage SOS Rwanda's IT network and server infrastructure across all locations — ensuring 99%+ system uptime, reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness.

Develop and implement a comprehensive cybersecurity framework — including data protection, access control, threat monitoring, and incident response — ensuring the cybersecurity audit score meets SOS-KDI standards.

Ensure compliance with SOS-KDI data protection rules and Rwanda data protection regulations, including the privacy of child and family records.

Design and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans — ensuring operational resilience in the event of system failures.

Digital Literacy & Capacity Building

Build digital literacy across SOS Rwanda — designing and delivering ICT training programmes for staff at all levels and locations.

Supervise the ICT Administrator and provide technical oversight to location ICT focal points.

Coach programme and operations staff on effective use of digital tools for monitoring, reporting, and case management.

Train community partners and staff on using technology for education, health monitoring, and economic strengthening.

Formal qualifications and Experiencerequirements:

Education & Professional Qualifications

Master’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred for Grade 5).

ITIL, PMP, or relevant technical certifications required (Grade 5 requirement).

Cybersecurity certification (CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

Professional Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive ICT experience; 3+ years in senior ICT leadership or digital transformation role.

Demonstrated experience leading digital transformation initiatives in an INGO, NGO, or complex multi-site organisation.

Proven experience with ERP systems (SOS ERP, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent) and HRIS platforms.

Strong track record in cybersecurity management, data protection, and ICT governance.

Experience with ICT4D tools — digital case management, mobile data collection, cloud platforms.

Experience working across multiple sites and geographically dispersed teams.

Skills & Competencies

Digital Transformation Strategy and Programme Digitisation.

ICT Infrastructure Management and Systems Architecture.

Data Governance and Cybersecurity.

ERP Systems Management and Integration.

Vendor Management and contract administration.

Strong change management and adult learning facilitation skills.

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

Good understanding of programme monitoring, MEAL, and data analytics.

Fluent English; Kinyarwanda and/or French is an advantage.

Commitment to SOS values and ethical use of data and technology in child-related programmes.

How to apply 

The interested Candidates in this position should send a detailed Curriculum Vitae with three (3) traceable professional references, application letter , Rwandan national Identity Card and academic certificates/degrees to sos.recruitment@sos-rwanda.org and properly fill the application form found via the followingLINKby not later than 27th September, 2026 at 5:00 pm Kigali time. 

Please mention in the subject of your email “Senior Manager ICT and Programs Digitalization”.

Female candidates are encouraged to apply, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

EXTERNAL ADVERTISEMENT OF VACANT POSTS TO THE POSITION OF RELATIONSHIP OFFICERS

UMUTANGUHA Finance Company (UFC) Plc, a company duly registered in the office of the Registrar General under company code number 101310843, licensed by National Bank of Rwanda to operate as Micro Finance Institution in Rwanda headquartered in Kigali, Opposite Nyamirambo Pele Stadium, House # 177, KN2 Avenue, P.O Box 2998 Kigali, Tel 0788387730, email: info@ufinance.co.rw is recruiting self-motivated, creative, persuasive individuals with excellent communication and sales skills to fill the positions of Relationship Officers with the following duties and responsibilities:

A. Responsibilities with regard to saving mobilization

The Relationship Officer “RO” is responsible for the growth of deposit volume at branch level by mobilizing accounts and savings from field (from current and potential clients). The RO will be responsible for the development of the relationship between clients and UFC. His/her specific tasks are to: 

Generate & develop deposits and new deposit pipeline by providing product knowledge, customer services and managing customer relationships

Sell the Deposits products to the existing and potential clients

Enhance and establish relationship with existing & perspective customers in the segment by visiting/talking to clients on a daily basis

Solicit new business from present and prospective customers; maintains ongoing business relationships with present customers in order to take advantage of additional cross-selling opportunities.

Involve in savings promotion activities according to specificities of areas.

Follow up and make sure that the accounts activated by his/her promotion are actively used by the customers.

Manage the High Network Individuals customer portfolio for the branch.

Ensure establishment and maintenance of the strong rapport with the clients

Achieve all business targets within allocated time

B. Responsibilities with regard to credit 

The RO is responsible of the quality loan portfolio and its growth at the assigned branch with the following duties:

Mobilize clients for the purpose of lending to them.

Train individual clients and group members in the UFC lending methodology

Supervise financial education trainings conducted by clients’ trainer

Guide, monitor, and supervise clients as well as groups activities

Evaluate and assess the credit risk of individual clients and groups by inspecting business and household of potential clients, appraise client’s business and repayment capability before disbursing loans.

Generate and submit on time accurate documentation to enable loans to be disbursed.

Maintain complete and accurate loan documentation in the office and supervise the maintenance of group record keeping process.

Follow up with clients to recover loans. 

Participate and/or hold cluster meetings. 

Take individual action as per policy to recover delinquent loans

Prepare and submit reports on the number of clients, repayments, portfolio quality, loan recoveries and follow-up action on delinquent loans.

Prepare and submit reports on the number of clients, repayments, portfolio quality, loan recoveries and follow-up action on delinquent loans. 

C. Sell of all financial products, services and delivery channels

Develop marketing and work plan for the establishment of solid clientele base. 

Identify and sensitize the potential clients in the respective area of operation. 

Advise clients on the use of UFC PLC Alternative delivery channels

Refer clients that are illegible for other UFC PLC products to the respective departments 

Main Performance Measures

Portfolio at risk (PAR)

Value of outstanding portfolio (Average portfolio)

Number of loan clients

Growth in the number of loan clients

Growth in the value of outstanding portfolio

Growth of the saving portfolio 

Number of saving clients

Client relationship

Ensure a perfect, good and quality customer service 

Compliance with Client Protection Principles

Safeguard the good reputation of UMUTANGUHA FINANCE COMPANY PLC

Any other task assigned by the line supervisor.

Requirements: 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Management, Finance and Banking and related fields 

At least 3 years’ experience in banking or micro finance sector preferably in Business or Credit sections;

Excellent understanding of the bank operations and credit functionalities

Negotiation and strong analytical skills

Excellent sales skills and strong credit analysis and loan portfolio management;

Excellent and effective communication skills, both orally and in writing 

Able to work in any UFC Plc Branches located in all provinces in Rwanda

Having a driving license Category A will be an added value;

Maximum age 38 years’ old

Application documents: 

Application letter

Curriculum vitae

Copy of ID card

Studies documents (copies of Certificates, academic transcripts, degree, etc)

Training and experience documents

A list of three references and their contacts

Note: All documents should be scanned in one document and be electronically submitted to: ufc.recruitment@ufinance.co.rw (Please mention the position you are applying for in the email subject).

The deadline for receiving applications is 28th September 2026 at 5:00 PM

NB: 

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Done at Kigali, 17th September 2026. 

 Mrs. Josephine MUKUNDIYIMANA Mr. Noel MUHAWENIMANA

 HR& Admin Manager Chief Executive Officer

item.title: Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards at RwandAir Ltd
item.title_raw: Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards at RwandAir Ltd : (Deadline 28 Sep 2026)
item.description:
Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards

Company: RwandAir Ltd
Location: Kigali International Airport, Rwanda
Department: HR & Administration
Reports to: Chief HR & Administration Officer
Deadline: 28 September 2026

RwandAir Ltd, the flag carrier airline of Rwanda, is seeking a qualified and experienced professional to fill the position of Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards.

Job Purpose

The successful candidate will lead the development of RwandAir’s organization design, job architecture, workforce planning, compensation, benefits, grading and total rewards frameworks across a workforce of approximately 1,200–1,500 employees.

Key Responsibilities

Lead organization design and structural reviews across RwandAir’s major functions.

Develop and implement an enterprise-wide job architecture covering job families, career levels and role profiles.

Establish workforce planning methods and productivity ratios.

Develop RwandAir’s Total Rewards philosophy and compensation framework.

Lead job evaluation, grading, salary structures and market benchmarking.

Design compensation rules for flight crew, technical staff and other workforce groups.

Oversee benefits including medical insurance, pension, staff travel and housing.

Advise senior management on employment costs, restructuring and rewards strategy.

Ensure organizational changes maintain regulatory accountability and safety requirements.

Build and lead a technically strong Organization Design & Rewards team.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Industrial/Organisational Psychology or a related field.

10–12 years of progressive HR experience.

At least 5–6 years of specialist experience in rewards, job architecture or organization design.

A Master’s degree in a relevant field is strongly preferred.

Accreditation in Korn Ferry Hay, Mercer IPE or WTW GGS is strongly preferred.

Essential Experience & Skills

Experience leading at least one enterprise-wide job evaluation and grading implementation in an organization with 1,000+ employees.

Experience in aviation or another regulated, multi-site and safety-critical industry.

Experience designing pay structures for technical, operational, unionized, expatriate and local employees.

Experience presenting compensation and organizational decisions at Board or ExCo level.

Strong organization design, compensation and benefits expertise.

Advanced workforce analytics and cost-modelling skills.

Knowledge of aviation operating fundamentals, including ICAO, IOSA, RCAA, FTL, crew productivity, CASK and ASK.

Working knowledge of Rwandan Labour Law No. 66/2018.

Strong HRIS/ERP and organizational modelling skills.

Application Requirements

Applicants should submit:

Application letter addressed to the Chief HR & Administration Officer

Recent Curriculum Vitae

Notarized copies of Degree/Diploma certificates

Relevant professional certificates

Copies of academic papers

Copy of Passport/National ID

Three referees

Application Deadline: 28 September 2026

Application: Submit your application online through the RwandAir e-Recruitment portal.

Location: Kigali International Airport, Rwanda

CLICK HERE TO READ MORE AND APPLY

item.title: Applications Specialist at HOPE International
item.title_raw: Applications Specialist at HOPE International: (Deadline 27-09-2026)
item.description:
Applications Specialist

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Application deadline: September 27, 2026

The applications specialist will have responsibility for ensuring the effective deployment and support of Temenos T24 and other banking applications in HOPE’s network of microfinance institutions and banks. This is accomplished through enhancing the parameterization of T24 to support the needs of management teams, assisting in new system deployments, fixing problems as they arise, and training and equipping country level staff.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda; other geographies possible for consultancy ,

Level: Senior Professional

Type: Full-time

Department: Core Banking Systems & Applications

Reports to: Senior Applications Specialist

RESPONSIBILITIES

Promote and fulfill the mission and vision of HOPE International.

System Development & Implementation

Utilize expertise in T24 to assist in the configuration and parameterization of T24 in new deployments so as to maximize effectiveness of the system and ensure that appropriate functionality is utilized

Develop, enhance, and customize T24 AA modules, products, and lifecycle events

Work on AA Contracts, AA Components, L3 customizations, and COB activities

Assist in development and implementation of both in-house and third-party core banking software integrations to T24

Recommend improvements to existing T24 technical and business processes in order to ensure the effective fulfillment of functional requirements

Equip Country-Level T24 Support Staff

Provide training, advice and mentoring to country-level T24 support staff

Approach each problem with an attitude of service and take every reasonable opportunity to turn projects into teaching moments

Provide Effective Second Level Support

Respond in a timely fashion to the real-time support needs of programs, resolving problems and minimizing disruption to banking services

Provide proactive mitigation of potential problems by identifying system risks and reconfiguring T24 to prevent either system malfunction or a mismatch of system capabilities with program needs

Learn and support integrated digital financial applications such as mobile payment products and web-based T24 front ends

Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to core-banking systems and other systems used by HOPE-led financial institutions.

Center of Excellence

Maintain expertise in recent releases of T24 MCB so as to serve the HOPE Network as a center of excellence for T24 best practices and functionality

Other

Perform other technical assistance functions as necessary, including responding to information requests from other departments

QUALIFICATIONS

Personal confession of Christian faith and commitment to the mission and vision of HOPE International.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field;

5-10 years of experience supporting T24 in commercial or microfinance banks, with specific experience with T24 AA required

Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines

Excellent project management skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Ability to conduct comparative analysis and prepare recommendations for presentation to senior leadership

Cross-cultural intelligence and communication skills

Experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Suite products

Fluent in English

Proficiency in French preferred

Extended cross-cultural living experience preferred

Apply Here: Applications Specialist | HOPE International

item.title_raw: Territory Lead at  EarthEnable Rwanda: (Deadline 27-09-2026)
item.description:
Territory Lead at EarthEnable Rwanda: (Deadline 27-09-2026)

JOB DESCRIPTION: TERRITORY LEAD 
Company: EarthEnable 

Reports to: District Operations Lead 

Location: Different districts in Rwanda 

Compensation: 320,000 - 350,000 RWF (Rwandan Franc) / month gross, depending on experience 

Who We Are 

At EarthEnable, we believe that our clients deserve our very best, that work should be fun, and that the best ideas could come from any part of the company. We celebrate each other’s wins, learn from our setbacks, and are deeply proud of the impact we make every day. We believe a home that doesn’t make you sick means more than living disease-free. It means pride and dignity in the place our customers most treasure: their homes. Being a part of our team means more than building housing products: it means building an organization and building a better future for rural families. 

What We Do 

EarthEnable is transforming the way people live, by making homes healthier for families across rural Rwanda, Uganda, and Kenya. 80% of Rwandans live in homes with dirt floors which are dusty, unsanitary, and fertile breeding grounds for parasites and germs. While replacing a dirt floor with concrete has significant health benefits (e.g. reducing diarrhea by 50% and parasitic infections by 80%), concrete is unaffordable for many who need it, and is also responsible for 8% of global carbon emissions. 

EarthEnable addresses this pressing and ubiquitous problem by selling high-quality, earthen housing products like our flagship floor that is 80% cheaper than concrete with 90% less embedded energy. Earthen floors, plasters, and blocks are composed of natural materials (gravel, clay, sand, and laterite) and sealed with a proprietary drying oil that makes them waterproof, strong, and polished. In our first decade of operations, EarthEnable has installed ~60,000 products for over 300,000 individuals and created livelihoods for over 1,300 people. See our new product - a full house - here!

Position Overview 

The Territory Lead is responsible for the overall performance, growth, and operational excellence of their assigned territory. This role combines commercial leadership, operational oversight, and people management to ensure sales targets are met, construction projects are executed efficiently, and customers receive an exceptional experience. 

The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-driven leader who can translate strategy into execution, build high-performing teams, and operate with strong business acumen in dynamic field environments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Territory Ownership and Business Performance 

Own the end-to-end performance of the territory, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and operational priorities. 

Develop and execute localized sales and operational strategies informed by market insights, customer needs, and competitive dynamics. 

Drive achievement of assigned sales and build targets while maintaining strong quality and customer satisfaction standards. 

Monitor territory performance through data and KPIs, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective actions. 

2. Sales Leadership and Customer Experience 

Lead the recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of Customer Sales Officers (CSOs) to build a strong and productive sales force. 

Equip teams with the tools, messaging, and support needed to effectively engage customers and convert leads. 

Champion customer-centric practices, ensuring a seamless journey from initial engagement through project completion. 

Strengthen relationships with cooperatives, institutions, local leaders, and community stakeholders to expand market reach and reinforce EarthEnable’s mission. 

Oversee territory-level marketing and activation initiatives to drive demand and brand visibility.

3. Operational and Construction Excellence 

Oversee all construction activities within the territory, ensuring adherence to quality standards, timelines, and safety practices. 

Align construction capacity with sales volume to prevent project delays and backlog. 

Partner closely with operations teams to coordinate material forecasting, ordering, and delivery. 

Track project progress and ensure timely follow-up on active builds, addressing bottlenecks before they escalate. 

Continuously identify opportunities to improve construction efficiency and reduce cycle times. 

4. Financial Stewardship and Data Integrity 

Ensure customer payments are collected in accordance with company policies while maintaining the highest standards of financial accountability. 

Monitor territory-level financial indicators, including revenue, cost drivers, and operational efficiency. 

Promote accurate and timely data capture to support reporting, forecasting, and informed decision-making. 

Safeguard company resources by reinforcing compliance with internal controls. 

5. Team Leadership and Culture Building 

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing territory team across sales and construction functions. 

Provide regular coaching, mentorship, and structured performance feedback to strengthen capability and accountability. 

Foster a culture grounded in professionalism, collaboration, continuous learning, and results. 

Model EarthEnable’s values and cultivate an environment where team members feel motivated, supported, and empowered to succeed. 

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Operations, or a related field. 

Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in field operations, sales leadership, or territory management. 

Demonstrated success managing teams and delivering measurable business results. 

Strong operational mindset with the ability to balance commercial growth and execution quality. 

Experience working in fast-paced or growth-oriented organizations is highly desirable. 

Proficiency in data-driven decision-making and performance management. 

Key Competencies

Territory Lead at EarthEnable Rwanda: (Deadline 27-09-2026)

JOB DESCRIPTION: TERRITORY LEAD 

Company: EarthEnable 

Reports to: District Operations Lead 

Location: Different districts in Rwanda 

Compensation: 320,000 - 350,000 RWF (Rwandan Franc) / month gross, depending on experience 

Who We Are 

At EarthEnable, we believe that our clients deserve our very best, that work should be fun, and that the best ideas could come from any part of the company. We celebrate each other’s wins, learn from our setbacks, and are deeply proud of the impact we make every day. We believe a home that doesn’t make you sick means more than living disease-free. It means pride and dignity in the place our customers most treasure: their homes. Being a part of our team means more than building housing products: it means building an organization and building a better future for rural families. 

What We Do 

EarthEnable is transforming the way people live, by making homes healthier for families across rural Rwanda, Uganda, and Kenya. 80% of Rwandans live in homes with dirt floors which are dusty, unsanitary, and fertile breeding grounds for parasites and germs. While replacing a dirt floor with concrete has significant health benefits (e.g. reducing diarrhea by 50% and parasitic infections by 80%), concrete is unaffordable for many who need it, and is also responsible for 8% of global carbon emissions. 

EarthEnable addresses this pressing and ubiquitous problem by selling high-quality, earthen housing products like our flagship floor that is 80% cheaper than concrete with 90% less embedded energy. Earthen floors, plasters, and blocks are composed of natural materials (gravel, clay, sand, and laterite) and sealed with a proprietary drying oil that makes them waterproof, strong, and polished. In our first decade of operations, EarthEnable has installed ~60,000 products for over 300,000 individuals and created livelihoods for over 1,300 people. See our new product - a full house - here!

Position Overview 

The Territory Lead is responsible for the overall performance, growth, and operational excellence of their assigned territory. This role combines commercial leadership, operational oversight, and people management to ensure sales targets are met, construction projects are executed efficiently, and customers receive an exceptional experience. 

The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-driven leader who can translate strategy into execution, build high-performing teams, and operate with strong business acumen in dynamic field environments. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Territory Ownership and Business Performance 

  • Own the end-to-end performance of the territory, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and operational priorities. 
  • Develop and execute localized sales and operational strategies informed by market insights, customer needs, and competitive dynamics. 
  • Drive achievement of assigned sales and build targets while maintaining strong quality and customer satisfaction standards. 
  • Monitor territory performance through data and KPIs, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective actions. 

2. Sales Leadership and Customer Experience 

  • Lead the recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of Customer Sales Officers (CSOs) to build a strong and productive sales force. 
  • Equip teams with the tools, messaging, and support needed to effectively engage customers and convert leads. 
  • Champion customer-centric practices, ensuring a seamless journey from initial engagement through project completion. 
  • Strengthen relationships with cooperatives, institutions, local leaders, and community stakeholders to expand market reach and reinforce EarthEnable’s mission. 
  • Oversee territory-level marketing and activation initiatives to drive demand and brand visibility.

3. Operational and Construction Excellence 

  • Oversee all construction activities within the territory, ensuring adherence to quality standards, timelines, and safety practices. 
  • Align construction capacity with sales volume to prevent project delays and backlog. 
  • Partner closely with operations teams to coordinate material forecasting, ordering, and delivery. 
  • Track project progress and ensure timely follow-up on active builds, addressing bottlenecks before they escalate. 
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve construction efficiency and reduce cycle times. 

4. Financial Stewardship and Data Integrity 

  • Ensure customer payments are collected in accordance with company policies while maintaining the highest standards of financial accountability. 
  • Monitor territory-level financial indicators, including revenue, cost drivers, and operational efficiency. 
  • Promote accurate and timely data capture to support reporting, forecasting, and informed decision-making. 
  • Safeguard company resources by reinforcing compliance with internal controls. 

5. Team Leadership and Culture Building 

  • Build, lead, and retain a high-performing territory team across sales and construction functions. 
  • Provide regular coaching, mentorship, and structured performance feedback to strengthen capability and accountability. 
  • Foster a culture grounded in professionalism, collaboration, continuous learning, and results. 
  • Model EarthEnable’s values and cultivate an environment where team members feel motivated, supported, and empowered to succeed. 

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Operations, or a related field. 
  • Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in field operations, sales leadership, or territory management. 
  • Demonstrated success managing teams and delivering measurable business results. 
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to balance commercial growth and execution quality. 
  • Experience working in fast-paced or growth-oriented organizations is highly desirable. 
  • Proficiency in data-driven decision-making and performance management. 

Key Competencies 

  • Strong leadership and people development skills 
  • Results-oriented with high ownership and accountability 
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability 
  • Excellent stakeholder and community engagement skills 
  • Financial and operational discipline 
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic environments 
  • Clear communicator with the ability to influence and motivate teams

Diocese ya Butare

Ikanisa ya Sakara
Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara

ITANGAZO RYO GUPIGANIRA ISOKO RYO GUTANGA INKOKO KU MUSHINGA

Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara, ukorera mu Itorero Anglican ry’u Rwanda (EAR), Paruwasi ya Ramba, Ikanisa ya Sakara ku bufatanye na Compassion International, uramenyesha ba rwiyemezamirimo bose babyifuza kandi bujuje ibisabwa ko ushaka gutanga amasoko akurikira:

Isoko ryo kugura no kugemura inkoko ku mushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara

Abifuza gupiganira iri soko barasabwa kuza gufata ibitabo bikubiyemo amabwiriza y’isoko (Tender Documents) ku biro by’Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara mu masaha y’akazi guhera ku wa 14/09/2026 kugeza ku munsi uzatangazwa mu gitabo cy’amabwiriza y’isoko.

Kugira ngo umuntu ahabwe igitabo cy’amabwiriza y’isoko, agomba kuba yishyuye amafaranga adasubizwa angana na 10,000 Frw kuri konti nimero:

Konti No: 4009201234081

Kandi akitwaza inyemezabwishyu (bordereau) igaragaza ko ayo mafaranga yishyuwe.

Abapiganwa bazashyikiriza amabaruwa yabo ku wa 28/09/2026 afunze neza kandi yujuje ibisabwa nk'uko bizagaragara mu gitabo cy’amabwiriza y’isoko.

Gufungura amabaruwa y’amasoko

Amabaruwa y’amasoko azafungurirwa mu ruhame ku biro by’Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara ku wa 28/09/2026 imbere y’abapiganwa.

Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara ufite uburenganzira bwo kwemera cyangwa kwanga isoko iryo ari ryo ryose igihe bibaye ngombwa kandi hakurikijwe amabwiriza agenga amasoko y’umushinga.

Bikorewe i Sakara, ku wa 13/09/2026.

Sunzu Jean Marie Vianney
Pasiteri wa EAR Paruwasi ya Ramba
Uhagarariye Umushinga RW0676 EAR Sakara

Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

This is a Director of Biomedical Engineering Unit position at the Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK).

Responsibilities or duties

The role involves overseeing maintenance planning, MEMMS, equipment lifecycle management, budgeting, reporting, and coordination with clinical departments. Specific duties include installing, testing, maintaining, and repairing biomedical equipment, performing preventive maintenance and safety checks, troubleshooting equipment failures, and ensuring medical equipment meets safety, quality, and regulatory standards. The position also requires training healthcare workers on equipment use, keeping accurate records, collaborating with medical staff and hospital management to identify equipment needs, assisting with procurement and evaluation, and supporting the development or improvement of medical devices and technologies. item.title: Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioners Technician job at Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK)
item.company: Central University Hospital Of Kigali ( CHUK )
item.description:
Reports To

Director of Medical Equipement and Infrastructure Development Unit

Job responsibilities

Install, maintain, service, and repair HVAC systems and equipment.

Inspect air-conditioning, ventilation, heating, refrigeration, and cooling systems for proper operation.

Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and refrigeration-related faults.

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on HVAC equipment.

Clean, replace, and repair filters, coils, fans, belts, motors, compressors, thermostats, and other components.

Check and adjust refrigerant levels and identify refrigerant leaks.

Test electrical circuits, controls, motors, and other HVAC components.

Read and interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, and wiring diagrams.

Ensure HVAC systems provide appropriate temperature, humidity, and air quality.

Respond to equipment breakdowns and emergency maintenance requests.

Maintain accurate records of inspections, maintenance, repairs, and replacement parts.

Follow occupational health, safety, environmental, and refrigerant-handling requirements.

Recommend equipment repairs, upgrades, or replacement when necessary.

Work with other technicians, electricians, plumbers, contractors, and facility-management teams.

Provide guidance to customers or building occupants on the proper operation of HVAC equipment.

Keep tools, equipment, and work areas clean and safe.

  • Work with other technicians, electricians, plumbers, contractors, and facility-management teams.
  • Provide guidance to customers or building occupants on the proper operation of HVAC equipment.
  • Keep tools, equipment, and work areas clean and safe.

item.company: Central University Hospital Of Kigali ( CHUK )
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

This job posting is for a Plumber A1 position at the Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK). The role is under contract and is at Level 7.II.

Responsibilities or duties

The responsibilities include installing, maintaining, and repairing hospital water-supply and plumbing systems. This involves maintaining hot and cold water distribution, repairing various plumbing fixtures and systems, and ensuring the proper functioning of drainage, sewage, and wastewater systems. The role also requires inspecting systems, responding to emergencies, and assisting with new installations and renovations. A key aspect is working safely around medical areas and adhering to infection-prevention procedures.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

The job requires ensuring plumbing work complies with health, safety, environmental, and building requirements. Maintaining records of repairs and materials used is also a responsibility.

Experience needed

Preventive and corrective maintenance according to the hospital maintenance schedule is expected.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

The role involves monitoring water consumption and reporting system problems. Maintaining tools and equipment, and keeping work areas clean and safe are also part of the duties.

item.title: Electrical Technician job at Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK)
item.company: Central University Hospital Of Kigali ( CHUK )
item.description:
Background

This is a contract position at Level 7.II within the Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK).

Job Responsibilities

Install, maintain, test, and repair hospital electrical systems and equipment. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical installations. Inspect electrical panels, distribution boards, cables, switches, sockets, lighting, and protective devices. Troubleshoot electrical faults and restore power safely and promptly. Maintain main power supply, generators, UPS systems, batteries, and emergency power systems. Maintain normal and emergency lighting systems, including lighting in operating theatres, wards, laboratories, and other critical areas. Test and maintain electrical protection systems such as circuit breakers, fuses, earthing, and surge protection. Monitor electrical loads and identify potential overloads or unsafe conditions. Carry out electrical installations for new buildings, renovations, and hospital equipment. Support the installation and connection of medical and non-medical equipment in coordination with biomedical and engineering teams. Respond to electrical emergencies and power failures, particularly in critical clinical departments. Carry out routine inspections and electrical safety testing. Read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications. Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, maintenance, faults, and electrical test results. Assist in energy-efficiency initiatives and monitor unnecessary power consumption. Supervise or coordinate electrical contractors when required. Ensure all electrical work follows applicable electrical codes, occupational-safety requirements, and hospital procedures. Maintain electrical tools, testing instruments, spare parts, and equipment in good condition.

item.title: Laundry Machine Operator/A1 job at Central University Hospital of Kigali (CHUK)
item.company: Central University Hospital Of Kigali ( CHUK )
item.description:
Reports To

Director of Medical Equipement and Infrastructure Development Unit

Job responsibilities

Operate industrial washing machines, dryers, extractors, ironing machines, and other laundry equipment.

Sort hospital linen according to type, colour, level of contamination, and washing requirements.

Load and unload laundry machines safely and according to equipment capacity.

Select appropriate washing programs, temperatures, chemicals, and cycle times.

Ensure contaminated and heavily soiled linen is handled according to hospital infection-control procedures.

Monitor machines during operation and identify unusual noise, vibration, leakage, overheating, or other faults.

Report equipment breakdowns and technical problems to the maintenance or engineering team.

Perform routine cleaning and basic operator-level maintenance of laundry machines.

Ensure correct use and storage of laundry detergents, disinfectants, and other chemicals.

Transfer clean linen safely to drying, ironing, folding, and storage areas.

Operate industrial pressing, ironing, folding, and finishing equipment where required.

Maintain cleanliness and organization of the laundry area.

Follow hospital infection-prevention, occupational-health, and safety procedures.

Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when handling contaminated linen or chemicals.

Avoid mixing clean and dirty linen and maintain proper separation between clean and contaminated areas.

Record laundry quantities, machine cycles, chemical usage, and equipment problems where required.

Assist in identifying damaged linen and separating items requiring repair or disposal.

Ensure clean linen is properly folded, packaged, stored, and delivered to hospital departments.

Report shortages of detergents, linen, PPE, and other laundry supplies.

Work closely with nursing, housekeeping, infection-control, and maintenance teams.
