The post holder is expected to be highly organized, service-oriented, discreet and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy international school environment.

Your main duties and responsibilities include:

Executive and Administrative Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, appointments, meetings, reminders and follow-up actions.
  • Prepare agendas, meeting packs, minutes, briefing notes, reports, presentations and routine correspondence.
  • Maintain accurate electronic and physical records for campus operations, events, suppliers, facilities and related activities.
  • Track decisions, assigned actions and deadlines, and provide timely reminders to responsible staff members.
  • Receive and appropriately direct enquiries, requests and concerns relating to campus operations and events.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

Campus Operations Coordination

  • Support the Director in coordinating daily operational requirements across the School campus, including classrooms, offices, boarding facilities, common areas and event spaces.
  • Receive, log and follow up maintenance, facilities, transport, grounds, housekeeping, security and logistical requests with the relevant teams.
  • Assist in planning room allocations, venue readiness, furniture arrangements, signage and operational set-ups.
  • Conduct or support routine readiness checks and report defects, risks, delays or service gaps to the Director.
  • Maintain operational schedules, checklists, service records, asset-related information and departmental trackers.
  • Support coordination with contractors, vendors and service providers, including access arrangements, work schedules and completion follow-up.
  • Assist with stock monitoring and timely requests for operational and event-related supplies.

Events Planning and Delivery

  • Support the planning and delivery of School events, meetings, ceremonies, conferences, parent activities, student programs, official visits and community engagements.
  • Prepare event plans, timelines, checklists, duty rosters, venue layouts, guest lists and logistical requirements.
  • Coordinate event requirements such as venues, seating, audio-visual support, catering, décor, transport, accommodation, protocol, security, cleaning and signage.
  • Liaise with internal departments and external service providers to confirm responsibilities, timelines and standards.
  • Be present during event set-up, delivery and breakdown, including outside normal working hours when required.
  • Support guest reception, registration, ushering, protocol and the resolution of operational issues during events.
  • Assist with post-event reviews, documentation of lessons learned and follow-up on outstanding actions or supplier matters.

Procurement, Budget and Vendor Support

  • Prepare and track purchase requests, quotations, delivery notes, invoices and other supporting documentation in accordance with School procedures.
  • Assist the Director in monitoring departmental and event expenditure against approved budgets.
  • Maintain organized vendor and service-provider records, including contacts, quotations, agreements and performance notes.
  • Verify that requested goods and services have been delivered as agreed and promptly report any discrepancies.
  • Promote value for money, proper documentation and responsible use of School resources.

Communication and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serve as a professional point of contact for staff, students, parents, visitors and suppliers on matters assigned by the Director.
  • Communicate operational and event arrangements clearly, accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Maintain positive working relationships across academic, boarding, administration, security, finance, procurement, transport, communications and other School functions.
  • Escalate urgent concerns, safety issues, service failures or reputational risks to the Director without delay.
  • Provide courteous and culturally sensitive service in line with the standards of an international school.

Safety, Safeguarding and Compliance

  • Comply with the School’s safeguarding, child-protection, health and safety, security, data-protection and confidentiality requirements.
  • Support the implementation of risk assessments, emergency arrangements, access controls and safety measures for events and campus activities.
  • Immediately report hazards, incidents, safeguarding concerns or breaches of procedure through the appropriate channels.
  • Ensure contractors, visitors and service providers follow School access, conduct and safety requirements.
  • Carry out duties in accordance with applicable Rwandan laws, School policies and approved procedures.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or advanced diploma in Business Administration, Hospitality, Events Management, Facilities Management, Operations, Public Administration or a related field.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in administration, operations, facilities, hospitality, events or executive support; experience in a school, hotel, conference centre or similar service environment is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple activities, stakeholders, schedules and deadlines.
  • Practical experience preparing reports, meeting minutes, trackers, purchase documentation and event plans.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides, email and calendars.
  • Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Kinyarwanda is strongly preferred; knowledge of French or German is an added advantage.
  • A valid driving license is an advantage.
  • Experience within international schools, higher education, or nonprofit organizations.
  • Experience working in Africa and/or within multicultural environments.
  • Familiarity with donor-funded programs and grant compliance.

Required Competencies and Personal Attributes

  • Excellent organization, planning and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation and follow-up.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, solve problems and remain calm under pressure.
  • High level of integrity, reliability, discretion and accountability.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with people from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds.
  • Service mindset, flexibility and willingness to support activities beyond normal office hours when operationally necessary.
  • Ability to work independently while keeping the Director appropriately informed.
  • Commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and the values of Ntare Louisenlund School.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Administrative tasks, minutes, reports and follow-up actions are completed accurately and on time.
  • Operational requests are properly logged, assigned, monitored and closed within agreed timelines.
  • Events are delivered according to approved plans, budgets, safety requirements and service standards.
  • Venues, facilities and logistical arrangements are ready at the required time.
  • Vendor, procurement and expenditure documentation is complete, accurate and well organized.
  • Internal and external stakeholders receive timely, professional and helpful communication.
  • Risks, incidents, delays and service failures are promptly identified and escalated.
  • School policies, safeguarding standards and confidentiality requirements are consistently observed.

Benefits & Compensation

  • A fully equipped school campus with excellent facilities in a beautiful natural setting in Bugesera.
  • An exceptional in-house professional development program with travel opportunities for further IB professional development.
  • Small learning groups.
  • An extensive and diverse co-curricular program and the possibility of taking part in or offering co-curricular experiences for students.
  • Collaboration with an experienced, internationally recognized school in Germany.
  • Various partnerships with external educational partners.
  • A committed, dedicated, and team-oriented faculty.
  • A competitive compensation package (in Rwandan Francs), based on your level of experience

item.title: Facilities Support Technician job at Ntare Louisenlund International School Rwanda
item.description:
Who we are:

Ntare Louisenlund School (Rwanda) aspires to become the premier institution in Africa, dedicated to fostering excellence in education. Through the Rwanda plus-STEM program, the school aims to attract the finest talents in mathematics, computer science, natural sciences, and technology, serving as a catalyst for innovation, entrepreneurship, and future-shaping endeavors. Situated on a sprawling 60-hectare campus in Rwanda's Bugesera District, a brief forty-five-minute drive from Kigali, the school is designed to accommodate up to 1,000 boarding students.

Ntare Louisenlund School is committed to delivering an exceptional international education, empowering students to seek scholarships at the world's leading universities. The student body will comprise two halves, with a portion selected through a rigorous assessment and funded by appropriate scholarships (plus-STEM stream), and the remainder consisting of students from across Africa pursuing the IB Diploma with their families financing the education. Seeking candidacy as an IB World School, Ntare Louisenlund School plans to offer the IB Middle Years Programme and Diploma Programme.

Operated and managed by Ntare Louisenlund CBC, in collaboration with Stiftung Louisenlund, a renowned institution with over 75 years of experience running a secondary boarding school in Germany, Ntare Louisenlund School strives for comparable excellence at both locations in Germany and Rwanda. A strategic partnership with the Rwandan government is envisioned to identify plus-STEM students eligible for government scholarships.

Your challenge and responsibilities:

We are seeking an adaptable, self-driven On-Call Night Facilities Support Technician responsible for providing basic, cross-functional maintenance support and acting as the primary first responder for overnight technical emergencies. While not expected to be a master engineer, this individual must possess a generalized foundational knowledge of campus systems and a strong willingness to learn. Above all, we are looking for a highly accountable, passionate problem-solver and collaborative team player who takes ownership of their work. The technician will ensure that all systems operate safely during the night and that any critical failures are seamlessly stabilized for the day-shift specialists, directly contributing to our standard of operational excellence.

Key Emergency Response & Basic Maintenance Duties:

First Response: Act as the immediate responder for overnight alarms or failures across the school campus.

Electrical & Generators: Provide basic troubleshooting for the school’s electrical distribution systems, lighting systems, and backup power systems (generators and UPS) in the event of power outages. Monitor fuel supplies for generators.

Plumbing & Pumps: Address basic plumbing issues, such as immediate leaks and blockages, to prevent water damage. Monitor pump systems (water supply, drainage, and other fluid systems).

HVAC & Fire Safety Systems: Perform basic checks on HVAC equipment if issues arise. Monitor fire alarm control panels, investigate activated zones, reset false alarms after verification, and ensure all firefighting systems (sprinklers, hydrants, extinguishers) remain unobstructed.

Elevator Systems: Respond immediately to elevator malfunction alerts. Secure the area during breakdowns, coordinate emergency protocols with specialized elevator contractors in the event of entrapments, and perform basic system resets if authorized and safe to do so.

CCTV & Security Infrastructure: Support the night security team by troubleshooting offline CCTV cameras, rebooting network video recorders (NVRs), and ensuring that perimeter lighting and electronic access control systems remain fully functional.

Kitchen Equipment & Audio-Visual (AV): Monitor commercial kitchen walk-in refrigerators and freezers for overnight temperature alarms. Safely reset tripped commercial cooking equipment and provide basic troubleshooting for advanced AV systems used in auditoriums for early morning events.

Safety & Reporting: Secure the area around any major civil works or infrastructure failures (roofs, walls, floors) to ensure safety. Provide detailed, written handover reports to the specialized day team (electricians, plumbers, civil engineers) for advanced repairs.

Qualifications:

Education: A high school diploma, vocational certificate, or technical training in general maintenance. (A Bachelor's degree in Engineering is not required, it would be an addition).

Experience: Hands-on experience in general facilities maintenance. Experience in an educational or institutional setting is a plus.

Technical Knowledge: Foundational understanding of general MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) systems, engineering best practices and a strong willingness to receive cross-training from specialized staff.

Problem-Solving: The ability to stay calm under pressure, assess a system failure during the night, and take immediate action to stabilize the situation and prevent property damage.

Benefits & Compensation

A fully equipped school campus with excellent facilities in a beautiful natural setting in Bugesera.

An exceptional in-house professional development programme with travel opportunities for further IB professional development.

Small learning groups.

An extensive and diverse co-curricular programme and the possibility of taking part in or offering co-curricular experiences for students.

Collaboration with an experienced, internationally recognized school in Germany.

Various partnerships with external educational partners.

A committed, dedicated, and team-oriented faculty.

item.title: Data Scientist job at GIZ Rwanda
item.description:
About GIZ Rwanda

The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH has been working in Rwanda for more than 40 years.Rwanda is a country with a turbulent and, at times, tragic history, and t...

About This Opportunity

The position of Data Scientist at GIZ Rwanda located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

About GIZ and the Project

The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH is a federally owned international cooperation enterprise for sustainable development with worldwide operations. The GIZ Office in Kigali covers GIZ’s portfolio in Rwanda and Burundi and as well as selected regional activities and projects. GIZ Rwanda/Burundi implements projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), the European Union and other commissioning authorities in the following priority areas: Sustainable Economic Development; Good Governance; Climate, Energy and Sustainable Urban Development; Digital Transformation and Digital Economy; and regional projects in the Great Lakes Region.

At GIZ, we do not just work in international cooperation – we strive to shape the future of sustainable development. Through the AI Hub of the Digital Transformation Center Rwanda, GIZ brings together several initiatives that foster responsible and impactful AI innovation across Africa.

Our Mission? To foster responsible and impactful AI innovation in Africa and to build a thriving, inclusive and locally driven AI ecosystem – one grounded in sound policy, strong skills and real-world use cases that deliver socio-economic impact across the continent.

Our Approach? The AI Hub hosts and connects a range of initiatives that work together to:

Shape enabling AI policy and responsible, ethical and inclusive AI governance;

Strengthen skills and capacity across the public sector and the wider AI ecosystem;

Turn ideas into impact through concrete, scalable AI use cases;

Grow a vibrant AI community and innovation ecosystem across Africa.

Our Partners? We work hand in hand with governments, civil society, academia and open-source AI communities, foster collaboration between the African and European private sector, and partner with regional organisations such as Smart Africa and the East African Community.

Your Next Career Move? We’re assembling a dynamic, purpose-driven team and are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist with expertise in AI and particularly Natural Language Processing & Machine Translation to help bring this vision to life. This is a hands-on technical role for a builder: you will own the AI Hub’s language-technology products – conversational assistants (chatbots) and machine translation – from concept through to deployment, champion open-source and open-innovation approaches, and help partners and GIZ projects turn AI ideas into working, responsible solutions. If you’re passionate about applied AI, African languages and building technology that lasts, this is your moment.

Responsibilities

The Data Scientist is the technical owner of the AI Hub’s Natural Language Processing & Machine Translation products and a hands-on advisor to partners and GIZ projects. The role spans three interlinked areas – product ownership, AI use-case development and technical advisory – and is tasked with:

Owning the AI Hub’s products in the areas of conversational AI and machine translation – from concept and design through development, testing, deployment and iteration – with a strong emphasis on African languages and low-resource NLP.

Championing open-source and open-innovation approaches, including responsible use, adaptation, fine-tuning and release of open models, datasets and tools, and the building of local capacity to sustain them.

Facilitating structured assessments of potential AI use cases – from problem framing and feasibility through data readiness, technical scoping and prioritisation – to detect where AI can deliver real socio-economic value.

Advising other GIZ projects and partners on the design, procurement, integration and quality assurance of NLP, machine translation and broader AI solutions.

Embedding responsible, ethical and inclusive AI practices across the product lifecycle, including data protection, privacy, fairness, transparency and mitigation of language and representation bias.

Ensuring effective project and product management across the assigned workstreams, including planning, budgeting, steering of contractors, and monitoring and evaluation.

Building and maintaining relationships with diverse stakeholders across Rwanda and the region – government, academia, start-ups, developer and open-source communities – and identifying synergies across GIZ projects and networks.

  • Facilitating structured assessments of potential AI use cases – from problem framing and feasibility through data readiness, technical scoping and prioritisation – to detect where AI can deliver real socio-economic value.
  • Advising other GIZ projects and partners on the design, procurement, integration and quality assurance of NLP, machine translation and broader AI solutions.
  • Embedding responsible, ethical and inclusive AI practices across the product lifecycle, including data protection, privacy, fairness, transparency and mitigation of language and representation bias.
  • Ensuring effective project and product management across the assigned workstreams, including planning, budgeting, steering of contractors, and monitoring and evaluation.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with diverse stakeholders across Rwanda and the region – government, academia, start-ups, developer and open-source communities – and identifying synergies across GIZ projects and networks.

item.title: Communications Officer job at BRAC
item.description:
About the AIM Program:

The Mastercard Foundation Accelerating Impact for Young Women (AIM) in Partnership with BRAC is equipping 2 million adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) with age-appropriate entrepreneurship, employability, and life-skills training, as well as the tools to start and scale their own businesses. The nine-year program (2021-2030) applies BRAC’s proven model using microfinance, youth empowerment, agriculture, education and skills development to enhance lives and livelihoods. It currently operates in seven African countries: Sierra Leone, Liberia, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ghana, and Kenya. Based on the AGYW age, needs, and circumstances, AGYW are placed on one of two pathways in the AIM program: an education pathway or a livelihood pathway.

About the Role:

The Communications Officer will guide the design and execution of strategies that effectively showcase BRAC Rwanda’s mission, programs, and impact, ensuring that stakeholders, partners, and the wider public remain well-informed and engaged. In this role, the officer will strengthen BRAC’s visibility and reputation in the country by cultivating strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups, while upholding the highest standards of sensitivity, accuracy, and integrity in all communications. Success in the position requires a collaborative mindset, working closely with colleagues to create compelling strategies and materials that advance BRAC’s mission and align with its vision.

Key Responsibilities:

Create and execute a robust, results-oriented communications strategy for the Country Office that supports its strategic goals and aligns with BRAC International (BI) strategy.

Write, design and oversee the production of creative and compelling communications and marketing materials; stories, photographs, videos, fact sheets, brochures and other materials; for diverse audiences, including public and private donors, local and national governments, partners, media and other key stakeholders.

Ensure compliance with donor-specific branding and marking requirements across all project communications and visibility materials.

Build and keep strong relationships with journalists and media houses; produce press releases and statements, respond to media inquiries and keep an up-to-date media and journalists’ database.

Under the supervision of the Senior Manager, Communications, Strategic Partnerships & Resource Mobilization, create audience-specific messages and detect and utilize effective channels to disseminate communications materials to key audiences.

As appropriate, oversee BRAC Rwanda’s social media channels and create engaging content for platforms including Facebook, LinkedIn and X among others.

deliver communications assist for events, including the development of signage, brands handouts, talking points and other visibility materials, photography and media liaison.

Ensure compliance with BRAC communications policies and keep confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive information.

create and publish compelling stories and content that showcase BRAC Rwanda’s reach, achievements and impact.

track and evaluate communications activities using relevant metrics and insights to assess impact and inform continuous improvement of communications strategies and approaches.

Write and edit program participant stories, video scripts, blogs, case studies, fact sheets, capacity statements, annual reports and other communications products.

keep an editorial calendar and oversee monthly and annual content planning and production processes.

assist the development of presentations, speeches, key messages and speaking points for Country Office leadership.

create and keep strategic communications relationships with government institutions, donors, development partners, private sector actors, philanthropic organizations and other key stakeholders.

create and organize internal communications that keep staff informed, engaged and aligned with BRAC Rwanda’s priorities, programs, achievements and organizational developments.

Design and execute integrated communications campaigns around BRAC Rwanda’s programs, thematic priorities, organizational milestones and advocacy priorities.

Ensure the ethical, dignified and safeguarding-compliant representation of programs participants across all photography, videography, storytelling and communications materias including appropriate informed consent and protection of sensitive information.

keep and systematically oversee a central repository of approved photographs, videos, stories, publications, branding assets and other communications materials.

Where necessary, organize and oversee external communications service providers and creative consultants, ensuring quality, timely delivery, budget compliance and adherence to BRAC standards.

assist communications budget planning and work plans, tracking and utilization, while ensuring value for money in communications-related expenditure.

assist resource mobilization efforts through the development of compelling donor-facing narratives, programs profiles, case studies, pitch materials, impact stories and visibility materials.

Academic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism or any other related fields.

Required Experience:

At least 3 years’ work experience with proven experience in communications, public relations, or media management within an NGO, or development sector environment.

Demonstrated ability to design and execute communication strategies and campaigns that align with organizational goals.

Experience in managing social media platforms, websites, and digital communication tools to build brand visibility.

Track record of producing high‑quality written content such as press releases, newsletters, reports, and promotional materials.

Experience in building and maintaining relationships with media outlets, stakeholders, and partners.

Familiarity with event planning and coverage, including preparing communication materials and coordinating publicity.

Experience handling crisis communication and managing sensitive information with discretion.

Background in monitoring and evaluating communication activities, including use of analytics to measure impact.

Prior experience working in multicultural or cross‑functional teams, demonstrating adaptability and collaboration.

Experience working in integrated social development programming is a plus.

Required Skills, Competencies & Knowledge:

Understanding communication theories, practices, and strategies

Knowledge of media relations, public relations, and stakeholder engagement

Familiarity with branding, reputation management, and corporate identity

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to craft clear, compelling, and persuasive messages

Proficiency in digital tools (social media analytics, website management, email marketing software, Adobe tools etc)

Strategic thinking: aligning communication activities with organizational goals

Experience in creative design, photography, and videography

Creativity and innovation: developing engaging campaigns and fresh ideas

Collaboration: working effectively with program teams, leadership, and external partners

Integrity: ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and ethical use of information.

About BRAC International:

BRAC International (BI), a leading non-profit organization, is on a mission to empower people and communities facing poverty, illiteracy, disease, and social injustice. Our vision is to create a world free from exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realize their potential. We design proven, scalable solutions that equip people with the assist and confidence they need to achieve their potential.

BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 and over the last five decades has grown to become one of the world’s largest non-governmental organisations (NGOs), reaching over 100 million people. We started our first international operation by venturing into Afghanistan in 2002, building on lessons from our work in Bangladesh to assist a nation devastated by war. Currently operating in 16 countries across Asia and Africa. Born, proven and led in the Global South, BRAC International brings a unique Southern perspective and commitment to continuous learning, providing a depth of insight, experience and evidence to meet the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage across Asia and Africa. To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org)

Our Core Values:

Integrity: We approach our collaborate with honesty and integrity.

Innovation: We innovate and iterate to enhance our impact.

Inclusiveness: We foster inclusion to reach those who need it most.

Effectiveness: We strive for effectiveness to better serve people in poverty.

item.title: Resource Mobilization and Donor Engagement Specialist job at World Vision
item.description:
About World Vision International Rwanda

World Vision International Rwanda is a Christian humanitarian organization established in 1994 to provide emergency relief following the genocide, now focused on long-term development. It supports ove...

Who May Be Interested

Professionals seeking career advancement and individuals with relevant qualifications may be interested in this opportunity.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Resource Mobilization and Donor Engagement Specialist based in Kigali, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Resource Mobilization and Donor Engagement Specialist at World Vision International Rwanda located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

JOB OPPORTUNITY

Resource Mobilization and Donor Engagement Specialist

Open ended contract.

World Vision is a child-focused Christian humanitarian organization implementing development programmes in 30 Districts of Rwanda. Our interventions in the strategic period of 2026-2030 seek to reach 2.5 million of the most vulnerable children. This is done through programming in Child Protection, Education, Nutrition and WASH, and Poverty Alleviation (Resilience and Livelihoods).

World Vision Rwanda seeks to hire a highly qualified, dedicated, and experienced Rwandan national for the role of Resource Mobilization and Donor Engagement Specialist joining an established and experienced team. This stimulating position incorporates a range of skills and development in multiple areas, allowing for an exciting opportunity for career growth in a dynamic, global organization. It will be based in Kigali, Rwanda, and will report to the Resource Development Manager.

Purpose of the position:

To enhance efficiency, strategic alignment, and end-to-end accountability for resource acquisition, World Vision Rwanda (WVR) is strengthening its resource mobilization function through a senior role that supports donor engagement, business development, pre-positioning, proposal development, and resource acquisition efforts. This approach is intended to enhance coordination across the funding lifecycle, strengthen accountability for results, and assist funding diversification and sustainable growth. The Senior Resource Development and Donor Engagement Specialist plays a key role in advancing WVR's resource mobilization agenda. The position supports efforts to detect, position for, and secure funding across institutional, private sector, and domestic funding streams while strengthening donor engagement, stewardship, and organizational positioning. This includes cultivating relationships with institutional donors, bilateral and multilateral agencies, foundations, private sector actors, philanthropic organizations, and domestic funding stakeholders in assist of WVR's Strategic Objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITES

30% Strategic Donor Engagement, Pre-positioning and Opportunity Management

End Results: Strengthened donor engagement and stewardship across institutional, bilateral, multilateral, UN, foundation, private sector, and domestic funding partners. Enhanced donor intelligence, competitor mapping and strategic positioning, resulting in increased visibility and readiness for funding opportunities. Well-managed funding pipeline and opportunity tracking that supports resource acquisition planning and decision-making. Improved organizational representation and partner engagement, leading to stronger relationships, strategic partnerships, donor retention and competitive positioning in the funding landscape. donor engagement plan/strategy for each Financial Year. Strengthen innovation through innovative financing mechanisms, digital fundraising, innovative partnerships and new donor approaches

35% Proposal Development and Quality Assurance

End Results: High-quality, competitive, and compliant funding proposals developed and submitted in accordance with donor requirements and organizational standards. Effective cross-functional coordination of proposal processes, ensuring timely inputs, clear accountability, and on-time submissions. Strengthened strategic partnerships and consortium engagement, supporting localization and enhanced competitiveness for funding opportunities. Improved proposal development systems, tools, and quality assurance mechanisms, resulting in greater efficiency, consistency, and proposal success rates.

20% Domestic Resource Mobilization

End Results: Strengthened domestic resource mobilization and fundraising performance through effective implementation of local fundraising initiatives and campaigns. Enhanced corporate and donor engagement, resulting in increased sponsorship opportunities, partnerships, and local giving support. Compelling donor-facing materials and fundraising propositions developed and utilized, contributing to improved fundraising outcomes and sustainable revenue growth.

5% Resource Development Systems and Reporting

Strategic Donor Intelligence and Funding Analysis - Robust donor intelligence, funding landscape analysis, and strategic insights generated to inform resource mobilization priorities, donor engagement strategies, positioning efforts, and funding decisions. Funding Pipeline and Opportunity Management - Accurate and up-to-date tracking of funding opportunities, donor engagements, proposal progress, Go-No Go decisions and acquisition outcomes within IMPAQ and related systems, providing reliable visibility of the funding pipeline and supporting resource acquisition planning. Resource Mobilization Reporting and Performance Insights - Timely production of resource mobilization reports, dashboards, and management insights to monitor performance, assess progress against targets, and support evidence-based decision-making. Strategic Planning and Organizational Readiness - Enhanced organizational planning, positioning, and funding readiness through the effective use of donor intelligence, opportunity forecasting, pipeline analysis, and resource mobilization data. Strengthen GAM data governance to ensure data driven decision making in acquisition stemming out of quality data. Strengthen knowledge management by use of available organisational platforms such as box to maintain donor intelligence data bases, proposal library and lessons learnt

5% Capacity Strengthening and Knowledge Management

End Results: Enhanced staff capacity in proposal development, donor compliance, and resource acquisition practices through training, coaching, and technical support. Strengthened organizational learning and institutional knowledge through effective knowledge sharing, documentation of best practices, and dissemination of lessons learned.

5% Other Responsibilities

End Results: Effective contribution to National Office planning, review processes, organizational priorities, and special assignments, ensuring alignment of resource acquisition efforts with broader organizational goals and operational needs.

KNOWLEDGE/QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE ROLE

Required Professional Experience

Minimum 5-7 years of progressive experience in resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, and proposal development within the international development, humanitarian, or non-profit sector. Demonstrated experience securing and managing competitive funding opportunities from institutional donors, bilateral and multilateral agencies, United Nations organizations, Foundations, Trusts, Government and private sector partners. Familiarity with UN funding portals and government engagement co creation processes is an advantage. Proven experience in resource acquisition and proposal management, including donor positioning, funding pipeline management, opportunity assessment, concept development, and consortium building. Demonstrated experience building and managing strategic relationships with donors, government institutions, development partners, and other key stakeholders. Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and complex proposal processes involving technical, programmatic, finance, operations, and support functions. Experience in donor intelligence, funding analysis, reporting, knowledge management, and capacity strengthening to support organizational growth, competitiveness, and resource acquisition performance.

Required Education, training, license, registration, and certification

Education

Master's Degree in International Development, Business Administration, Economics, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Communications, International Relations, Project Management, or a related field. A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field combined with substantial and relevant professional experience may be considered. If a foreign institution issues the degree, an equivalence certificate from the Rwanda Higher Education Council (HEC) will be required)

Professional Training

Training in resource mobilization, donor engagement, proposal development, business development, grant acquisition, partnership development, or fundraising. Training in project design methodologies, results-based management, proposal costing and budgeting, donor compliance, or grant management is an added advantage.

Professional Certifications (Desirable)

Certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is an advantage. Certification in fundraising, resource mobilization, grant management, business development, or partnership management is desirable. Relevant certifications in Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL), Results-Based Management, or strategic planning are an added advantage.

License / Registration

No specific professional license or registration required.

Other Requirements

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Demonstrated ability to use donor intelligence and engagement tools, grants management, pipeline management, and advanced proposal development platforms. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications

Strong knowledge of resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, grant acquisition, and partnership development within the international development sector. Familiarity with project design, results-based management, proposal development, budgeting, consortium development, and localization approaches. Knowledge of donor intelligence platforms, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), grants management systems, and resource mobilization tools. Strong analytical, partnering management, networking, negotiation, and communication skills. Experience working in international development, humanitarian, faith-based, or similar organizations. Professional training or certification in project management, resource mobilization, fundraising, grant management, or related fields is an added advantage.

Language Requirements

English proficiency

item.title: Site Manager job at Trinity Metals
item.description:
Who we Are:

Rutongo Mines Ltd is a Tin Mining Company, situated in Masoro Sector, Rulindo District, Northern Province. The Management of Rutongo Mines Ltd informs the public that it is recruiting Internal and External Competent, Qualified and Experienced staff for the following positions:

Position/Job Title: Site Manager

Grade: D1

Department: Mining

Reports to: Mine Manager

Job Brief or Position Summary:

Site Manager is tasked with overseeing and managing all site activities to ensure efficient, safe, and environmentally compliant mining operations. This role encompasses operational leadership, staff supervision, safety, occupational health, environmental compliance, and community relations. The Mine Superintendent/Site Manager is the key point of contact between site operations and the company’s management, ensuring that all site activities align with the company’s strategic goals and regulatory requirements.

Site Manager is pivotal in driving operational success, maintaining safety and environmental standards and fostering a positive work environment.

Responsibilities:

Operational Management:

Leading and overseeing day-to-day mining operations, including extraction, hauling, tramming, processing, and transportation activities.

Collaborate with technical services team to create and execute operational plans and schedules to achieve production targets.

Track equipment performance and organize maintenance and repair activities to minimize downtime.

Requisition equipment necessary for the implementation of the mine plan.

Optimize resource utilization and ensure efficient operation of all mining and processing equipment.

Assist Management in all aspects of growing the business.

Occupational Health and Safety Compliance:

Enforce and promote adherence to safety and occupational health regulations, standards, and best practices.

Perform regular safety and occupational health inspections, audits, and risk assessments to detect and mitigate potential hazards.

Guide safety and occupational health training programs and ensure all personnel are trained and compliant with safety and health procedures.

Personnel Management:

Oversee and guide site personnel, including hiring, training and development, performance management and discipline management.

Create and execute workforce schedules and oversee site staffing levels to meet operational needs.

Foster a positive work environment and encourage teamwork and professional development.

Control daily attendances and leaves.

Training and Development:

Create and execute training programs for new and existing employees to ensure they are skilled and knowledgeable about mining operations and safety procedures.

Stay current with industry trends and advancements and incorporate relevant practices into training programs.

Budget and Resource Management:

Produce and oversee site budgets, including capital and operational expenditures.

Track financial performance and execute cost-saving measures where applicable.

Organize procurement and management of site resources, including materials, equipment and supplies.

Environmental Compliance and Community Relations:

Ensure adherence to all environmental regulations, policies and practices to protect the environment and minimize impact on surrounding areas.

Execute and track environmental management plans.

Engage with local communities and stakeholders, addressing concerns and fostering positive relationships.

Execute and track anti-illegal mining strategies and plans.

Ensure compliance with all environmental regulations and company policies related to.

Reporting and Communication:

Report on site performance, incidents, accidents and issues to the Mine Manager regularly.

Produce and present detailed reports on production metrics, safety performance, and operational challenges.

Facilitate effective communication between site teams and the central management team.

Emergency Response:

Create and execute emergency response plans and procedures for site incidents.

Guide emergency response efforts and organize with external emergency services when necessary.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in mining from a recognized Institution or any related degree with 4 years’ experience in mining; or Advanced Diploma in Mining from a recognized Institution or any related degree with 5 years’ experience in mining.

Minimum of 3 years of experience in Underground Mining operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial role.

Strong knowledge of mining processes, techniques, equipment, and safety standards.

Proven experience in budget management, staff supervision, and operational planning.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to use English as the language of business.

Ability to work effectively under pressure and adapt to changing conditions.

Ability to collaborate with Microsoft office (excel, word, PowerPoint).

Be able to work under these Conditions:

The role requires working on-site in potentially hazardous environments.

Availability for on-call emergency response and extended hours as needed.

Regular travel to and from the site, and occasional off-site meetings or training sessions.

Ideal Candidate:

The ideal candidate for the Mine Superintendent/Site Manager role will be an experienced leader with a strong background in mining operations and a proven track record of managing safety, environmental, and operational aspects of a mining site. They will possess exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to fostering a safe and productive work environment while maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements.

item.description:
Who we Are:

Rutongo Mines Ltd is a Tin Mining Company, situated in Masoro Sector, Rulindo District, Northern Province. The Management of Rutongo Mines Ltd informs the public that it is recruiting Internal and External Competent, Qualified and Experienced staff for the following positions:

Position/Job Title: Mine Supervisor (5)

Grade: C3

Department: Mining

Reports to: Site Manager

Job Brief or Position Summary:

The Mine Supervisor is tasked with overseeing the day-to-day mining activities in the area or in the tunnel she/he is responsible to ensure safety, efficiency, and productivity. This role involves leading and managing mining crews, coordinating with various departments and ensuring compliance with regulations and company policies.

Responsibilities:

Mine supervisor has the following responsibilities and duties:

Safety and Compliance:

Ensure all mining operations comply with occupational health and safety regulations, company policies, and environmental standards.

perform regular occupational health and safety inspections and risk assessments to detect and mitigate potential hazards.

execute and enforce occupational health and safety protocols, including emergency response plans.

guide safety meetings and training sessions to promote a culture of safety.

Investigate accidents and incidents, document findings and implementing corrective actions.

Operational Oversight:

guide and organize daily mining activities, including drilling, blasting, loading, tramming and hauling.

track production schedules and ensure operations are carried out efficiently and within set targets.

Oversee equipment maintenance and ensure machinery is in good order.

Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues promptly to minimize downtime.

create and execute operational strategies to enhance productivity and efficiency.

Daily Operational Management:

Plan and schedule daily mining tasks and allocate resources effectively to meet production goals.

Supervise the daily setup and operation of mining equipment and machinery.

organize with the geology and survey teams to ensure proper ore body identification and extraction techniques are used.

organize with the processing and laboratory teams to ensure proper minerals beneficiation techniques are used.

Oversee the execution of drilling and blasting operations, ensuring adherence to occupational health and safety and operational guidelines.

track and adjust ventilation systems to ensure a safe and productive working environment.

oversee the transportation and logistics of extracted materials to processing facilities including production to the upgrade plant.

Collect data, evaluate and analyze daily production reports, identifying trends and areas for improvement.

make sure that all personnel follow standard operating procedures and occupational health and safety protocols.

make sure that all working areas are adhering to best hygiene, cleanliness and house-keeping practices.

perform regular checks on the stability and integrity of underground structures to prevent collapses or other hazards.

oversee and oversee the daily maintenance and repair of mine infrastructure and equipment.

organize with the maintenance team to schedule and prioritize repairs or upgrades to minimize operational disruptions.

Supervise the implementation of dust control measures and ensure compliance with environmental regulations.

keep accurate and up-to-date records of daily operational activities, including production quantities, equipment usage, and personnel performance.

Team Management:

guide, mentor, and oversee teams of miners and mine workers, including assigning tasks and monitoring performance.

perform regular performance evaluations and deliver feedback and assist to team members.

Ensure adequate staffing levels and oversee shift schedules to meet operational needs.

Foster a collaborative team environment and resolve conflicts or issues within the team.

Communication and Coordination:

Collaborate with other departments, such as geology, survey, processing, engineering, maintenance and SHEC, to ensure smooth operation and resolve any cross-functional issues.

produce and submit detailed reports on mining operations, production metrics, occupational health and safety and environmental incidents.

Communicate effectively with management and deliver recommendations for improvements.

organize with external contractors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services.

Regulatory and Environmental Compliance:

Ensure compliance with all local, and national, regulations regarding mining operations.

execute environmental management practices to minimize the impact of mining activities on the surrounding ecosystem.

keep up-to-date knowledge of industry regulations and best practices.

Oversee the proper disposal of waste materials and management of environmental impact assessments.

Budget and Resource Management:

Request regarding the required materials and equipment,

track and control operational costs to stay within budget.

oversee resource allocation, including manpower and materials, to optimize efficiency.

detect opportunities for cost-saving measures and operational improvements.

Oversee distribution of necessary supplies and equipment, ensuring cost-effectiveness and availability.

Training and Development:

create and execute training programs for new and existing employees to ensure they are skilled and knowledgeable about mining operations and safety procedures.

Stay current with industry trends and advancements and incorporate relevant practices into training programs.

Quality Control and Assurance:

track and assess the quality of mining operations, including ore extraction and processing.

track and assess the quality of mineral concentrates produced from the area or from the tunnel she/he is tasked with and ensure they meet the company’s standards.

execute quality control measures to make sure that mining activities meet operational and regulatory standards.

Address any quality issues or deviations from expected performance.

Technology and Innovation:

Stay abreast of technological advancements and innovations in mining equipment and techniques.

Evaluate and recommend new technologies that could enhance operational efficiency and safety.

execute and oversee new technologies or systems in the underground mining environment.

Job Requirements:

Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, Mining Technology, Mineral Processing, or a related mining discipline.

Experience

Minimum of 2years of experience in underground Mining operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.

Skills:

Strong knowledge of underground mining techniques, equipment, and safety practices.

item.description:
About Trinity Musha Mines Ltd

Trinity Musha Mines Limited is a Rwandan mining company that operates the Musha mine and is a subsidiary of Trinity Metals Limited.

Who May Be Interested

Professionals seeking career advancement and individuals with relevant qualifications may be interested in this opportunity.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Plant Maintenance Supervisor based in Rwamagana, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Plant Maintenance Supervisor at Trinity Musha Mines Ltd located in Rwamagana, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

Common Skills Required

Communication

Leadership

Management

Excel

Planning

Training

JOB ADVERT - Plant Maintenance Supervisor

Trinity Musha Mines Ltd is a Mining company focused on the production and exploration of Tin, Tantalum, and Lithium in Rwanda. Trinity Musha is currently inviting suitable candidates to apply for the following position:

Position/Job Title: Plant Maintenance Supervisor

Grade: C3

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Engineering Superintendent

Job Brief:

To supervise, plan, and organize all plant maintenance activities, ensuring that plant equipment and machinery are maintained safely, reliably, and efficiently, while leading and developing the maintenance team to achieve maximum plant availability.

Responsibilities:

Plant Maintenance Supervisors have the following responsibilities and duties:

Plan, organize, and supervise preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance activities for all plant equipment and machinery (crushers, screens, conveyors, pumps, motors, etc.).

Create and execute maintenance schedules and programs to minimize unplanned downtime and maximize plant availability and reliability.

Supervise, organize, and allocate daily tasks and to maintenance team.

Track equipment performance, investigate recurring breakdowns, perform root cause analysis, and execute corrective and preventive actions.

Ensure strict compliance with Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) procedures and standards in all maintenance activities.

Keep accurate maintenance records, including work orders, equipment history files, spare parts usage, and maintenance reports.

Organize closely with Production/Operations teams to plan and schedule maintenance shutdowns with minimal disruption to plant output.

Train, mentor, supervise, and evaluate the performance of maintenance staff, and detect training needs.

Ensure proper use, calibration, and upkeep of maintenance tools, equipment, and workshop facilities.

Participate in the preparation and control of the plant maintenance budget, monitoring maintenance costs against targets.

Produce and submit periodic (daily, weekly, and monthly) maintenance performance reports to the Engineering Superintendent.

Ensure plant equipment complies with statutory, regulatory, and manufacturer requirements.

Respond promptly to plant breakdowns and emergencies, mobilizing the maintenance team to restore operations safely and quickly.

Job Requirements:

The Plant Maintenance Supervisor should have the following qualifications and skills:

Bachelor's Degree (A0) or Advanced Diploma (A1) in Mechanical Engineering, with extensive relevant experience.

Minimum 5 years of proven experience in plant maintenance, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role, preferably within a mining, heavy industrial processing plant.

Strong working knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems used in crushing, screening, and materials-processing plants.

Knowledge of preventive maintenance planning principles; familiarity with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an added advantage.

Strong leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to supervise a multidisciplinary maintenance team.

Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to perform root cause analysis and execute lasting corrective actions.

Sound understanding of Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations applicable to industrial and mining operations.

Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and maintenance reporting/documentation tools.

Ability to work under pressure, oversee competing priorities, and make sound decisions during breakdowns or emergencies.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Kinyarwanda and/or French is an advantage.

Willingness to work extended hours, weekends, or be on standby/on call as required by plant operations.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Trinity Musha Mines Ltd values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, or background.

item.title: HQ Accountant job at Intwari SACCO Gicumbi
item.description_html:
About INTWARI SACCO GICUMBI (ISG)

INTWARI SACCO GICUMBI (ISG) is a District Savings and Credit Cooperative (D-SACCO) established following the consolidation of twenty-one Umurenge Sacco’s operating within Gicumbi District, in accordance with the Government of Rwanda SACCO consolidation framework. ISG is duly registered under RCA and licensed by the National Bank of Rwanda (BNR).

In accordance with the Government of Rwanda SACCO’s consolidation framework and under the supervision of the National Bank of Rwanda (BNR) INTWARI SACCO GICUMBI is looking for qualified, competent, committed, proactive and self-motivated individual to occupy the following positions:

POSITION NAME: HQ ACCOUNTANT

REPORTS TO: HEAD OF FINANCE & ADMNISTRATION

RESPONSIBILITIES & TASKS

Under the supervision and guidance of the Head of Finance & Administration:

  • To work diligently on the assigned tasks on time and to produce results;
  • To comply with the instructions of the employer or his/her representative;
  • To take good care of and manage the equipment assigned to him/her in his/her work;
  • To be at work and respect working days and hours;
  • To maintain confidentiality of work;
  • To provide basic identification documents before starting work;
  • To follow the principles and rules governing the conduct of the Cooperative's business activities;
  • Ensures that the accounting systems of the Institution comply with the accounting standards;
  • Verifies the correctness of cash, general ledger account balance with balance carried; according to the month end cash collection and deposit report;
  • Follows up the status of accounts receivables, and other collections and payables;
  • Prepares the inventory for asset accounts in cooperation with the concerned departments;
  • Reviews ledger accounts, track balances for correctness and prepares an interim annual financial statement and closes books of accounts on the end of every fiscal period;
  • Facilitates audit activities, submits timely financial reports and provides required data and information that maybe required by auditors, implements auditor’s recommendations;
  • Closes books of accounts, and prepares financial statements (income statement, balance sheets, etc.) and reports to various stakeholders (e.g. BNR) periodically;
  • Reconciles accounts with debtor and creditors;
  • Reconciles the interbranch, inter-district and interbank accounts and investigation on reasons for unbalanced/unreconciled accounts;
  • Maintains share and member register;
  • Checks and certifies correctness of payroll, travel allowances, per diem and related payments;
  • Consolidates financial statements of branches;
  • Processes banker’s cheque requests and transactions;
  • Prepares the annual tax declaration;
  • Any other duty that does not conflict with the laws and regulations as requested by the Head of Finance & Administration or his/her superior authority.

QUALIFICATION/JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field.
  • Proven years of relevant experience.
  • Accounting certification CPA, ACCA would be added value.
  • Minimum five years (5 years) of experience in accounting of MFIs/ Banks.
  • Advanced knowledge of related statutory and regulatory banking compliance regulations, accounting principles, and tax laws.
  • Good skills in the use of computers and Core Banking Software.
  • Good financial reporting skills.
  • Good planning, organizational, analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Integrity

item.title: Leathercraft and Crafting Teacher job at Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI)
item.description:
About Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI)

The Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI) is a young, women-led Rwandan non-profit that works to improve the lives of women and girls through education, capacity building, and advocacy. Operating since...

About This Opportunity

The position of Leathercraft and Crafting Teacher at Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI) located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

JOB ADVERTISEMENT: 

Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI) is seeking to recruit a “Leathercraft and Crafting Teacher”. 

Introduction 

IMPANURO is a Kinyarwanda word that translates as "good advice" or "guidance." Impanuro Girls’ Initiative (IGI) is a young women-led national non-governmental organization legally registered and authorized to operate in Rwanda. As a nonprofit organization, IGI fosters women's empowerment and builds girls' agency under registration number N° 763/RGB/NGO/LP/11/2021 issued by the Rwanda Governance Board (RGB). The founder of the organization was determined to address teenage pregnancy issues resulting from poor or no access to Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) information and services, among other systemic challenges. 

Our Values: PASSION, HUMANITY, ACCOUNTABILITY, and INTEGRITY. 

Our Mission: We are a young women-led Rwandan non-governmental organization, striving to enhance women and girls’ lives through education, capacity building, counselling, socio-economic empowerment, and advocacy to ensure a healthy and dignified lifestyle. 

Our Vision: A Rwandan society where women and girls have healthy and dignified lives, are meaningfully engaged in communities and are economically empowered. 

About the Role 

The Leathercraft and Crafting Teacher will deliver 6 months of comprehensive, highly practical instruction to students at the IGI Ruhango Tekena Hub using dedicated inventory assets. Your objective is to train students in the integrated processes of leather footwear production, artisanal design, and contemporary handcrafting, equipping young women to launch self-reliant micro-enterprises, footwear workshops, or creative craft brands, while supporting each trainee's confidence, voice, and economic empowerment. Training follows the RTB-accredited 6-month curriculum, including competency-based assessment, trainee portfolios, and supervision of the 2-month Industrial Attachment Program. This position works closely with both the Field guide and Center Coordinator. 

Who The organization is seeking: 

Education Qualifications 

Education: Diploma or Certificate in Leather Technology, Footwear Production, Fine Arts, Industrial Art and Design, or a related composite TVET qualification. 

Certification: TVET teacher certification or formal pedagogical training endorsement. 

Experiences: 

2–3 years of verifiable experience operating an active footwear manufacturing workshop, custom leather goods company, or commercial craft collective. 

Expert proficiency across shoe lasting methodologies, mechanical operation of heavy leather machines, hand tools, precise fabric/leather nesting, and diverse traditional African weaving patterns (such as Agaseke). 

RTB-registered Trainer/Assessor status or Trainer of Trainers (ToT) certificate is an added advantage; valid Police Clearance/Criminal Record Certificate required prior to appointment. 

LANGUAGES 

Candidates must be Complete fluency in Kinyarwanda.

Professional working proficiency in English and/or French is a strong advantage.

item.description:

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Hairdressing Teacher based in Kigali, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Hairdressing Teacher at Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI) located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

Common Skills Required

Leadership

Management

Planning

Training

JOB ADVERTISEMENT: 

Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI)is seeking to recruit a “Hairdressing Teacher”. Introduction 

IMPANURO is a Kinyarwanda word that translates as "good advice" or "guidance." Impanuro Girls’ Initiative (IGI) is a young women-led national non-governmental organization legally registered and authorized to operate in Rwanda. As a nonprofit organization, IGI fosters women's empowerment and builds girls' agency under registration number N° 763/RGB/NGO/LP/11/2021 issued by the Rwanda Governance Board (RGB). The founder of the organization was determined to address teenage pregnancy issues resulting from poor or no access to Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) information and services, among other systemic challenges. 

Our Values: PASSION, HUMANITY, ACCOUNTABILITY, and INTEGRITY. 

Our Mission: We are a young women-led Rwandan non-governmental organization, striving to enhance women and girls’ lives through education, capacity building, counselling, socio-economic empowerment, and advocacy to ensure a healthy and dignified lifestyle. 

Our Vision: A Rwandan society where women and girls have healthy and dignified lives, are meaningfully engaged in communities and are economically empowered. 

About the Role 

The Hairdressing Teacher will deliver 6 months of practical, hands-on lessons to students at the IGI Ruhango Tekena Hub. Your ultimate goal is to equip young women with advanced hairdressing and salon styling techniques, turning these technical skills into profitable, self reliant businesses or vibrant freelance styling careers, while supporting each trainee's confidence, voice, and economic empowerment. Training follows the RTB-accredited 6- month Hairdressing curriculum, including competency-based assessment, trainee portfolios, and supervision of the 2-month Industrial Attachment Program. This position works closely with both the Field guide and Center Coordinator. 

Who The organization is seeking: 

Education Qualifications 

Education: Diploma or Advanced Certificate in Hairdressing, Cosmetology, Beauty Therapy, or a related technical trade. 

Certification: TVET teacher certification, pedagogical training, or a certified technical equivalent. 

Experiences: 

2–3 years of professional experience running an active beauty salon or working as a guide hairstylist/instructor. 

Expert mastery of local and modern braiding, dreadlocks, weaving, relaxed hair care, styling aesthetics, and salon workspace organization. 

RTB-registered Trainer/Assessor status or Trainer of Trainers (ToT) certificate is an added advantage; valid Police Clearance/Criminal Record Certificate required before appointment. 

LANGUAGES 

Candidate must be Complete fluency in Kinyarwanda. 

Professional working proficiency in English and/or French is a strong advantage. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Teach comprehensive hairdressing techniques, including professional hair cutting, advanced styling, chemical processing, coloring, braiding, and weaving.

Deliver structured hands-on practical lessons covering modern scalp care, hair treatments, and strict salon hygiene and sanitation standards. 

Instruct students on the safe handling, maintenance, and sterilization of professional hairdressing tools and electrical salon equipment. 

Train students in salon customer care, active consultation skills, client retention techniques, and foundational salon management. 

Plan and organize simulated salon environments and practical exams within the hub to test speed, creativity, and execution. 

Help students detect hyper-local beauty market gaps and design low-cost freelance or mobile hair styling business models. 

oversee daily lesson planning, student attendance mapping, regular skills assessments, and comprehensive technical training reports. 

perform RTB-aligned formative and summative competency assessments, keep trainee portfolios, and assist the 2-month Industrial Attachment Program (IAP) placement and supervision after training. 

keep a safe, gender-responsive learning environment in line with IGI's Safeguarding Policy, and actively encourage trainees' confidence, voice, and leadership.
