This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Hairdressing Teacher based in Kigali, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Hairdressing Teacher at Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI) located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

Common Skills Required

Leadership

Management

Planning

Training

JOB ADVERTISEMENT:

Impanuro Girls Initiative (IGI)is seeking to recruit a “Hairdressing Teacher”. Introduction

IMPANURO is a Kinyarwanda word that translates as "good advice" or "guidance." Impanuro Girls’ Initiative (IGI) is a young women-led national non-governmental organization legally registered and authorized to operate in Rwanda. As a nonprofit organization, IGI fosters women's empowerment and builds girls' agency under registration number N° 763/RGB/NGO/LP/11/2021 issued by the Rwanda Governance Board (RGB). The founder of the organization was determined to address teenage pregnancy issues resulting from poor or no access to Sexual Reproductive Health (SRH) information and services, among other systemic challenges.

Our Values: PASSION, HUMANITY, ACCOUNTABILITY, and INTEGRITY.

Our Mission: We are a young women-led Rwandan non-governmental organization, striving to enhance women and girls’ lives through education, capacity building, counselling, socio-economic empowerment, and advocacy to ensure a healthy and dignified lifestyle.

Our Vision: A Rwandan society where women and girls have healthy and dignified lives, are meaningfully engaged in communities and are economically empowered.

About the Role

The Hairdressing Teacher will deliver 6 months of practical, hands-on lessons to students at the IGI Ruhango Tekena Hub. Your ultimate goal is to equip young women with advanced hairdressing and salon styling techniques, turning these technical skills into profitable, self reliant businesses or vibrant freelance styling careers, while supporting each trainee's confidence, voice, and economic empowerment. Training follows the RTB-accredited 6- month Hairdressing curriculum, including competency-based assessment, trainee portfolios, and supervision of the 2-month Industrial Attachment Program. This position works closely with both the Field guide and Center Coordinator.

Who The organization is seeking:

Education Qualifications

Education: Diploma or Advanced Certificate in Hairdressing, Cosmetology, Beauty Therapy, or a related technical trade.

Certification: TVET teacher certification, pedagogical training, or a certified technical equivalent.

Experiences:

2–3 years of professional experience running an active beauty salon or working as a guide hairstylist/instructor.

Expert mastery of local and modern braiding, dreadlocks, weaving, relaxed hair care, styling aesthetics, and salon workspace organization.

RTB-registered Trainer/Assessor status or Trainer of Trainers (ToT) certificate is an added advantage; valid Police Clearance/Criminal Record Certificate required before appointment.

LANGUAGES

Candidate must be Complete fluency in Kinyarwanda.

Professional working proficiency in English and/or French is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

Teach comprehensive hairdressing techniques, including professional hair cutting, advanced styling, chemical processing, coloring, braiding, and weaving.

Deliver structured hands-on practical lessons covering modern scalp care, hair treatments, and strict salon hygiene and sanitation standards.

Instruct students on the safe handling, maintenance, and sterilization of professional hairdressing tools and electrical salon equipment.

Train students in salon customer care, active consultation skills, client retention techniques, and foundational salon management.

Plan and organize simulated salon environments and practical exams within the hub to test speed, creativity, and execution.

Help students detect hyper-local beauty market gaps and design low-cost freelance or mobile hair styling business models.

oversee daily lesson planning, student attendance mapping, regular skills assessments, and comprehensive technical training reports.

perform RTB-aligned formative and summative competency assessments, keep trainee portfolios, and assist the 2-month Industrial Attachment Program (IAP) placement and supervision after training.

keep a safe, gender-responsive learning environment in line with IGI's Safeguarding Policy, and actively encourage trainees' confidence, voice, and leadership.

item.title: Agronomist job at Fisher Global Ltd
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

Fisher Global Ltd is a Rwandan agribusiness and diversified business company established in 2016, with a strong focus on sustainable agriculture, agricultural production, processing, export, logistics, and international trade. The company is committed to contributing to Rwanda’s economic development by connecting high-quality Rwandan agricultural products to local and international markets while creating sustainable economic opportunities for farmers and rural communities.

Fisher Global’s core agricultural activities include the commercial production and aggregation of chilli, soybeans, maize, and other high-value crops, complemented by agronomic assist, farm management, post-harvest handling, warehousing, and export services. The company has developed particular expertise in the chilli value chain, including the production, processing, quality management, packaging, and export of dried chilli products to international markets.

Fisher Global Ltd is expanding its agricultural and post-harvest operations and invites applications from qualified, motivated, and results-oriented candidates for the following positions:

AGRONOMIST

The Agronomist will deliver technical and field-level assist to ensure improved crop productivity, quality, sustainability, and compliance with Good Agricultural Practices (GAP). The successful candidate will work closely with farmers, field teams, and other stakeholders to assist crop production and achieve Fisher Global Ltd’s agricultural objectives.

Responsibilities or duties

Deliver technical advice on crop production, soil fertility, irrigation, fertilizer application, pest and disease management, and crop protection.

Perform regular farm visits to track crop performance and detect production challenges.

Train farmers and field teams on modern farming technologies and Good Agricultural Practices (GAP).

Perform field demonstrations, farmer training, and extension activities.

Assist out-growers and partner farmers with technical assistance.

Track crop establishment, growth, harvesting, and overall production performance.

Collect field data and assist yield estimation and production forecasting.

Track proper use of agricultural inputs and compliance with company production standards.

Assist food safety, traceability, certification, environmental, and sustainability requirements.

Produce accurate weekly, monthly, and seasonal reports.

Participate in field trials, research, demonstrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Promote climate-smart agriculture, soil and water conservation, and environmentally responsible farming.

Keep good relationships with farmers, local authorities, cooperatives, and agricultural stakeholders.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Bachelor’s Degree in Agronomy, Agriculture, Crop Science, Horticulture, Soil Science, Plant Science, or a closely related field.

Practical experience in crop production, soil fertility, irrigation, fertilizer application, pest and disease management, and crop protection.

Experience working directly with farmers, out-growers, cooperatives, or agricultural extension programs.

Experience conducting farmer training, field demonstrations, and field visits.

Knowledge of GAP, food safety, traceability, and sustainable agriculture.

Knowledge of climate-smart agriculture and soil and water conservation is an advantage.

Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and report-writing skills.

Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

Ability and willingness to travel extensively to farms and project sites countrywide.

The candidate must be proficient in motorcycle riding and possess a valid motorcycle driving license.

Must be 35 years of age or younger.

Experience needed

Having 1–2 years of relevant experience in agronomy, crop production, agricultural extension, farm management, or a related area will be an additional advantage.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

Number of position: 17 Agronomists to be deployed at 17 working sites in different Districts.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

The Candidates for both positions should demonstrate:

Strong work ethic and professional integrity.

Commitment to quality and customer requirements.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Willingness to work in field, rural, processing, and agricultural environments.

Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively under pressure.

Female candidates, candidates with disabilities and Refugee candidates are strongly encouraged to apply for both positions.

item.title: Drying Site Officer job at Fisher Global Ltd
item.description:
About Fisher Global Ltd

Fisher Global Ltd is a Rwandan agribusiness and diversified business company established in 2016, with a strong focus on sustainable agriculture, agricultural production, processing, export, logistics, and international trade. The company is committed to contributing to Rwanda’s economic development by connecting high-quality Rwandan agricultural products to local and international markets while creating sustainable economic opportunities for farmers and rural communities.

Fisher Global’s core agricultural activities include the commercial production and aggregation of chilli, soybeans, maize, and other high-value crops, complemented by agronomic assist, farm management, post-harvest handling, warehousing, and export services. The company has developed particular expertise in the chilli value chain, including the production, processing, quality management, packaging, and export of dried chilli products to international markets.

Fisher Global Ltd is expanding its agricultural and post-harvest operations and invites applications from qualified, motivated, and results-oriented candidates for the following positions:

DRYING SITE OFFICER

The Drying Site Officer will oversee post-harvest activities including the receiving, inspection, drying, sorting, grading, processing, and storage of agricultural products such as chili (urusenda), rosemary, and other crops.

The successful candidate will be tasked with maintaining product quality, reducing post harvest losses, ensuring food safety, and supporting efficient movement of produce from collection points through processing and storage.

Key Responsibilities

Receive and inspect agricultural produce from farmers and collection points.

Check incoming produce for quality, moisture levels, damage, and compliance with company standards.

Record quantities received and keep accurate documentation.

Oversee drying operations using mechanical dryers or approved drying methods.

Track drying temperatures, moisture levels, and processing times.

Ensure proper operation, cleaning, and maintenance of drying and processing equipment.

Supervise sorting, grading, cleaning, and initial processing of produce.

Ensure products meet company, buyer, food safety, and quality standards.

Oversee safe storage of dried and processed products.

Keep proper warehouse conditions, stock records, and FIFO inventory systems.

Detect and reduce causes of post-harvest losses.

Track processing output, product losses, stock levels, and quality performance.

Keep accurate daily, weekly, and monthly records and reports.

Assist product traceability and certification requirements.

Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, workplace safety, and environmental standards.

Organize with Field Officers, Logistics, Quality Control, and Operations teams.

Report equipment breakdowns, quality issues, losses, and other operational challenges promptly.

Assist harvesting and post-harvest planning and schedules.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma (A2) in Agriculture, or Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science, Agribusiness, Post Harvest Technology, or a related field.

Having 1–2 years of relevant experience in post-harvest handling, food processing, drying operations, agribusiness, or warehouse operations will be an additional advantage.

Experience with drying systems, food processing equipment, or warehouse management is an advantage.

Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, quality control, and post-harvest loss reduction.

Basic computer skills for reporting and record keeping.

Strong organizational and operational skills.

Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.

Good teamwork and communication skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

High level of integrity, accountability, and responsibility.

Must be 35 years of age or younger.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS

The Candidates for both positions should demonstrate:

Strong work ethic and professional integrity.

Commitment to quality and customer requirements.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Willingness to work in field, rural, processing, and agricultural environments.

Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively under pressure.

item.title: Corporate Contract Management Specialist job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

The Rwanda Development Board (RDB) is seeking a Corporate Contract Management Specialist. This role is crucial for ensuring legal compliance and effective contract management within the organization.

Responsibilities or duties

The Corporate Contract Management Specialist will be responsible for a variety of legal and administrative tasks, including:

Providing General legal support and advice on a wide range of issues.

Drafting Contracts, MoUs, analyzing and reviewing laws, orders, instructions, regulations, rules of procedure relating to RDB activities.

Working with legal analysts in preparing judicial or extra-judicial legal action on behalf of RDB. Receiving summons and being responsible for preparing rebuttal pleadings for RDB.

Liaising with lawyers and the Attorney General's Office on litigation concerning RDB.

Giving legal opinions on the management of user department's issues including but not limited to recruitment, contracts, and termination of contracts.

Proposing and carrying out necessary trainings intended to uplift the level of legal compliance within RDB.

Representing RDB in judicial and extra-judicial proceedings (Upon accreditation by the Rwanda Bar Association).

Representing the Division in internal and external meetings, conferences, etc. under delegation by supervision or any other hierarchical official.

Any other related assignment as may be directed by superior(s).

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Specific qualifications are not detailed in this excerpt, but the responsibilities imply a strong legal background and contract management expertise. Accreditation by the Rwanda Bar Association is required for judicial representation.

Experience needed

Experience in legal support, contract drafting, and litigation is expected.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

This is a Level 3.II position under Statute, with 1 post available. Exams will be conducted, including a Psychometric Test and an Oral exam. The role reports to the Legal Analyst, Team Lead.

Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

The Rwanda Development Board (RDB) is seeking an HR Performance Management Specialist to join their team. This role is crucial for enhancing organizational effectiveness through robust performance management systems.

Responsibilities or duties

The primary responsibilities include performance management, capacity assessment, proposing training programs, supporting the design and implementation of career development and performance management strategies, processes, and tools. The specialist will utilize strategic workforce planning for talent mobility and pipeline creation, assist in developing policies and guidelines for managers, maintain and communicate the performance management calendar, identify training needs, develop the Annual Capacity Building Plan, acclimate new hires, propose training courses, assess training effectiveness, evaluate ongoing programs, coordinate performance appraisal exercises, and monitor Staff Performance Contracts.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Specific qualifications are not detailed in this excerpt but would typically include expertise in HR performance management, strategic workforce planning, and training needs analysis.

Experience needed

Experience in performance management and capacity building is expected.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

This is a Level 3.II position under Statute, with one post available. Exams will be conducted, including Psychometric Test, Written, and Oral assessments. The role reports to the People & Culture Division Manager.

item.title: Procurement Specialist job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description_html:
Job responsibilities

  • Prepare annual procurement plans in accordance with the strategic and action plans for the implementation of program activities and ensure its implementation on a timely and efficient manner;
  • Ensure that all procurement activities are carried out in accordance with the procurement plan as approved by the Senior Management of RDB;
  • Prepare necessary procurement documentation for services, goods and works including the preparation of advertisements, identification of possible suppliers/contractors, preparation of bidding documents, Request for Quotations, Request for proposals, opening reports, evaluation reports, price market research, obtaining the necessary clearances (from RPPA, Tender Committee and Partners);
  • Train or advise staff from user departments in public procurement procedures;
  • Ensure compliance in the procurement of works, goods, and services;
  • Update and maintain the RDB Procurement manual including procedures and standard forms to be used during implementation;
  • Liaise regularly with user departments in executing the procurement plan;
  • Assisting in negotiation of contracts with selected consultants/suppliers. Arrange for signing of contract and distributes them to appropriate authorities;
  • Provide necessary help to the tender committee as secretary to the committee;
  • Any other related assignment as may be directed by superior(s).

item.title: Graphic Design Specialist job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

The Rwanda Development Board (RDB) is seeking a Graphic Design Specialist to join their team. This role is crucial for promoting Rwanda globally through effective visual communication and marketing materials.

Responsibilities or duties

The Graphic Design Specialist will be responsible for:

Collaborating and strategizing with multiple teams for a wide range of materials that include web pages, presentations, branding collateral, signage, internal communication, newsletters, and other various marketing materials.

Developing concepts using innovative software and executing original content using ideal fonts, color, text, imagery and layout.

Assisting on the creative and concept design for activations under the Visit Rwanda partnerships.

Performing day-to-day duties involving design, animation, infographics and other creative works for leading events and projects needed to promote Rwanda under the strategic partnerships for digital communications purpose.

Designing digital media content for Visit Rwanda campaigns and events aligned with RDB’s mandate.

Assisting in Visit Rwanda and RDB’s web presence and boosting brand awareness.

Liaising with RDB Marketing teams to ensure brand consistency online and on social media platforms.

Developing, suggesting and implementing visual and direct marketing and communications methods to increase Rwanda’s visibility globally.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Specific qualifications and skills are not detailed in the provided text, but proficiency in graphic design software and a strong understanding of visual communication principles are expected.

Experience needed

Experience in graphic design, particularly in marketing and digital media, is implied by the responsibilities.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

This is a Level 3.II position under Statute, with 1 post available. Exams will be conducted, including Psychometric Test, Written, and Oral assessments. The role reports to the Head of Communications Department.

item.title: Document & Publication Specialist job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

This role is within the Rwanda Development Board (RDB) and involves managing intellectual property information.

Responsibilities or duties

Undertake publication of all required intellectual property rights information in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations; Manage all processes, systems and procedures relating to documentation of intellectual property applications and registered rights including inputting all required information and data in the relevant systems; Ensure stored data is up to date, accurate, well organized and well protected at all times Ensure stored information on Intellectual Property Rights is available to user and provide reliable and accurate requested information within the required timeframes; Respond timeously and accurately to all search requests on intellectual property applications and registrations rights; Manage efficient search and publication operations by maintaining an updated and modern search system of intellectual property information databases; Collaborate with key stakeholders such as the Prime Minister’s Office to ensure that IP information required to be published by these other stakeholders is availed on time and with the accurate information; Prepare comprehensive reports and statistics regularly and also as and when required. Perform any other duties assigned to her/him by the hierarchical supervisors Develop and maintain professional relationship with customers, colleagues and management

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Level:3.II

Experience needed

Not specified.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

Under Statute. Exams to be conducted: 1:PsychometricTest 2:Written 3:Oral. Reports To: Intellectual Property Division Manager.

item.title: Secretary to Central Secretariat job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

The Rwanda Development Board (RDB) is a government agency responsible for accelerating the country's economic development. This role supports the RDB mission by providing essential administrative functions within the Central Secretariat.

Responsibilities or duties

Contribute to the implementation of the RDB mission by providing the necessary administrative support required for the fulfillment of the RDB mandate; Ensure the RDB Central Secretariat acts with efficient knowledge and remains an effective facilitator to internal and external customers; Ensure proper management of document flow across RDB including archiving function by ensuring appropriate security and access to information; Ensure effective relations with peer departments and in particular in the entire Administration Unit; Manage office communications to maximize internal and external stake holder’s satisfaction; Establish and maintain an effective document management system with appropriate filing, and retrieval systems to the entire project information base; Receive, sort and deliver all Central office incoming mail; Properly manage the implementation of courier and archive contracts; Manage the document tracking system and ensure that it works efficiently and give support where necessary; Any other function which shall be deemed to be appropriate to the efficiency of the Central secretariat functions; Any other related assignment as may be directed by superior(s)

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Specific qualifications are not detailed in this description but would typically include strong organizational skills, proficiency in office software, and excellent communication abilities.

Experience needed

Experience in administrative support or secretarial roles is likely required.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

This is a full-time position under statute. Exams will be conducted, including Psychometric Test, Written, and Oral assessments. The role reports to the Administration & Estate Director.

item.title: Estate Management Officer job at Rwanda Development Board
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

This role is within the Rwanda Development Board (RDB) and focuses on ensuring the optimal condition and functionality of RDB buildings nationwide.

Responsibilities or duties

Ensure that all RDB buildings nationwide are maintained in optimal condition, addressing any issues promptly to ensure operational functionality and safety.

Ensure regular Maintenance of RDB facilities, including lifts, generators, heating, air conditioning, and utility supplies (electricity and water), ensuring they remain in good working condition through regular inspections.

Report any problems or incidents affecting RDB buildings and their surroundings, coordinating with relevant teams for prompt resolution.

Ensure that all RDB buildings have valid insurance coverage, managing insurance policies and claims as necessary.

Support in the Preparation of technical specifications for the rehabilitation and maintenance of RDB buildings, ensuring detailed and accurate documentation for effective project execution.

Ensure the availability and adequacy of office space and associated requirements,

Identify and manage necessary reactive maintenance work, addressing urgent repair needs to minimize disruption and maintain building functionality.

Perform any other tasks as assigned by the supervisor, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the Estate Management function.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Level:4.II

Experience needed

Not specified.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

Under Statute.

item.title: Financial Specialist (Under contract) job at City of Kigali
item.description_html:
Background

This is a contract position within the City of Kigali.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in the preparation of action plans and budgets;
  • Reviews and finalizes final and mid-term budgets for all allotments including development of detailed justifications;
  • Participate in budget negotiations with MINECOFIN;
  • Consolidate revenue collection reports in collaboration with RRA;
  • Coordinate the budget revision process
  • Preparation of annual, quarterly and monthly cash plans of the City of Kigali in collaboration with other departments;
  • Preparation of periodic fund requests from the Treasury;
  • Generate purchase orders for internal approval.
  • Processing commitments for different requests;
  • Ensure all invoices and various requests received from the financial controller are well verified before payment;
  • Check payment documents for further processing;
  • Ensure all invoices from external parties (contractors, suppliers, etc.) are paid in due time and safe keep transaction supporting documents;
  • Record all transactions properly in IFMIS or other accounting software and submit the monthly consolidated report within the stipulated deadlines;
  • Maintain bank accounts, ensure monthly bank statements and account overviews are produced regularly;
  • Prepare bank accounts reconciliation statements;
  • Quarterly review of CoK expenditure vouchers to guide the next quarter disbursement;
  • Implement strong internal control systems in decentralized entities to ensure transparency and accountability;
  • Provide technical / financial assistance to all implementing decentralized entities in the CoK;
  • Consolidate the financial reports and generate the accounting information of decentralised entities;
  • Preparation of periodic budget execution and financial statement reports;
  • Maintain and regularly update of CoK assets inventory register;
  • Ensure that the preparation and review of periodic inventory and fixed asset report is timely produced;
  • Monitor the implementation of the employees’ performance contracts and their appraisals in the finance department;
  • Consolidate and submit the annual performance evaluation report of employees to DAF for further review;
  • Monitor the preparation of the payroll lists, fringe benefits of all concerned staff at the finance department;
  • Facilitate external and internal audit of the CoK;
  • Facilitate process of internal and external audit of different NBAs under CoK supervision;
  • Preparation and submission of activity plans and periodic reports;
  • Perform any other duties assigned by the supervisor.

Qualifications

Not specified.

Experience

Not specified.

Other Details

Exams to be conducted: Psychometric Test, Written, Oral. Reports to Director of Finance Unit.

item.title: Petroleum Market Distribution Specialist job at Ministry Of Trade And Industry
item.description:
Background information about the job or company

This role is within the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MINICOM) and focuses on the petroleum market distribution.

Responsibilities or duties

The responsibilities include formulating and updating petroleum trade policy, monitoring international oil markets, ensuring efficient petroleum product trade and distribution, developing standards for the downstream petroleum sector, organizing government petroleum purchases and sales, supervising loading and offloading of government petroleum products, and ensuring the good functioning and maintenance of government depots.

Qualifications or requirements

Specific qualifications are not detailed in this excerpt, but the role requires a Level 3.II designation and involves reporting to the Director General of Trade & Investment. Exams will include a Psychometric Test, Written Test, and Oral Test.

Experience needed

Experience requirements are not explicitly stated.

Any other provided details

This is a contract position with 1 post available. The application deadline is September 18, 2026.

item.title: Meteorological Applications Officer job at Rwanda Meteorology Agency
item.description:
Background information about the job or company (e.g., role context, company overview)

The Meteorological Applications Officer will be responsible for:

Responsibilities or duties

The Meteorological Applications Officers provide specialist expertise in the fields of Aviation, Agro-Meteorology, Climate and Hydrology.

Deliver services for specialist applications and users, according to the Standard Operating Procedures for each product or service, whether routine or on-demand;

Develop and implement services for users, including liaison with the Division Manager for hybrid services;

provide explanations to the public or other interested groups(s) about the science and applications of weather, water and climate;

Climate change mainstreaming,

Participate in appropriate WMO, regional and national forums, programmes and projects under the supervision of the Senior Met Applications Officer and the Division Manager, Applications and Services.

(specific to the Aviation Application Officer) administer the WMO Competency Assessment Toolkit for Aviation forecasters and Aviation Observers.

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

NB: Candidates with Bachelor's degree in Mathematical Sciences, Physics, Chemistry, Water Resources Management, Environmental Sciences, Statistics, Agriculture/Animal Science, Geography, (GIS)& Remote Sensing, Natural Resources Management or other Earth Sciences must have one (1) year relevant working experience in forecasting center, Meteorological operations and its related applications, meteorological software, NWP models, climate models and their applications and climate information services or successfuly completed a meteorological program/trainning in a recognised WMO Center/institution

item.title: IECMS IT Support Staff & Call Center Operator job at Ministry of Justice
item.description:
Background information about the job or company

This role is for an IT Support Staff & Call Center Operator within the IECMS project at the Ministry of Justice (MINIJUST).

Responsibilities or duties

Interview IECMS users during telephone calls to obtain information useful in providing effective solutions. Manage inbound calls to ensure effective and timely resolution of IECMS user issues. Place outbound calls to verify IECMS user satisfaction. Escalate complex issues to more experienced IECMS team for proper resolution. Support personnel, and act as focal point when end-users face hardware, software, or system issues. Provide phone, remote access, and desktop support to IECMS users. Track assigned tasks throughout problem solving life cycle using the institution’s Help Desk system. Must maintain accurate and timely service tickets. Maintain records of inquiries or complaints as well as logs of interaction with customers. Calm end-users and ensure their challenges or issues are addressed properly. Perform any other task directed by his/her supervisor.

Qualifications or requirements

Key technical skills & knowledge required: Knowledge of customer service practices and principles. Excellent data entry and typing skills. Superior listening, verbal, and written communication skills. Demonstrate decisiveness in resolving problems, making decisions and identifying priorities. Good analytical skills and problem solving techniques. Good interpersonal communication skills and ability to work with others under pressure and solve problems. End-users focus and adaptability to different personality types. Ability to multi-task, set priorities and manage time effectively. The ability to learn quickly and work with minimum supervision.

Experience needed

NB: having Minimum of 1 year of experience in an IT Support and/or call center environment, especially in ICT industry. Previous experience in a customer support role. Having experience in Desktop Support, Network Administration, System Administration are added advantage. Certifications in A++, N++, MCIP, MCSA, CCNA are added advantage.

item.title: Agronomist - FXBVILLAGE Project job at FXB Rwanda
item.description:
About FXB Rwanda

FXB Rwanda is a registered Rwandan Local Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) rooted in Rwanda since 1995, and a member of FXB Global, carrying the legacy of François-Xavier Bagnoud into its fourth decade — across all four provinces and the City of Kigali.

FXB Rwanda implements integrated development programs aimed at reducing poverty and vulnerability and promoting sustainable livelihoods, food and nutrition security, health, education, WASH, and economic empowerment.

FXB Rwanda is currently seeking to recruit a qualified, motivated, and experienced Agronomist to assist the implementation of the FXBVillage Project in Gisagara District.

Position Information

Job Title: Agronomist

Project: FXBVillage Project

Duty Station: Gisagara District, Rwanda

Reports to: Program Coordinator

Employment Type: Fixed-term contract – 12 months, renewable subject to performance

Expected Start Date: October 2026

Project Background

The FXBVillage program uses a holistic approach designed to addresses the multiple interconnected dimensions of poverty, including health, education, and income generation, to help the most vulnerable families become self-sufficient and graduate out of extreme poverty within a three-year period. From October 2026, FXB Rwanda will start the implementation of the FXBVillage project in Kansi and Kibirizi sectors of Gisagara District in the Southern Province of Rwanda.

Job Purpose

The Agronomist will deliver technical guidance and hands-on assist to FXBVillage participant households to enhance agricultural productivity, food and nutrition security, household income, and resilience to climate change.

The position will assist participants to adopt regenerative and climate-resilient agricultural practices, enhance soil health, increase crop productivity and quality, strengthen sustainable farming systems, and link farmers to appropriate markets.

Low-tech solutions and regenerative agriculture practices will be implemented through two complementary levels of Climate-Resilient and Regenerative Agriculture Hubs (CRRAHs). Community CRRAHs will serve as collective learningand demonstration spaces incorporating agroforestry, fruit trees, composting, organic fertilizers, local food preservation techniques, rainwater harvesting, as well as the promotion, propagation, and conservation of local seeds adapted to the agroecological realities of the project areas.

The successful candidate will work closely with participant households, community structures, local authorities, and other agricultural stakeholders to make sure that project-supported agricultural interventions are effectively implemented and generate sustainable results.

A. Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. Agricultural Technical assist and Extension

deliver technical guidance and practical coaching to participant households on crop production and sustainable agricultural practices.

Train farmers on appropriate crop selection, seasonal planning, land preparation, planting, crop management, harvesting, post-harvest handling, and storage.

Promote the adoption of regenerative and climate-resilient agriculture practices, including soil fertility management, erosion control, water conservation, crop diversification, mulching, composting, agroecological practices, and other appropriate techniques.

assist farmers to enhance soil health, productivity, and the sustainable use of available land and natural resources.

perform regular field visits throughout the agricultural cycle, from land preparation and planting through harvesting, to deliver timely technical advice.

detect agricultural challenges affecting participant households and deliver appropriate technical solutions.

2. Farmer Training and Demonstration

Contribute to the design and adaptation of agriculture related training manuals.

Design and facilitate practical agricultural training sessions for participant households .

Establish and facilitate Climate-Resilient and Regenerative Agriculture Hubs (CRRAHs) and practical demonstration plots where appropriate.

Facilitate farmer-led experimentation and learning to detect locally appropriate and effective agricultural practices.

Promote peer-to-peer learning and knowledge sharing among participant farmers.

assist farmers to apply improved technologies, including Water Harvesting techniques and farming practices demonstrated through the project.

3. Agricultural Productivity and Food Security

assist participant households to increase crop productivity, enhance the quality of agricultural produce, and strengthen household food security.

Promote diversified agricultural production to enhance household nutrition and resilience.

Advise farmers on efficient and sustainable use of agricultural inputs and resources.

assist participants to create practical agricultural production plans aligned with local seasons, market opportunities, and household priorities.

4. Market Linkages and Income Generation

Facilitate linkages between farmers, cooperatives, buyers, local markets, and other relevant value-chain actors.

deliver guidance on post-harvest handling, quality improvement, aggregation, and value addition.

detect opportunities for participants to strengthen agriculture-based income-generating activities.

5. Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement

Work closely with Sector and District agricultural officers and agronomists in the planning and implementation of project agricultural activities.

keep effective collaboration with local authorities, farmer groups, cooperatives, extension workers, and other relevant stakeholders.

Participate in relevant agricultural meetings, workshops, trainings, and coordination forums on behalf of FXB Rwanda, as assigned.

Ensure effective coordination between agricultural interventions and other components of the FXBVillage Project.

B. Required Qualifications and Competencies

1. Education and Professional Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Agriculture, Crop Production, Agricultural Sciences, or another closely related field.

At least three (3) years of relevant professional experience in agronomy, agricultural extension, crop production. Working with smallholder farmers and rural communities will be an added advantage.

Demonstrated practical experience in regenerative agriculture, climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable land management, or agroecological practices is highly desirable.

Experience working with NGOs, community-based programs, or development projects will be an added advantage.

Experience facilitating farmer training, demonstration plots, farmer learning groups, or similar community-based agricultural approaches is an advantage.

2. Technical and Personal Competencies

Strong knowledge of regenerative and climate-resilient agriculture practices.

Practical understanding of crop production and smallholder farming systems.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively with rural communities and vulnerable households.

Strong facilitation, coaching, and community mobilization skills.

Good communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Strong organizational, planning, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

Good analytical and field-level monitoring skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Fluency in Kinyarwanda is required; good working knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

A valid Category A driving license (motorcycle) is required, as the position involves regular field travel to rural communities and participant households.

Willingness and ability to work extensively in the field and travel within Gisagara District.

C. Gender and Inclusion

Female candidates are particularly encouraged to apply and will be given additional consideration.

About FXB Rwanda

FXB Rwanda is a registered Rwandan Local Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) rooted in Rwanda since 1995, and a member of FXB Global, carrying the legacy of François-Xavier Bagnoud into its fourth decade — across all four provinces and the City of Kigali.

FXB Rwanda implements integrated development programs aimed at reducing poverty and vulnerability and promoting sustainable livelihoods, food and nutrition security, health, education, WASH, and economic empowerment.

FXB Rwanda is currently seeking to recruit a qualified, motivated, and experienced Agronomist to assist the implementation of the FXBVillage Project in Gisagara District.

Position Information

Job Title: Agronomist

Project: FXBVillage Project

Duty Station: Gisagara District, Rwanda

Reports to: Program Coordinator

Employment Type: Fixed-term contract – 12 months, renewable subject to performance

Expected Start Date: October 2026

Project Background

The FXBVillage program uses a holistic approach designed to addresses the multiple interconnected dimensions of poverty, including health, education, and income generation, to help the most vulnerable families become self-sufficient and graduate out of extreme poverty within a three-year period. From October 2026, FXB Rwanda will start the implementation of the FXBVillage project in Kansi and Kibirizi sectors of Gisagara District in the Southern Province of Rwanda.

Job Purpose

The Agronomist will deliver technical guidance and hands-on assist to FXBVillage participant households to enhance agricultural productivity, food and nutrition security, household income, and resilience to climate change.

The position will assist participants to adopt regenerative and climate-resilient agricultural practices, enhance soil health, increase crop productivity and quality, strengthen sustainable farming systems, and link farmers to appropriate markets.

Low-tech solutions and regenerative agriculture practices will be implemented through two complementary levels of Climate-Resilient and Regenerative Agriculture Hubs (CRRAHs). Community CRRAHs will serve as collective learningand demonstration spaces incorporating agroforestry, fruit trees, composting, organic fertilizers, local food preservation techniques, rainwater harvesting, as well as the promotion, propagation, and conservation of local seeds adapted to the agroecological realities of the project areas.

The successful candidate will work closely with participant households, community structures, local authorities, and other agricultural stakeholders to make sure that project-supported agricultural interventions are effectively implemented and generate sustainable results.

A. Key Duties and Responsibilities

1. Agricultural Technical assist and Extension

  • deliver technical guidance and practical coaching to participant households on crop production and sustainable agricultural practices.
  • Train farmers on appropriate crop selection, seasonal planning, land preparation, planting, crop management, harvesting, post-harvest handling, and storage.
  • Promote the adoption of regenerative and climate-resilient agriculture practices, including soil fertility management, erosion control, water conservation, crop diversification, mulching, composting, agroecological practices, and other appropriate techniques.
  • assist farmers to enhance soil health, productivity, and the sustainable use of available land and natural resources.
  • perform regular field visits throughout the agricultural cycle, from land preparation and planting through harvesting, to deliver timely technical advice.
  • detect agricultural challenges affecting participant households and deliver appropriate technical solutions.

2. Farmer Training and Demonstration

  • Contribute to the design and adaptation of agriculture related training manuals.
  • Design and facilitate practical agricultural training sessions for participant households .
  • Establish and facilitate Climate-Resilient and Regenerative Agriculture Hubs (CRRAHs) and practical demonstration plots where appropriate.
  • Facilitate farmer-led experimentation and learning to detect locally appropriate and effective agricultural practices.
  • Promote peer-to-peer learning and knowledge sharing among participant farmers.
  • assist farmers to apply improved technologies, including Water Harvesting techniques and farming practices demonstrated through the project.

3. Agricultural Productivity and Food Security

  • assist participant households to increase crop productivity, enhance the quality of agricultural produce, and strengthen household food security.
  • Promote diversified agricultural production to enhance household nutrition and resilience.
  • Advise farmers on efficient and sustainable use of agricultural inputs and resources.
  • assist participants to create practical agricultural production plans aligned with local seasons, market opportunities, and household priorities.

4. Market Linkages and Income Generation

  • Facilitate linkages between farmers, cooperatives, buyers, local markets, and other relevant value-chain actors.
  • deliver guidance on post-harvest handling, quality improvement, aggregation, and value addition.
  • detect opportunities for participants to strengthen agriculture-based income-generating activities.

5. Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with Sector and District agricultural officers and agronomists in the planning and implementation of project agricultural activities.
  • keep effective collaboration with local authorities, farmer groups, cooperatives, extension workers, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Participate in relevant agricultural meetings, workshops, trainings, and coordination forums on behalf of FXB Rwanda, as assigned.
  • Ensure effective coordination between agricultural interventions and other components of the FXBVillage Project.

B. Required Qualifications and Competencies

1. Education and Professional Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Agriculture, Crop Production, Agricultural Sciences, or another closely related field.
  • At least three (3) years of relevant professional experience in agronomy, agricultural extension, crop production. Working with smallholder farmers and rural communities will be an added advantage.
  • Demonstrated practical experience in regenerative agriculture, climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable land management, or agroecological practices is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with NGOs, community-based programs, or development projects will be an added advantage.
  • Experience facilitating farmer training, demonstration plots, farmer learning groups, or similar community-based agricultural approaches is an advantage.

2. Technical and Personal Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of regenerative and climate-resilient agriculture practices.
  • Practical understanding of crop production and smallholder farming systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with rural communities and vulnerable households.
  • Strong facilitation, coaching, and community mobilization skills.
  • Good communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong organizational, planning, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

  • Fluency in Kinyarwanda is required; good working knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.
  • A valid Category A driving license (motorcycle) is required, as the position involves regular field travel to rural communities and participant households.

item.title: Project Facilitator job at FXB Rwanda
item.description_html:
About FXB Rwanda

FXB Rwanda is a registered Rwandan Local Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) rooted in Rwanda since 1995, and a member of FXB Global, carrying the legacy of François-Xavier Bagnoud into its fourth decade — across all four provinces and the City of Kigali.

FXB Rwanda implements integrated development programs aimed at reducing poverty and vulnerability and promoting sustainable livelihoods, food and nutrition security, health, education, WASH, and economic empowerment.

FXB Rwanda is currently seeking to recruit three (3) qualified, motivated, and experienced Project Facilitators to assist the implementation of the FXBVillage Project in Gisagara District.

Project Background

The FXBVillage program uses a holistic approach designed to addresses the multiple interconnected dimensions of poverty, including health, education, and income generation, to help the most vulnerable families become self-sufficient and graduate out of extreme poverty within a three-year period. From October 2026, FXB Rwanda will start the implementation of the FXBVillage project in Kansi and Kibirizi sectors of Gisagara District in the Southern Province of Rwanda.

A. Scope of Work

Under the direct supervision of the Unit Manager, the Project Facilitator is tasked with the day-to-day planning, coordination, and implementation of field-based project activities within the assigned FXBVillage. S/he serves as the primary field-level link between the project and participant households, providing direct technical assist, coaching, guidance, and other project interventions to participants.

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Plan and organize the implementation and delivery of project services in the areas of Economic Strengthening, Education, WASH, Health, Nutrition, and Psycho-Social assist, ensuring that interventions create sustainable, long-lasting impact and empower participants to remain self-reliant beyond the project’s phase-out;
  • keep and regularly update the participants’ database to ensure accuracy, completeness, and accessibility of information;
  • Ensure assigned project community coaches, participants and stakeholders are trained on program key interventions including Economic empowerment, Education, Child rights, Health, Nutrition, HIV Prevention, Psychosocial assist, WASH environment and housing;
  • produce concept notes and budgets of activities concerned in the components of Economic Strengthening, Education, Social, Health, Nutrition, Psychosocial assist and HIV Prevention;
  • Ensure and contribute to the quality of service delivery to all stakeholders, timely submission of high quality reports, proper documentation and filing;
  • Participate in daily monitoring and evaluation of the project activities;
  • Ensure all supported children in education have necessary school materials, school uniform, school fees, perform well, remain in and complete schools;
  • Plan, produce, and deliver training sessions for participants on key topics such as family planning, sexual and reproductive health, HIV prevention, hygiene, nutrition, economic strengthening, education, and child rights;
  • perform home visits to program participants in order to assist and follow up program activities; and offer psychosocial assist to the participants when a need arises;
  • Representing FXB Rwanda in the area of attachment;
  • Ensure whether program participants have adequate materials for Hygiene and WASH and verify whether they follow WASH and Hygiene principles;
  • deliver regularly reports on the program’s activities in assigned area of implementation and contribute to developing donor reports;
  • Perform any other duties/ responsibilities assigned by the supervisor.

B. Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Nursing, Clinical Psychology, healthcare, or other related fields;
  • Proven experience in projects implementation serving vulnerable populations (at least three years); and at least 2 years of experience in a similar field-based position;
  • Skilled with preparing and presenting impact-based activity concept notes and reports;
  • Experience in providing psychosocial assist interventions and/or nursing is an added value;
  • Relevant experience in working with local leaders;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, French and Kinyarwanda;
  • Proficient in MS office and Outlook;
  • Management skills and abilities to team work;
  • Ready to live in the working place and willingness to work in rural area;
  • Category A (motorcycle) driving license is required.

item.title: Applications Specialist job at Hope International
item.description:
About HOPE International

At HOPE International, we invest in the dreams of families in the world’s underserved communities as we proclaim and live the Gospel.

About This Opportunity

The position of Applications Specialist at HOPE International located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The applications specialist will have responsibility for ensuring the effective deployment and assist of Temenos T24 and other banking applications in HOPE’s network of microfinance institutions and banks. This is accomplished through enhancing the parameterization of T24 to assist the needs of management teams, assisting in new system deployments, fixing problems as they arise, and training and equipping country level staff.

RESPONSIBILITIES

System Development & Implementation

Utilize expertise in T24 to help with the configuration and parameterization of T24 in new deployments so as to maximize effectiveness of the system and make sure that appropriate functionality is utilized

create, enhance, and customize T24 AA modules, products, and lifecycle events

Work on AA Contracts, AA Components, L3 customizations, and COB activities

help with development and implementation of both in-house and third-party core banking software integrations to T24

Recommend improvements to existing T24 technical and business processes in order to ensure the effective fulfillment of functional requirements

Equip Country-Level T24 assist Staff

deliver training, advice and mentoring to country-level T24 assist staff

Approach each problem with an attitude of service and take every reasonable opportunity to turn projects into teaching moments

deliver Effective Second Level assist

Respond in a timely fashion to the real-time assist needs of programs, resolving problems and minimizing disruption to banking services

deliver proactive mitigation of potential problems by identifying system risks and reconfiguring T24 to prevent either system malfunction or a mismatch of system capabilities with program needs

Learn and assist integrated digital financial applications such as mobile payment products and web-based T24 front ends

deliver technical assistance and assist for incoming queries and issues related to core-banking systems and other systems used by HOPE-led financial institutions.

Center of Excellence

keep expertise in recent releases of T24 MCB so as to serve the HOPE Network as a center of excellence for T24 best practices and functionality

Other

Perform other technical assistance functions as necessary, including responding to information requests from other departments

QUALIFICATIONS

Personal confession of Christian faith and commitment to the mission and vision of HOPE International.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field;

5-10 years of experience supporting T24 in commercial or microfinance banks, with specific experience with T24 AA required

Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines

Excellent project management skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Ability to perform comparative analysis and produce recommendations for presentation to senior leadership

Cross-cultural intelligence and communication skills

Experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Suite products

Fluent in English

Proficiency in French preferred

Extended cross-cultural living experience preferred

item.title: Digital Project Manager job at World Vision
item.description:
VisionFund Rwanda (VFR), is Rwanda’s largest microfinance Institution. VFR is committed to the development of Rwanda through providing affordable financial services (savings and loans) to the less privileged throughout its 4 zones in Rwanda.

VFR is the institution where you can develop your expertise working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused high performance environment. If you are looking for interesting but challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, then VFR has the will to make it so.

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR) has zero tolerance to abuse and sexual exploitation of children and adults beneficiaries. We expect all our employees/affiliates to commit to protecting children and adult beneficiaries from harm and abide by our safeguarding policy.

JOB SUMMARY

The establishment of the digital project manager function is to drive delivery of digitalization initiatives and maximize benefits of digital solutions within Vision Fund Rwanda and by extension aid in achieving Vision Funds’ International digitalization strategy.

The Digital Project Manager (DPM), as an independent and focused role, will oversee the portfolio of identified digitalization projects with the main focus of driving paperless and cashless expectations. The person is to manage the digital projects life cycle from pre-project to closure.

Responsibilities or duties

Key responsibilities and weighting (adds to 100%)

(20%) VFR digital strategy and innovation

In charge of VFR digital strategy and road map

Work with SLT to map out the VFR digital strategy road map and plan for its evolution

Lead VFR digital innovation - identify areas of improvements, give and seek ideas on process improvement and follow through their implementation

Ensure that digitization translates to real benefits to VFR and its clients

(30%) Digital project management

Planning, Organizing, Monitoring and control of project deliverables.

Leading and coordinating all project implementation activities while adhering to specifications, and time and cost estimates.

Project Documentation: Business case, Functional specification documents, Project plans (on smart sheets), Project Contracts, Business Process Documentation, updating of SOPS and policies relating to digital changes, training manuals, STC minutes, Post implementation reports.

(25%) Change management

Ensures VFR staff are ready for change. Communicates the urgency to go digital across all our operations by year 2030. Breaks down the why, how and when of the digital strategy.

Ensures all internal and external customers are well trained and have what they need for a successful roll out.

Ensure that users properly test the digital solutions to ensure it meets business acceptance criteria for deployment.

In charge of the go to market strategy: Ensures successful roll out of digital solutions across VFR and to customers.

(20%) Digital projects reporting

Track and communicate project status to stakeholders (CEO, COO/HOIT and Regional Project Manager) on a weekly basis. Reporting progress to the VFR project STC.

Manage digital project issue risks during all project phases, flag escalate blockages and seek solutions in collaboration with all stakeholders.

Track digital projects expenditure and share the quarterly spend with relevant stakeholders.

Track digital projects KPIs post go live and ensure the business achieves the benefits highlighted in the business case.

Carry out project post implementation review 6 months after go live - document lessons and recommend enhancements.

(5%) Spirituality

Supportive and exemplifying role model that upholds Christian Values and Principles. Regularly attend the staff spiritual and nurture activities.

Maintain a positive working relationship with all staff, provide clear written and verbal communication and acquire and develop professional skills that benefit VisionFund.

Qualifications or requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business or IT or in a field relevant to project management.

Good communication and presentation skills; fluency in English is an advantage

Experience needed

Three years’ experience managing complex software implementations (preferably financial systems)

Three years of general project management experience across multiple functions.

Proven ability to self-manage and use conventional project management tools and techniques.

Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications

Preferable Project management certifications in PMP, PRINCE, Business Analysis or Six Sigma

Recent technical training on Project management.

Determined personality with initiative, perseverance and the ability to motivate and manage a team.

Capability and willingness to take responsibility and highly developed sense of rectitude

Ready to comply and live up to and in accordance with the organization Ideals and Core Values,

Be proficient in Microsoft office applications,

Good knowledge in economic and financial topics,

Be a good trainer, facilitator, mentor, and coach

Very good communication and marketing skills

A mature, committed Christian

Working Environment / Conditions:

Office environment: typical office based 60% and field 40%

Travel: 80% Domestic/ 20% international travel is required.

On call: (in the after normal working hours)

Our offer

VisionFund Rwanda is willing to offer you a competitive salary, challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, develop your expertise by working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused and high performing environment

  • (20%) VFR digital strategy and innovation
    • In charge of VFR digital strategy and road map
    • Work with SLT to map out the VFR digital strategy road map and plan for its evolution
    • Lead VFR digital innovation - identify areas of improvements, give and seek ideas on process improvement and follow through their implementation
    • Ensure that digitization translates to real benefits to VFR and its clients
  • (30%) Digital project management
    • Planning, Organizing, Monitoring and control of project deliverables.
    • Leading and coordinating all project implementation activities while adhering to specifications, and time and cost estimates.
    • Project Documentation: Business case, Functional specification documents, Project plans (on smart sheets), Project Contracts, Business Process Documentation, updating of SOPS and policies relating to digital changes, training manuals, STC minutes, Post implementation reports.
  • (25%) Change management
    • Ensures VFR staff are ready for change. Communicates the urgency to go digital across all our operations by year 2030. Breaks down the why, how and when of the digital strategy.
    • Ensures all internal and external customers are well trained and have what they need for a successful roll out.
    • Ensure that users properly test the digital solutions to ensure it meets business acceptance criteria for deployment.
    • In charge of the go to market strategy: Ensures successful roll out of digital solutions across VFR and to customers.
  • (20%) Digital projects reporting
    • Track and communicate project status to stakeholders (CEO, COO/HOIT and Regional Project Manager) on a weekly basis. Reporting progress to the VFR project STC.
    • Manage digital project issue risks during all project phases, flag escalate blockages and seek solutions in collaboration with all stakeholders.
    • Track digital projects expenditure and share the quarterly spend with relevant stakeholders.
    • Track digital projects KPIs post go live and ensure the business achieves the benefits highlighted in the business case.
    • Carry out project post implementation review 6 months after go live - document lessons and recommend enhancements.
  • (5%) Spirituality
    • Supportive and exemplifying role model that upholds Christian Values and Principles. Regularly attend the staff spiritual and nurture activities.
    • Maintain a positive working relationship with all staff, provide clear written and verbal communication and acquire and develop professional skills that benefit VisionFund.

Qualifications or requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business or IT or in a field relevant to project management.

Good communication and presentation skills; fluency in English is an advantage

Experience needed

  • Three years’ experience managing complex software implementations (preferably financial systems)
  • Three years of general project management experience across multiple functions.
  • Proven ability to self-manage and use conventional project management tools and techniques.

Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Preferable Project management certifications in PMP, PRINCE, Business Analysis or Six Sigma
  • Recent technical training on Project management.
  • Determined personality with initiative, perseverance and the ability to motivate and manage a team.
  • Capability and willingness to take responsibility and highly developed sense of rectitude
  • Ready to comply and live up to and in accordance with the organization Ideals and Core Values,
  • Be proficient in Microsoft office applications,
  • Good knowledge in economic and financial topics,
  • Be a good trainer, facilitator, mentor, and coach
  • Very good communication and marketing skills
  • A mature, committed Christian

Working Environment / Conditions:

  • Office environment: typical office based 60% and field 40%
  • Travel: 80% Domestic/ 20% international travel is required.
  • On call: (in the after normal working hours)

VisionFund Rwanda is willing to offer you a competitive salary, challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, develop your expertise by working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused and high performing environment

item.title: Request for Proposal for Provision of External Financial Audit Services tender at easyHATCH Ltd
item.description_html:
Request for Proposal for Provision of External Financial Audit Services Tender at easyHATCH Ltd

easyHATCH Ltd is a poultry hatchery and breeder operation based in Musanze District, Rwanda, operating breeder rearing and laying farms, a hatchery, and associated commercial functions. The Company is inviting proposals from eligible, appropriately licensed audit firms to provide external (statutory) financial audit services for the Company's financial statements.

This Request for Proposal (RFP) sets out the background, scope of services required, eligibility criteria, submission requirements, and evaluation process. Firms wishing to be considered must respond fully to this RFP in accordance with the instructions in Clause 8.

2. PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES OF THE AUDIT

The Company requires an independent external auditor to:

(a) express an independent opinion on whether the Company's annual financial statements give a true and fair view of its financial position and performance, in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and the Rwandan Companies Law N° 007/2021 of 05/02/2021, as amended;

(b) conduct the audit in accordance with International Standards on Auditing (ISA);

(c)provide a management letter identifying any control weakness, accounting irregularity, or recommendation for improvement arising from the audit, addressed to the Board and management;

(d) support the Company's statutory and tax compliance obligations by providing financial statements certified in a form acceptable to the Rwanda Revenue Authority; and

(e) provide the Board with a clear, evidence-based, and independently formed view of the Company's financial reporting, free of any conflict of interest.
