item.title: IT Internal Auditor job at VisionFund
item.description:
About Vision Fund Rwanda

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR) is one of the largest deposit-taking Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) in Rwanda with a mission to provide financial and non-financial services to underprivileged rural communit...

Who May Be Interested

Technology professionals including IT specialists, software developers, and technical support staff may find this position relevant.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of IT Internal Auditor based in Kigali, Rwanda. Applicants with strong technical expertise and problem-solving abilities are encouraged to apply.

About This Opportunity

The position of IT Internal Auditor at Vision Fund Rwanda located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

Common Skills Required

Communication

Management

Data analysis

Excel

Audit

Planning

Negotiation

Administration

JOB ADVERTISEMENT

‘’Make a difference to thousands in the land of a thousand hills’’

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR), is Rwanda’s largest microfinance Institution. VFR is committed to the development of Rwanda through providing affordable financial services (savings and loans) to the less privileged throughout its 4 zones in Rwanda.

VFR is the institution where you can create your expertise working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused high performance environment. If you are looking for interesting but challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, then VFR has the will to make it so.

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR) has zero tolerance to abuse and sexual exploitation of children and adults beneficiaries. We expect all our employees/affiliates to commit to protecting children and adult beneficiaries from harm and abide by our safeguarding policy.

IT Internal Auditor

Reporting to Internal Auditor Manager

Work location: Head Office/Nyarutarama

Job Purpose

The IT Internal Auditor is tasked with planning and conducting information technology audits and reviews to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of IT governance, risk management, and internal controls. The position evaluates the organization's IT systems, applications, processes, policies, cybersecurity, and information security practices to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry standards.

The role provides independent and objective assurance and advisory assist to management on IT-related risks and controls, identifies control weaknesses, and recommends practical improvements to strengthen the overall control environment.

Main Responsibilities

Contribute to the development and implementation of the Annual Internal Audit Plan, applying a risk-based approach to detect and prioritize IT audit areas.

track emerging IT risks, technology developments, cybersecurity threats, regulatory requirements, and industry trends that may impact the VFR's risk and control environment.

Plan and execute assigned IT audit engagements in accordance with approved audit programs, agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

Assess IT governance, risk management, and internal controls and deliver management with practical recommendations for strengthening IT risk management and the control environment.

perform and, where assigned, guide IT audits and reviews covering areas including:

IT General Controls;

Information and Cybersecurity;

IT Governance and IT Risk Management;

Systems and application reviews;

Access and user administration;

Backup and disaster recovery/business continuity;

IT projects and Project Assurance;

IT policies, procedures, standards, and frameworks;

Third-party/vendor technology risk.

Utilize data analytics, and technology-enabled audit techniques to enhance the efficiency, effectiveness, and coverage of IT audit activities.

produce and keep complete and well-organized audit working papers, documenting the audit process from planning through fieldwork, conclusion, and reporting in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and quality standards.

Perform timely validation and follow-up of management's implementation of agreed audit actions, and deliver accurate issue tracking and status reporting.

track and communicate emerging IT risks, recurring control weaknesses, process inefficiencies, and potential solutions to management and the Internal Audit Manager.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, quality assurance standards, audit programs, templates, tools, and data analytics techniques, particularly for IT audit assignments.

keep awareness of applicable laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, internal policies, and recognized IT and cybersecurity frameworks relevant to the organization's operations.

Collaborate effectively with Internal Audit team and key stakeholders, including IT, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and other business functions, while maintaining appropriate independence and professional objectivity.

deliver advisory input on IT-related initiatives, systems, projects, and process changes, where requested, without assuming management responsibility or compromising Internal Audit independence.

assist the Internal Audit Manager in preparing audit reports, management updates, committee reporting, and other Internal Audit deliverables related to IT risk and control matters.

keep professional competence and continuously create IT audit, cybersecurity, data analytics, risk management, and regulatory knowledge to remain current with evolving technology and emerging risks.

Perform any other duties related to Internal Audit and IT risk and control assurance as assigned by the Internal Audit Manager.

Education & Core Competencies Required

Degree in Computer Science or related discipline.

Certified Information System Auditor (CISA) or Pursuing CISA.

Additional Certification e.g. CISM, CRISC an added advantage.

At least 3 years’ experience in information System Audit.

Strong analytic skills. Ability to perform analysis of Business processes and operations and to think strategically using financial analysis.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

Ability to present financial information effectively to both specialists and non-specialists.

Understanding of financial and banking software packages, preferably familiarity with Orbit Rubikon Banking Solution.

Knowledge of micro, small and medium enterprise Market segments in Rwanda

Attributes Desired:

Understanding of Banking System Enterprises Resources Planners (ERPS) Operating System and Database.

Data Analysis skill include ability to use data analysis took to perform test detect trends deliver insight interpret and communicate results.

Understanding of information Security standard took and best practices.

Understand of IT Governance and IT Audit fundamentals.

Knowledge of internal auditing internal control risk management and corporate governance.

Ability to write reports.

keep Professional understanding internal Audit International Professional Practice and consistently apply them to enhance the audit methodology and deliverable.

item.title: Finance Clerk job at Salvo Grima Ltd
item.description:
About Salvo Grima Group

Salvo Grima Group is a dynamic group of companies specializing in distribution, ship supply, retail and wholesale. Established in 1860 in Malta, Europe, and now employs over 500 in eight countries, is seeking a talented Finance Clerk to join our growing Finance Team.

About the Role

The selected candidate will be based in our offices in Kigali where one of our subsidiaries, Salvo Grima Rwanda Ltd (SGR), was established in 2020. Today, SGR employs over 100 team members. SGR is a distribution company and represents a growing number of world-leading manufacturers including Prohealth, Unilever, Danone, British American Tobacco, Kellogg’s, SC Johnson, Mondelez International, KimFay and Mars Wrigley.

The Finance Clerk will be under the responsibility of The Senior Accountant. He/She will report directly to the “Payables & Cost Accountant”. He/She will also work closely with all other departments of the company, most notably the finance department.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

More specifically, the “Finance Clerk” shall be tasked with:

Daily reconciliation of DSR sales, returns and payment received

Record sales invoice and payment in ERP

Verifying all purchase orders/requisitions, incoming statements, invoices, and expense claims for authentication in conjunction with appropriate personnel prior to petty cash disbursements.

Raising Export Invoice and Proforma

Posting bank transactions

Maintaining and properly recording petty cash transactions and updating prices in Navision

Receive clients cheques and ensure their timely banking

Uploading transactions onto RRA dedicated portal for non-EBM supported expenses incurred

Ensuring that all supplier invoices and payment proofs are properly kept on file for further reference

Assisting in the month-end closing procedure in finance department, especially in areas that are directly linked to his/her scope of activities

Demonstrating good understanding of the chart of accounts in Navision

Ensuring that financial transactions to be recorded comply with company policies and procedures

Participating in professional development training towards increased competence to align theory and practice

Any other duties that may be assigned by the supervisor

ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance or accounting roles.

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration.

Relevant professional qualification/ certification would be an added advantage.

Fluency in Microsoft Word and Excel. Knowledge of accounting software is an added value.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Kinyarwanda required.

Excellent organizational skills.

Demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all levels of staff.

Extensive knowledge of Financial Reporting Standards and Rwandan Tax law.

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities and deadlines.
item.description_text:
About Salvo Grima Group

Salvo Grima Group is a dynamic group of companies specializing in distribution, ship supply, retail and wholesale. Established in 1860 in Malta, Europe, and now employs over 500 in eight countries, is seeking a talented Finance Clerk to join our growing Finance Team.

About the Role

The selected candidate will be based in our offices in Kigali where one of our subsidiaries, Salvo Grima Rwanda Ltd (SGR), was established in 2020. Today, SGR employs over 100 team members. SGR is a distribution company and represents a growing number of world-leading manufacturers including Prohealth, Unilever, Danone, British American Tobacco, Kellogg’s, SC Johnson, Mondelez International, KimFay and Mars Wrigley.

The Finance Clerk will be under the responsibility of The Senior Accountant. He/She will report directly to the “Payables & Cost Accountant”. He/She will also work closely with all other departments of the company, most notably the finance department.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

More specifically, the “Finance Clerk” shall be tasked with:

Daily reconciliation of DSR sales, returns and payment received

Record sales invoice and payment in ERP

Verifying all purchase orders/requisitions, incoming statements, invoices, and expense claims for authentication in conjunction with appropriate personnel prior to petty cash disbursements.

Raising Export Invoice and Proforma

Posting bank transactions

Maintaining and properly recording petty cash transactions and updating prices in Navision

Receive clients cheques and ensure their timely banking

Uploading transactions onto RRA dedicated portal for non-EBM supported expenses incurred

Ensuring that all supplier invoices and payment proofs are properly kept on file for further reference

Assisting in the month-end closing procedure in finance department, especially in areas that are directly linked to his/her scope of activities

Demonstrating good understanding of the chart of accounts in Navision

Ensuring that financial transactions to be recorded comply with company policies and procedures

Participating in professional development training towards increased competence to align theory and practice

Any other duties that may be assigned by the supervisor

ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance or accounting roles.

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration.

Relevant professional qualification/ certification would be an added advantage.

Fluency in Microsoft Word and Excel. Knowledge of accounting software is an added value.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Kinyarwanda required.

Excellent organizational skills.

Demonstrate the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all levels of staff.

Extensive knowledge of Financial Reporting Standards and Rwandan Tax law.

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities and deadlines.

item.title: Clinical Doctor job at GAMICO Ltd
item.description_html:
About GAMICO Ltd

GAMICO Ltd is a mining company operating the Bashyamba tin mine, one of the largest tin producers in Rwanda, situated in Kigali Sector, Nyarugenge District. GAMICO has been in existence for about 10 y...

Who May Be Interested

Professionals seeking career advancement and individuals with relevant qualifications may be interested in this opportunity.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Clinical Doctor based in Kigali, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Clinical Doctor at GAMICO Ltd located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

GAMICO LTD

JOB VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Position: Clinical Doctor — GAMICO Clinic

GAMICO Ltd, a mining company currently operating the Bashyamba Mine located in Kigali Sector, Nyarugenge District; is seeking to recruit a qualified and motivated Medical Doctor to join its occupational health team at the GAMICO Clinic. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinical care to staff and strengthening occupational health surveillance across our mining operations.

Position Summary

Job Title Medical Doctor

Department SHEC

Reports To SHEC Manager

Duty Station GAMICO Mine Site,

Number of Positions 1 (One)

Contract Type Full-time, subject to probation

Application Deadline 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • deliver outpatient consultation, diagnosis, and treatment services to GAMICO staff and, where applicable, the surrounding mining community;
  • perform pre-employment, periodic, and exit medical examinations for mine workers, including screening for occupational health risks such as silicosis and other dust-related conditions;
  • Oversee occupational health surveillance, including referral and follow-up for chest X-ray/spirometry findings;
  • keep accurate, confidential medical records and occupational injury/illness registers;
  • Respond to workplace medical emergencies and organize referrals to external health facilities;
  • Advise management on occupational health matters, including PPE adequacy and recommendations from health surveillance data;
  • Supervise clinic assist staff (nurses, clinical officers, lab technicians) as applicable;
  • Ensure compliance with Rwanda Ministry of Health regulations and occupational health and safety standards.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Medicine (MBBS/MD) from a recognized institution;
  • Valid registration/license with the Rwanda Medical and Dental Council;
  • At least five (5) years of clinical experience; experience in occupational health, mining, or industrial settings is an added advantage;
  • Knowledge of, or willingness to be trained in, occupational lung disease screening (e.g., silicosis, pneumoconiosis);
  • Strong communication, record-keeping, and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/mine-site setting;
  • Fluency in Kinyarwanda and English; French and/or Swahili is an advantage.

item.title: Billing and Collection Agent job at Echowa Ltd
item.description:
About Echowa Ltd

ECHOWA Ltd is a Kigali-based company specializing in outsourcing professional services for international partners. We provide a range of expertise in...

About This Opportunity

The position of Agent De Facturation Et De Recouvrement at Echowa Ltd located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

JOB OFFER NO. 012/Echowa/2026

Compagnie : Echowa Ltd

Location: Kigali, Rwanda

Position: Billing and Collections Agent

Contract Type: Permanent (with a one-month probationary period)

Company presentation

ECHOWA Ltd is a Kigali-based company specializing in outsourcing professional services to international partners. We provide a range of skills in IT, design, accounting, administrative management, and more, for foreign companies seeking efficiency and quality.

Job Description

As part of our growth, we are recruiting a Billing and Customer Collections Officer to strengthen our teams.

You are responsible for customer invoicing and payment tracking, and actively contribute to the sound management of our cash flow. You ensure rigorous monitoring of receivables and maintain professional contact with our clients to guarantee timely payments.

This varied role combines administrative work, analysis, and direct contact with clients.

Responsibilities and job description

Billing

Prepare customer invoices in accordance with contracts and services rendered

Verify the accuracy of the billing information

Ensure the administrative follow-up of invoices

Manage any corrections and credit notes

Payment tracking

Track customer deadlines and payments

Ensure payment reconciliation

Identify and analyze overdue invoices

Customer debt collection

Follow up with clients by phone and email

Maintain a professional and constructive relationship with clients

Follow up on cases until they are resolved

Ensuring the follow-up and collection of customer receivables, including frequent travel to Luxembourgish clients for direct contact

Monitoring and improvement

Maintain rigorous monitoring of customer receivables

Participate in improving billing and collection processes

Collaborating with internal teams to resolve any potential disputes

Qualifications / abilities

Proficiency in one or more CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or equivalent).

Good command of office tools: Excel, Google Sheets, Word.

Ability to analyze and interpret business data.

Basic knowledge of digital marketing and sales prospecting.

Excellent organization and rigor in database management.

Autonomy and good time management while working remotely.

Personal qualities

Analytical mind and attention to detail.

Good written and oral communication skills in French.

Sense of service and customer focus.

Proactivity and team spirit.

Ability to quickly learn new digital tools.

Languages ​​required

French: fluent (written and spoken).

English: Fluent (written and spoken). An asset.

Candidature

Documents to send: CV with references, cover letter in French, certificates of experience (preferred), copy of identity document

Please note: this offer is exclusively for candidates who meet all the criteria mentioned above.

For foreign applicants, please ensure that all your administrative documents are in order, valid and up to date, including: visa, work permit, passport and any other document required to legally carry out professional activity in the country concerned.

Number of Positions: 3

Employment Type: Full-time

Reporting To: Branch Business Manager

Academic Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, Management, Accounting or Finance

Experience Requirements:Minimum three (3) years in SACCOs or microfinance.

Key Responsibilities: Ensures the attainment of sales goals to overseeing everyone provides excellent members/customer service; Supports the Branch Business Manager in developing a local market sales plan and reaching the branches sales targets

item.title: Safety, Security and Safeguarding Coordinator job at Save the Children
item.description:
The post- holder will be working closely with the Regional Security Director (RSD) in carrying out safety and security assessments; make recommendations and provide support for their implementation by Country Office. She/ He will facilitate the implementation of Save the Children’s Safety and Security Policy and Standards within country programs and help drive systemic change in the quality of safety and security management. Also, to contribute to building country compliance with safety and security Minimum Standards.

CHILD SAFEGUARDING: 

Level 3:  the role holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work in country programs; or are visiting country programs; ore because they are responsible for implementing the police checking/vetting process staff.

Anti-Fraud and Integrity Commitment: 

The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward fraud, corruption, and unethical behavior. All staff are expected to uphold the highest standards of integrity and accountability, comply with internal policies and procedures, and report any suspected misconduct through the appropriate channels.
Please note: The organization does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process (application, interview, offer, or onboarding). Any request for payment should be reported immediately.

SCOPE OF ROLE:

Reports to: Operations Director 

Dotted Line Manager: Director of HR, Admin and IT

Staff directly reporting to this post: - None, but directly in charge of Field Focal Point Persons

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

Child Safeguarding Leader and Champion across Rwanda and Burindi offices

Work with programme development and programme operations teams to identify potential risks to children in all project’s activities including workshops and events, plan mitigating measures, and assign staff to be responsible for the implementation.

Undertake clear, strong advocacy in line with the Safeguarding Policies at National levels. 

Deliver high quality, accessible and reliable support, guidance and capacity to emergency/humanitarian response and programmes team 

Establish Country safeguarding networks to champion local implementation

Work with CP colleagues to ensure that a mapping of service providers for children is completed in Save the Children’s operational areas and local procedures are developed/up to date

Coach and support Field Focal Points in order to improve Safeguarding practice. 

Safe programming and Safeguarding Practice promoted across Rwanda and Burundi offices 

Work with programme development team and other programme staff to ensure that all programming is designed, implemented and monitored through a Safeguarding lens, including supporting all new proposals

Ensure that support for safeguarding is adequately resourced in all new project budgets

Support staff to take proactive steps to ensure that all programming activity identifies the potential risks and works to eliminate and mitigate those risks.

Ensure that the tools and knowledge are made available to managers and that they know how to access support and guidance

Role model high levels of professional safeguarding behaviour and maintain the standards required by the Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct 

Country roll-out and maintenance of training programmes 

Deliver a suite of mandatory core training workshops so as to enable staff with key responsibilities to undertake their roles and mainstream safeguarding functions

Deliver on-going refresher training and safeguarding inductions as appropriate 

Review and strengthen Safeguarding systems within the country office, planning, and delivering training programs accordingly. 

Identify Safeguarding issues within Save the Children operational areas and develop a plan to respond to them in collaboration with other internal and external partners

Deploy resources of the Keeping Children Safe strategically to ensure that the country office, its partners and all representatives maintain Save the Children safeguarding standards.

Capacity Building

Develop capacity building plan for staff and partners and provide on-going mentoring and support 

Serve as safeguarding lead focal point for the field office and lead on establishment of strong safeguarding procedures and risk assessment in all programme activities in accordance with the national strategies developed

Build the capacity of Safeguarding Focal points to deliver safeguarding trainings, manage & undertake investigation

item.title: Advisor E-Mobility Development Partnership with the Private Sector job at GIZ Rwanda
item.description:
A. Background

The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH is a federally owned international cooperation enterprise for sustainable development with worldwide operations. The GIZ Office in Kigali covers GIZ’s portfolio in Rwanda and Burundi. GIZ Rwanda/Burundi implements projects on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development, the European Union and other commissioning authorities in the following priority areas: Sustainable Economic Development; Good Governance; Climate, Energy and Sustainable Urban Development; Digital Transformation and Digital Economy; and regional projects in the Great Lakes Region.

Rwanda is positioning itself as a regional leader in sustainable mobility, with government policy actively driving a shift away from fossil-fuel vehicles. The country's technical and vocational training system must address the new areas to provide skills for local technicians to maintain EVs: EV technology, battery diagnostics, or high-voltage safety - technical careers on emerging green jobs. Targeted vocational training would close the EV skills gap, improve employment prospects for Rwandan graduates, and create the technical foundation for Rwanda's e-mobility ambition.

B. Main Tasks and Responsibilities

Technical leadership for the joint implementation of the e-mobility develoPPP project in Rwanda including:

Budget and expenditure planning,

Project and contract management

Joint project management with the project partner

Stakeholder relations with project and technical partners, risk and conflict management

Technical and financial monitoring of the project and regular reporting to the local GIZ team and develoPPP headquarters team.

C. Required Qualifications, Competences and Experience

1. Qualifications and professional experience

Master’s degree in business administration, Economics, International Development, Political Science, Social Science or other related field.

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in relevant thematic areas of the project, such as private sector development, TVET and related areas

In-depth experience of working with or within the private sector management level

Knowledge of skills development concepts and instruments, Train-of-Trainer concepts,

Work experience in GIZ projects.

Good knowledge of the Rwandan private sector landscape

Effective project management skills and experience in complex multi-faceted projects.

Ability to lead and work in a dynamic and multidisciplinary team and context.

item.title: Recreation Supervisor job at Kigali Marriott Hotel
item.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Create recreational activity agendas and advertisements using publishing software. Conduct inventory of supplies, materials, and equipment and inform manager of low supply items. Encourage, recruit, register, and schedule guests to participate in recreation activities. Promote a fun and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Provide information to guests about available recreation facilities and activities. Promote the rules and regulations of the recreation facility intended for the safety and welfare of guests and members. Observe activity in the recreational facility and respond appropriately in accordance with local operating procedure in the event of an emergency. Be aware of possible situations where guests are not able to safely participate in an activity and inform supervisor/manager. Provide assistance to injured guests until the arrival of emergency medical services. Clean and maintain recreational equipment and supplies.

Assist management in training, motivating, and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Process orders or transactions from customers and collect payment as necessary. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, and implement new ways to increase organizational quality. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

License or Certification: CPR Certification

First Aid Certification

Recreation and Fitness Equipment

Any certification or training required by local and state agencies.

item.title: Graduate Laboratory Technician job at Trinity Musha Mines Ltd
item.description:
Background

Trinity Musha Mines Ltd is a Mining company focused on the production and exploration of Tin, Tantalum, and Lithium in Rwanda. Trinity Musha is currently inviting suitable candidates to apply for the following position:

Job Summary

Graduate Laboratory Technician is an entry-level role designed for individuals who are starting their careers in the mining, metallurgy, or laboratory sciences field. This position provides support in the day-to-day operations of the laboratory by assisting in sample preparation, conducting basic analyses, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of test results. The Graduate Laboratory Technician will develop technical skills under the guidance of senior staff while contributing to the operational success of the laboratory.

Key Responsibilities:

Sample preparation and analysis support

Assist in the preparation of samples for chemical and instrumental analyses, including wet chemistry and XRF tests.

Supervise the sample preparation activity across the Laboratory.

Get trained for routine analyses under the supervision of senior laboratory staff.

Ensure proper handling and storage of samples according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Receive and record all samples submitted to the laboratory.

Quality control and assurance

Assist in implementing quality control procedures, such as ensuring the correct use of Certified Reference Materials (CRMs), blanks, and duplicates.

Maintain proper documentation of test results and assist in the identification of any deviations from expected results.

Participate in quality checks and contribute to the continuous improvement of laboratory practices.

Laboratory equipment and maintenance

Operate basic laboratory instruments and equipment with guidance.

Ensure that laboratory equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and functioning as required.

Report any issues with laboratory equipment or tools to the Laboratory technician for troubleshooting.

Safety and compliance

Follow safety protocols and standard operating procedures to maintain a safe working environment.

Handle chemicals, reagents, and hazardous materials safely according to laboratory guidelines.

Assist in maintaining a clean, organized laboratory workspace.

Reporting and documentation

Label and track samples appropriately to ensure traceability and proper storage.

Assist in generating basic analytical reports and documentation as required.

Team Collaboration & Development

Work closely with senior laboratory staff, including Laboratory Technicians and Analysts, to ensure smooth operations.

Participate in training sessions to develop technical laboratory skills and improve analytical techniques.

Communicate effectively with laboratory team members to support laboratory functions.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Chemistry, Metallurgy, Geology, or a related field.

Recent graduate with little or no professional experience in a laboratory environment.

A keen interest in laboratory work, mining, and metallurgical processes.

Basic understanding of laboratory safety and quality control procedures.

Strong attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to follow instructions.

Good communication skills and ability to work in a team-oriented environment.

item.title: Senior Breast Imaging Officer job at Partners In Health
item.description_html:
Organization Profile

In 2005, PIH and its Rwandan sister organization, Inshuti Mu Buzima (IMB), began working in partnership with the government of Rwanda to address the HIV/AIDS epidemic afflicting the population and to comprehensively strengthen the public health system in rural, underserved districts in Rwanda. Today, PIH/IMB supports delivery of comprehensive integrated non-communicable disease (NCD) services in three rural districts of Rwanda, including cancer care. Cancer care is predominantly based at the flagship Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence (BCCOE), which was inaugurated in June 2012 and has since provided care to over 9,000 patients, with services ranging from cancer prevention, diagnosis, and treatment.As breast cancer incidence rises in Rwanda, innovative and sustainable strategies to facilitate timely, accurate diagnoses are urgently needed to eliminate these preventable deaths. High-quality breast imaging is essential for the evaluation of potential cancer. Specifically, diagnostic breast ultrasound is the global standard of care in evaluating breast masses and more accurate than physical exam alone in identifying benign versus malignant disease. By triaging lesions requiring biopsy, ultrasound may also reduce unnecessary referrals and allocate resources to those most likely to have cancer. However, radiologists are still scarce and breast ultrasound is typically offered only at urban referral hospitals. Decentralizing breast ultrasound to district hospitals would expand access to this critical evidence-based intervention, particularly for low-income rural patients facing heightened barriers to referral hospital care. It is with this regards that Rwandan policymakers have called for breast ultrasound decentralization at all district hospitals. Based on this, PIH/IMB in collaboration with Brigham and Women’s Hospital(BWH) are implementing a project entitled “MURIKA (Mobilizing Ultrasound for Breast Imaging and Care)” aiming to use a fully powered hybrid implementation-effectiveness trial design, to examine whether real-time virtual supervision using teleultrasound technology is more effective than asynchronous virtual feedback in facilitating breast ultrasound provision and maintaining clinicians’ skills at 16 Rwandan selected district hospitals. During the tele-ultrasound supervision, the trained clinicians/medical imaging technologists will receive real time supervision and feedback from the incumbent Senior Breast Imaging Officer on a video call using REACTS (a radiology software). For asynchronous virtual supervision, the clinicians-trainees will save the ultrasound images and will be shared with the incumbent who will provide them feedback within 24 hours. The project will focus on comparing the effectiveness of these two strategies in terms of building the trainees’ skills and supporting the incorporation of the breast ultrasound provision into clinical care at the 16 district hospitals.

Overall Responsibilities:

Under the guidance of PIH/IMB Research and Training and Oncology Programs Leadership, as well as BWH partners, the Senior Breast Imaging Officer will be mainly responsible for leading clinical interventions, trainings, mentorship and supervision in diagnostic breast ultrasound within the 16 selected intervention hospitals and PIH/IMB supported sites, following the established radiology requirements and regulations to ensure patient care, safety and clinicians’ skills enhancement. The position will also be involved in different related research activities, expert meetings, workshops, and curriculum reviews.

Specific Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Developing diagnostic breast ultrasound training curricula;
  • Leading breast ultrasound trainings, combining in-person and web-based didactic lectures and supervision;
  • Supporting the assessments of the effectiveness of the training and supervision strategies;
  • Serving as a virtual mentor-supervisor for the selected study or intervention sites/hospitals (via tele-ultrasound for some hospitals and asynchronous supervision for other sites);
  • Participating in regular (weekly, monthly, quarterly) meetings and workshops with different stakeholders;
  • Supporting study results interpretation, dissemination and translation of findings into policy and practice;
  • Providing clinical expertise on diagnostic breast ultrasound while supporting other breast medical imaging project-related activities as needed and requested by the PIH/IMB supervisors.

Ideal Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Imaging Services; a Master’s degree being an added advantage;
  • Having worked in cancer control or breast cancer early detection national programs;
  • Working specialization in medical breast imaging techniques and equipment, especially in diagnostic breast ultrasound;
  • 3-5 years’ experience in imaging services from a reputable health/ radiology institution/center
  • Some experience with a CT Scan, MRI and mammography machines is also an added advantage;
  • Flexibility and willingness to work across several locations, in resource limited settings, including rural areas and diverse team ;
  • Strong management, communication, mentoring, teaching and leadership skills;
  • Highly organized and able to manage a heavy patient load;
  • Have compassion for vulnerable population, advocacy for their well-being and medical needs;
  • Persuaded and practicing the principles of equity;
  • Showing expert skills, knowledge, experience and passion for medical imaging techniques especially in diagnostic breast ultrasound;
  • Ability to live PIH/IMB values: Ubumuntu-Compassion, Ubupfura-Integrity, Ubunyangamugayo-Honesty, Ubwubahane-Mutual respect, Ubufatanye-Solidarity, Agaciro-Dignity, Kugira ishyaka-Determination.

At Partners In Health, we are committed to ensuring that those who benefit from our work- including our patients, families and community members – as well as our staff are treated with dignity and respect and protected from sexual exploitation, abuse and sexual harassment. By signing this Job Description, the employee confirms their understanding of this commitment, their readiness to follow it, and adhere to it.

item.title: Emergency Physician job at Partners In Health
item.description:
Job Purpose

The Emergency Physician provides high-quality, evidence-based emergency and acute care services to patients presenting with acute illness and injury across the full spectrum of acuity. He/she will combine direct clinical service with active contributions to undergraduate and postgraduate medical education, clinical supervision of medical students, interns, residents, nurses, and other healthcare professionals, while supporting departmental quality improvement initiatives and research. The Emergency Physician works within a multidisciplinary team from the hospital departments and upholds the hospital's commitment to patient safety, equity of care, and academic excellence.

Specific Responsibilities:

Clinical Care

Assess, diagnose, and manage undifferentiated emergency presentations including resuscitation, trauma, paediatric emergencies, and mental health crises.

Perform and supervise emergency procedures (airway management, intubation, central/arterial line placement, chest drain insertion, cardioversion, lumbar puncture, etc.).

Manage patient flow in the emergency department, prioritising acuity through effective triage, and ensuring timely disposition decisions.

Collaborate with inpatient specialists, surgeons, internal medicine, pediatricians and allied health professionals to facilitate optimal patient outcomes.

Maintain accurate, timely, and complete medical documentation in accordance with hospital standards.

Teaching & Academic

Supervise and teach medical students, interns rotating through the emergency department.

Mentor junior staff and provide constructive performance feedback aligned with postgraduate training frameworks.

Deliver didactic teaching sessions, case-based discussions, simulation training, and bedside teaching as assigned.

Contribute to curriculum development and competency-based assessment of trainees.

Engage in scholarly activities including clinical research, quality improvement projects, case series, or guideline development.

Quality, Safety & Governance

Champion patient safety culture and participate in clinical audit, adverse event review, etc

Promote compliance with national clinical protocols, accreditation standards, and infection prevention guidelines.

Contribute to departmental key performance indicators monitoring 

Support hospital accreditation processes and emergency department preparedness activities including mass casualty drills.

Identify and escalate clinical risks through appropriate governance channels.

Leadership & Collaboration

Act as a resource and role model for professional conduct, clinical reasoning, and communication.

Contribute to departmental strategic planning, policy development, and operational improvement initiatives.

Maintain effective relationships with pre-hospital services, referral hospitals, and community health partners.

Required Qualifications

Postgraduate specialist qualification in Emergency Medicine (Fellowship, Board Certification, or equivalent national specialist registration) 

Minimum 3 years post specialist qualification experience in a busy emergency department.

Demonstrated experience in clinical supervision and teaching of medical trainees.

Advanced Life Support certification (ACLS/ALS) current; ATLS or equivalent trauma certification preferred.

Familiarity with electronic medical records and hospital information systems.

Demonstrated team-building and facilitation skills.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication, interpersonal and interviewing skills.

Excellent computer skills with proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office 

Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse range of stakeholders.

Ability to conduct basic data analysis.

Fluent in English; knowledge of French and Kinyarwanda is an advantage

Ability to live PIH/IMB values: Ubumuntu-Compassion, Ubupfura-Integrity, Ubunyangamugayo-Honesty, Ubwubahane-Mutual respect, Ubufatanye-Solidarity, Agaciro-Dignity, Kugira ishyaka-Determination.

He/she will combine direct clinical service with active contributions to undergraduate and postgraduate medical education, clinical supervision of medical students, interns, residents, nurses, and other healthcare professionals, while supporting departmental quality improvement initiatives and research. The Emergency Physician works within a multidisciplinary team from the hospital departments and upholds the hospital's commitment to patient safety, equity of care, and academic excellence.

Specific Responsibilities:

Clinical Care

Assess, diagnose, and manage undifferentiated emergency presentations including resuscitation, trauma, paediatric emergencies, and mental health crises.

Perform and supervise emergency procedures (airway management, intubation, central/arterial line placement, chest drain insertion, cardioversion, lumbar puncture, etc.).

Manage patient flow in the emergency department, prioritising acuity through effective triage, and ensuring timely disposition decisions.

Collaborate with inpatient specialists, surgeons, internal medicine, pediatricians and allied health professionals to facilitate optimal patient outcomes.

Maintain accurate, timely, and complete medical documentation in accordance with hospital standards.

Teaching & Academic

Supervise and teach medical students, interns rotating through the emergency department.

Mentor junior staff and provide constructive performance feedback aligned with postgraduate training frameworks.

Deliver didactic teaching sessions, case-based discussions, simulation training, and bedside teaching as assigned.

Contribute to curriculum development and competency-based assessment of trainees.

Engage in scholarly activities including clinical research, quality improvement projects, case series, or guideline development.

Quality, Safety & Governance

Champion patient safety culture and participate in clinical audit, adverse event review, etc

Promote compliance with national clinical protocols, accreditation standards, and infection prevention guidelines.

Contribute to departmental key performance indicators monitoring 

Support hospital accreditation processes and emergency department preparedness activities including mass casualty drills.

Identify and escalate clinical risks through appropriate governance channels.

Leadership & Collaboration

Act as a resource and role model for professional conduct, clinical reasoning, and communication.

Contribute to departmental strategic planning, policy development, and operational improvement initiatives.

Maintain effective relationships with pre-hospital services, referral hospitals, and community health partners.

Required Qualifications

Postgraduate specialist qualification in Emergency Medicine (Fellowship, Board Certification, or equivalent national specialist registration) 

Minimum 3 years post specialist qualification experience in a busy emergency department.

Demonstrated experience in clinical supervision and teaching of medical trainees.

Advanced Life Support certification (ACLS/ALS) current; ATLS or equivalent trauma certification preferred.

Familiarity with electronic medical records and hospital information systems.

Demonstrated team-building and facilitation skills.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication, interpersonal and interviewing skills.

Excellent computer skills with proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office 

Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse range of stakeholders.

Ability to conduct basic data analysis.

Fluent in English; knowledge of French and Kinyarwanda is an advantage

Ability to live PIH/IMB values: Ubumuntu-Compassion, Ubupfura-Integrity, Ubunyangamugayo-Honesty, Ubwubahane-Mutual respect, Ubufatanye-Solidarity, Agaciro-Dignity, Kugira ishyaka-Determination.

item.title: Medical Surgical Nurse job at Partners In Health
item.description:
Job Purpose

The Medical Surgical Nurse provides safe, high quality, evidence-based nursing care to patients admitted to the medical-surgical ward. Working within an interdisciplinary team, the nurse is responsible for the comprehensive assessment, and planning of patient needs, implementation and evaluation of patient care plans. The position also contributes to clinical teaching, mentorship of junior staff and students, and continuous quality improvement in line with standards and clinical protocols.

Specific Responsibilities:

Clinical nursing care

Develop, implement, and evaluate patient nursing care plans in collaboration with a multidisciplinary team.

Conduct thorough nursing assessments of patients upon admission and throughout their care continuum, documenting findings in the patient files

Monitor patient vital signs, clinical parameters, and response to treatment; escalate changes in condition promptly to the attending physician or nurse in charge.

Assist physicians/surgeons and other healthcare providers during examniations and procedures.

Provide pre- and post-operative nursing care including wound management, drain care, and monitoring of surgical complications.

Conduct patient and family education regarding diagnosis, treatment plan, medications, and discharge care instructions.

Ensure accurate, timely, and complete nursing documentation in accordance with hospital and national standards.

Patient Safety & Quality Improvement

Participate in adverse event reporting and root cause analysis processes in compliance with hospital quality and patient safety policies.

Contribute to ward-level continuous quality improvement projects, including data collection, audits, and clinical reviews.

Adhere to Rwanda Hospital Accreditation Standards and support ward preparation for accreditation assessments.

Ensure proper use, maintenance, and inventory of medical equipment and supplies; report deficiencies to head of department.

Report incidents, adverse events and near misses according to hospital policies.

Teaching, Mentorship & Professional Development

Mentor and support orientationf of new staff and students during clinical rotations on the ward.

Participate in ward-based in-service training, case presentations, and nursing grand rounds.

Engage in continuing professional development (CPD) activities and apply new knowledge to clinical practice.

Support the implementation of evidence-based nursing practice guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Collaboration & Communication

Participate actively in daily team rounds, handover reports, and care coordination meetings.

Communicate effectively with patients, families, and team members, maintaining dignity, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity.

Required Qualifications

Masters in Medical Surgical Nursing or equivalent

Registered nurse with a valid nursing license. Nurses holding an A1 certificate with significant relevant experience may be considered.

Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience in surgery in a hospital setting. Experience in a teaching hospital or referral hospital is an added value.

Demonstrated experience in clinical teaching and mentorship

Familiarity with Rwanda national clinical protocols, IPC standards, and triage systems.

Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Proficiency in basic computer skills and willingness to use electronic medical record systems.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse range of stakeholders.

Ability to conduct basic data analysis.

Fluent in English and Kinyarwanda; knowledge of French is an advantage

Ability to live PIH/IMB values: Ubumuntu-Compassion, Ubupfura-Integrity, Ubunyangamugayo-Honesty, Ubwubahane-Mutual respect, Ubufatanye-Solidarity, Agaciro-Dignity, Kugira ishyaka-Determination.

item.title: Neonatal Nurse job at Partners In Health
item.description:
Job Purpose

The Neonatal Nurse provides safe, high-quality, evidence-based nursing care to newborns, including preterm and ill neonates requiring specialized care. Working within a multidisciplinary maternal and newborn health team, the nurse is responsible for comprehensive assessment, monitoring, and management of neonatal conditions, including stabilization, thermoregulation, feeding support, and early detection of complications. The position also contributes to clinical teaching, mentorship of nursing staff and students, and continuous quality improvement to ensure patient safety and adherence to neonatal care standards and protocols.

Specific Responsibilities:

Clinical nursing care

Develop, implement, and evaluate neonatal nursing care plans in collaboration with the maternal and newborn health and multidisciplinary team.

Conduct comprehensive neonatal assessments upon admission and throughout care, ensuring early identification of risks, complications, and care needs, including maternal history review.

Monitor neonatal vital signs and clinical parameters, responding promptly to any deterioration and escalating concerns to the neonatal or medical team

Assist healthcare providers during neonatalogy procedures and interventions, ensuring aseptic technique and patient safety in the neonatal unit.

Provide safe and effective neonatal care, including thermoregulation, feeding support, infection prevention, respiratory support monitoring, and management of common neonatal conditions.

Educate mothers and families on newborn care practices, danger signs, feeding, hygiene, and discharge care instructions to promote continuity of care at home

Ensure accurate, timely, and complete neonatal documentation, including nursing records, monitoring charts, and care plans in line with hospital standards and protocols.

Patient Safety & Quality Improvement

Participate in neonatal adverse event reporting and root cause analysis processes in compliance with hospital patient safety and neonatal care quality standards.

Contribute to neonatal unit continuous quality improvement initiatives, including neonatal mortality and morbidity reviews, infection prevention audits, and newborn outcome monitoring.

Adhere to Rwanda Hospital Accreditation Standards and support neonatal unit preparedness for accreditation assessments and compliance with newborn care safety standards.

Ensure proper use, sterilization (where applicable), maintenance, and inventory management of neonatal equipment, consumables, and supplies (e.g., incubators, radiant warmers, oxygen delivery devices); report any deficiencies to the unit in charge.

Report neonatal incidents, adverse events, and near misses promptly in line with hospital policies and neonatal safety reporting systems.

Teaching, Mentorship & Professional Development

Mentor and support orientation of new staff and students during clinical rotations on the ward.

Participate in ward-based in-service training, case presentations, and nursing grand rounds.

Engage in continuing professional development (CPD) activities and apply new knowledge to clinical practice.

Support the implementation of evidence-based nursing practice guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Collaboration & Communication

Participate actively in daily team rounds, handover reports, and care coordination meetings.

Communicate effectively with patients, families, and team members, maintaining dignity, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity.

Required Qualifications

Master of science in Neonatal Nursing with a valid nursing license of practing in Rwanda 

Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience in Neonatal nursing in a hospital setting; experience in a teaching or referral hospital is an added value.

Demonstrated experience in clinical teaching, mentorship, and supervision of nursing staff and students in the operating theatre environment.

Familiarity with Rwanda national clinical protocols, infection prevention and control (IPC) standards, and surgical safety checklist systems.

Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills in perioperative patient management.

Proficiency in basic computer skills and willingness to use electronic medical record and theatre documentation systems.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary surgical and anesthesia team.

Ability to support basic data collection, quality improvement tracking, and perioperative outcome analysis.

Fluent in English and Kinyarwanda; knowledge of French is an advantage.

Ability to live PIH/IMB values: Ubumuntu-Compassion, Ubupfura-Integrity, Ubunyangamugayo-Honesty, Ubwubahane-Mutual respect, Ubufatanye-Solidarity, Agaciro-Dignity, Kugira ishyaka-Determination.

item.title: Peri-operative nurse job at Partners In Health
item.description:
Job Purpose

The Perioperative Nurse provides safe, high-quality, evidence-based nursing care to patients undergoing surgical and invasive procedures. Working within a multidisciplinary surgical team, the nurse is responsible for preoperative assessment and preparation, intraoperative patient advocacy and support, and postoperative monitoring and care. The position also contributes to clinical teaching, mentorship of nursing staff and students, and continuous quality improvement to ensure patient safety and adherence to perioperative standards and protocols.

Specific Responsibilities:

Clinical nursing care

Develop, implement, and evaluate perioperative nursing care plans in collaboration with the surgical and multidisciplinary team across preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative phases.

Conduct comprehensive preoperative patient assessments and ensure readiness for surgery, including verification of consent, investigations, and safety checklists.

Monitor patients’ vital signs and intraoperative parameters, responding promptly to changes in condition and escalating concerns to the surgical or anesthesia team.

Assist surgeons, anesthetists, and other healthcare providers during surgical procedures, ensuring aseptic technique and patient safety in the operating theatre.

Provide safe and effective postoperative nursing care, including pain management, wound care, drain management, and early detection of surgical complications.

Educate patients and families on perioperative processes, surgical procedures, recovery expectations, and post-discharge care instructions.

Ensure accurate, timely, and complete perioperative documentation, including surgical safety checklists and intraoperative records, in line with hospital standards and protocols.

Patient Safety & Quality Improvement

Participate in perioperative adverse event reporting and root cause analysis processes in compliance with hospital patient safety and surgical quality standards.

Contribute to operating theatre continuous quality improvement initiatives, including surgical audits, infection prevention reviews, and perioperative outcome monitoring.

Adhere to Rwanda Hospital Accreditation Standards and support operating theatre preparedness for accreditation assessments and surgical safety compliance.

Ensure proper use, sterilization, maintenance, and inventory management of surgical instruments, anesthesia equipment, and theatre supplies; report any deficiencies to the theatre in charge.

Report surgical incidents, adverse events, and near misses promptly in line with hospital policies and perioperative safety reporting systems.

Teaching, Mentorship & Professional Development

Mentor and support orientationf of new staff and students during clinical rotations on the ward.

Participate in ward-based in-service training, case presentations, and nursing grand rounds.

Engage in continuing professional development (CPD) activities and apply new knowledge to clinical practice.

Support the implementation of evidence-based nursing practice guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Clinical nursing care

Conduct comprehensive preoperative patient assessments and ensure readiness for surgery, including verification of consent, investigations, and safety checklists.

Monitor patients’ vital signs and intraoperative parameters, responding promptly to changes in condition and escalating concerns to the surgical or anesthesia team.

Assist surgeons, anesthetists, and other healthcare providers during surgical procedures, ensuring aseptic technique and patient safety in the operating theatre.

Provide safe and effective postoperative nursing care, including pain management, wound care, drain management, and early detection of surgical complications.

Educate patients and families on perioperative processes, surgical procedures, recovery expectations, and post-discharge care instructions.

Ensure accurate, timely, and complete perioperative documentation, including surgical safety checklists and intraoperative records, in line with hospital standards and protocols.

Patient Safety & Quality Improvement

Participate in perioperative adverse event reporting and root cause analysis processes in compliance with hospital patient safety and surgical quality standards.

Contribute to operating theatre continuous quality improvement initiatives, including surgical audits, infection prevention reviews, and perioperative outcome monitoring.

Adhere to Rwanda Hospital Accreditation Standards and support operating theatre preparedness for accreditation assessments and surgical safety compliance.

Ensure proper use, sterilization, maintenance, and inventory management of surgical instruments, anesthesia equipment, and theatre supplies; report any deficiencies to the theatre in charge.

item.title: Irrigation Instructor job at Rwanda Rural Rehabilitation Initiative
item.location: Amizero Institute of Technology and Hospitality (AMITH), Kayonza District
item.description:
Background

Rwanda Rural Rehabilitation Initiative (RWARRI) is a non-governmental organization dedicated to promoting and improving the socio-economic welfare of rural communities in Rwanda. The organization was conceived in 1994 and started implementing its activities in Rwanda in 1995. RWARRI is registered with the Rwanda Governance Board (RGB), a government body tasked with regulating Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), under registration number 023/11. For promoting education, RWARRI initiated a technical and vocational education training (TVET) school named Amizero Institute of Technology and Hospitality (AMITH). This school started operating with the trades of Culinary Art, Hairdressing, Masonry, Tailoring, Welding, and Carpentry.

With the idea of expanding its contribution to the development of rural areas through agriculture and youth employment, RWARRI is partnering with SUYANA Foundation, a Switzerland-based organization whose aim is to support individuals and communities by enhancing health, education, and livelihood, and fostering local commitment for long-lasting positive impact. This partnership is initiating short courses in agriculture in the trades of Mechanization, Irrigation, and Post-Harvest Handling and Storage, through a project named Shaping the Next Generation of Agriculture, or Youth Empowerment for Sustainable and Profitable Agriculture in Rwanda (YESPAR).

In line with the Rwanda TVET Board (RTB) Training Organization Guide (TOG) for Short Courses in Irrigation Technology, RWARRI is recruiting an Irrigation Instructor and an Irrigation Teaching Assistant to jointly ensure effective delivery of theoretical and practical irrigation training at AMITH TVET School. This document presents the Terms of Reference (ToR) for both positions.

Positions Covered by this ToR

Two complementary positions are being recruited under the YESPAR project at AMITH. A brief overview of each is given below — full duties, responsibilities, and expected outputs are detailed in the respective full Terms of Reference.

Position 1: Irrigation Instructor — leads theoretical and practical training delivery (8 months).

Position 2: Irrigation Teaching Assistant — supports the Irrigation Instructor in lesson delivery and workshop management (6 months).

POSITION 1 — IRRIGATION INSTRUCTOR

Position Title: Irrigation Instructor

Duty Station: Amizero Institute of Technology and Hospitality (AMITH), Kayonza District

Reports To: AMITH School Manager and YESPAR Project Manager (RWARRI)

Duration: Eight (8) months, renewable or not

Project: Youth Empowerment for Sustainable and Profitable Agriculture in Rwanda (YESPAR)

Purpose of the Role

The Irrigation Instructor will be responsible for training YESPAR-supported students in irrigation technology, ensuring they acquire both the theoretical knowledge and practical skills necessary for employment or entrepreneurship as drip irrigation system operators, overhead (sprinkler) irrigation system operators, surface irrigation system operators, and irrigation pumping system operators, while respecting safety, security, and environmental regulations.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Irrigation and Drainage, Water Engineering, or a related field, with at least 1 year of relevant experience. Strong practical skills in irrigation systems and pumping equipment, plus good communication and mentoring ability.

item.title: Territory Lead job at EarthEnable Rwanda
item.description:
Who We Are

At EarthEnable, we believe that our clients deserve our very best, that work should be fun, and that the best ideas could come from any part of the company. We celebrate each other’s wins, learn from our setbacks, and are deeply proud of the impact we make every day. We believe a home that doesn’t make you sick means more than living disease-free. It means pride and dignity in the place our customers most treasure: their homes. Being a part of our team means more than building housing products: it means building an organization and building a better future for rural families.

What We Do

EarthEnable is transforming the way people live, by making homes healthier for families across rural Rwanda, Uganda, and Kenya. 80% of Rwandans live in homes with dirt floors which are dusty, unsanitary, and fertile breeding grounds for parasites and germs. While replacing a dirt floor with concrete has significant health benefits (e.g. reducing diarrhea by 50% and parasitic infections by 80%), concrete is unaffordable for many who need it, and is also responsible for 8% of global carbon emissions.

EarthEnable addresses this pressing and ubiquitous problem by selling high-quality, earthen housing products like our flagship floor that is 80% cheaper than concrete with 90% less embedded energy. Earthen floors, plasters, and blocks are composed of natural materials (gravel, clay, sand, and laterite) and sealed with a proprietary drying oil that makes them waterproof, strong, and polished. In our first decade of operations, EarthEnable has installed ~60,000 products for over 300,000 individuals and created livelihoods for over 1,300 people. See our new product - a full house - here!

Position Overview

The Territory Lead is responsible for the overall performance, growth, and operational excellence of their assigned territory. This role combines commercial leadership, operational oversight, and people management to ensure sales targets are met, construction projects are executed efficiently, and customers receive an exceptional experience.

The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-driven leader who can translate strategy into execution, build high-performing teams, and operate with strong business acumen in dynamic field environments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Territory Ownership and Business Performance

Own the end-to-end performance of the territory, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and operational priorities.

Develop and execute localized sales and operational strategies informed by market insights, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.

Drive achievement of assigned sales and build targets while maintaining strong quality and customer satisfaction standards.

Monitor territory performance through data and KPIs, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective actions.

2. Sales Leadership and Customer Experience

Lead the recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of Customer Sales Officers (CSOs) to build a strong and productive sales force.

Equip teams with the tools, messaging, and support needed to effectively engage customers and convert leads.

Champion customer-centric practices, ensuring a seamless journey from initial engagement through project completion.

Strengthen relationships with cooperatives, institutions, local leaders, and community stakeholders to expand market reach and reinforce EarthEnable’s mission.

Oversee territory-level marketing and activation initiatives to drive demand and brand visibility.

3. Operational and Construction Excellence

Oversee all construction activities within the territory, ensuring adherence to quality standards, timelines, and safety practices.

Align construction capacity with sales volume to prevent project delays and backlog.

Partner closely with operations teams to coordinate material forecasting, ordering, and delivery.

Track project progress and ensure timely follow-up on active builds, addressing bottlenecks before they escalate.

Continuously identify opportunities to improve construction efficiency and reduce cycle times.

4. Financial Stewardship and Data Integrity

Ensure customer payments are collected in accordance with company policies while maintaining the highest standards of financial accountability.

Monitor territory-level financial indicators, including revenue, cost drivers, and operational efficiency.

Promote accurate and timely data capture to support reporting, forecasting, and informed decision-making.

Safeguard company resources by reinforcing compliance with internal controls.

5. Team Leadership and Culture Building

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing territory team across sales and construction functions.

Provide regular coaching, mentorship, and structured performance feedback to strengthen capability and accountability.

Foster a culture grounded in professionalism, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.

Model EarthEnable’s values and cultivate an environment where team members feel motivated, supported, and empowered to succeed.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Operations, or a related field.

Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in field operations, sales leadership, or territory management.

Demonstrated success managing teams and delivering measurable business results.

Strong operational mindset with the ability to balance commercial growth and execution quality.

Experience working in fast-paced or growth-oriented organizations is highly desirable.

Proficiency in data-driven decision-making and performance management.

Key Competencies

Strong leadership and people development skills

Results-oriented with high ownership and accountability

Strategic thinker with strong execution capability

Excellent stakeholder and community engagement skills

Financial and operational discipline

Adaptability and resilience in dynamic environments

Clear communicator with the ability to influence and motivate teams

This role combines commercial leadership, operational oversight, and people management to ensure sales targets are met, construction projects are executed efficiently, and customers receive an exceptional experience.

The ideal candidate is a proactive and results-driven leader who can translate strategy into execution, build high-performing teams, and operate with strong business acumen in dynamic field environments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Territory Ownership and Business Performance

  • Own the end-to-end performance of the territory, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and operational priorities.
  • Develop and execute localized sales and operational strategies informed by market insights, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.
  • Drive achievement of assigned sales and build targets while maintaining strong quality and customer satisfaction standards.
  • Monitor territory performance through data and KPIs, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective actions.

2. Sales Leadership and Customer Experience

  • Lead the recruitment, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of Customer Sales Officers (CSOs) to build a strong and productive sales force.
  • Equip teams with the tools, messaging, and support needed to effectively engage customers and convert leads.
  • Champion customer-centric practices, ensuring a seamless journey from initial engagement through project completion.
  • Strengthen relationships with cooperatives, institutions, local leaders, and community stakeholders to expand market reach and reinforce EarthEnable’s mission.
  • Oversee territory-level marketing and activation initiatives to drive demand and brand visibility.

3. Operational and Construction Excellence

  • Oversee all construction activities within the territory, ensuring adherence to quality standards, timelines, and safety practices.
  • Align construction capacity with sales volume to prevent project delays and backlog.
  • Partner closely with operations teams to coordinate material forecasting, ordering, and delivery.
  • Track project progress and ensure timely follow-up on active builds, addressing bottlenecks before they escalate.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve construction efficiency and reduce cycle times.

4. Financial Stewardship and Data Integrity

  • Ensure customer payments are collected in accordance with company policies while maintaining the highest standards of financial accountability.
  • Monitor territory-level financial indicators, including revenue, cost drivers, and operational efficiency.
  • Promote accurate and timely data capture to support reporting, forecasting, and informed decision-making.
  • Safeguard company resources by reinforcing compliance with internal controls.

5. Team Leadership and Culture Building

  • Build, lead, and retain a high-performing territory team across sales and construction functions.
  • Provide regular coaching, mentorship, and structured performance feedback to strengthen capability and accountability.
  • Foster a culture grounded in professionalism, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
  • Model EarthEnable’s values and cultivate an environment where team members feel motivated, supported, and empowered to succeed.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of progressive experience in field operations, sales leadership, or territory management.
  • Demonstrated success managing teams and delivering measurable business results.
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to balance commercial growth and execution quality.
  • Experience working in fast-paced or growth-oriented organizations is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in data-driven decision-making and performance management.

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people development skills
  • Results-oriented with high ownership and accountability
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capability
  • Excellent stakeholder and community engagement skills
  • Financial and operational discipline
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic environments
  • Clear communicator with the ability to influence and motivate teams

item.title: Maintenance Planner job at Trinity Musha Mines Ltd
item.description:
Background

Trinity Nyakabingo Mines Ltd is a Wolfram Mining Company, situated in Shyorongi Sector, Rulindo District, Northern Province.on its own behalf, the Management of Trinity Nyakabingo Mines Ltd informs all public that it recruits Competent, Qualified and Experienced Staff to fill this vacant position:

Job Brief

Responsible for designing, scheduling and coordinating the planned maintenance workload for the Maintenance Section - building and maintaining the Preventive Maintenance Schedule (PMS), preparing work packs, and ensuring the right job is executed by the right team at the right time.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and refine the Preventive Maintenance Schedule (PMS) based on OEM recommendations and operating data.

Plan and schedule weekly/monthly maintenance work, balancing PM tasks, corrective orders and production priorities.

Prepare detailed work packs (scope, parts, tools, procedures, labour hours) and coordinate maintenance windows with Production.

Generate, release and track work orders; manage backlog and report to the Maintenance Supervisor.

Coordinate spare parts availability with the Storekeeper; monitor consumption and recommend MIN/MAX corrections.

Track planning KPIs (PM compliance, schedule compliance, MTBF/MTTR) and weekly planning reports.

Maintain CMMS data integrity, job plans and task libraries; embed safety/PPE/LOTO requirements into job plans.

Requirements:

A1 Advanced Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Electromechanics or related field; Bachelor's degree an advantage.

Minimum 3 years' experience in maintenance planning, scheduling or a hands-on maintenance role with planning exposure.

Proficiency in CMMS/EAM platforms (e.g. SAP PM, Maximo, Pragma, Fiix) and advanced MS Excel/MS Project skills.

Strong understanding of mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and auto-electrical systems; ability to read P&IDs and OEM manuals.

Highly organised, analytical and able to prioritise multiple tasks and deadlines.
