item.title: Internal Audit Manager at Vision Fund Rwanda
item.description:
March 16th 2026

JOB ADVERTISEMENT

‘’Make a difference to thousands in the land of a thousand hills’’

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR), is Rwanda’s largest microfinance Institution. VFR is committed to the development of Rwanda through providing affordable financial services (savings and loans) to the less privileged throughout its 4 zones in Rwanda.

VFR is the institution where you can develop your expertise working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused high performance environment. If you are looking for interesting but challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, then VFR has the will to make it so.

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR) has zero tolerance to abuse and sexual exploitation of children and adults beneficiaries. We expect all our employees/affiliates to commit to protecting children and adult beneficiaries from harm and abide by our safeguarding policy.VFR needs to recruit experienced and qualified staff on the following position:

Internal Audit Manager

Reporting to: Regional Audit Manager / Board Audit Committee (BAC) / CEO

Type of the contract: Open Ended Contract

Job Purpose 

Support VFR accomplish its objectives, create, protect and sustain value by providing an independent, risk-based, and objective assurance over risk management, control and governance processes.

Monitor VFR’s compliance with the existing laws, rules and regulations in the country.

Monitor compliance with VFR’s and VFI’s standards, policies and procedures for financial, operational and social performance requirements.

Advise the VFR Board of Directors and VFR Management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal control systems and risk management

Perform any statutory function related to Internal Audit required by the regulators of VFR.

Main Responsibilities

% Time

Major Activities

End Results Expected

(5%) Planning

Develops and submits for approval to the BAC annual audit plan that outlines the activities to be undertaken by the Internal Audit Department (IAD) during the year.

Prepare amended internal audit plan and present it to the Audit Committee for approval in case of significant shifts in risk profile or significant changes in the operations of VFR.

Annual plan prepared before beginning of Q1 and approved by the audit committee

(15%) Reporting

Submits timely reports to management for all the audits conducted during the year;

Submits written audit reports & internal audit activity reports to the Audit Committee before every scheduled Board meeting;

Presents the audit activity reports during the BAC meeting every quarter;

Submits high quality progress reports to RAM monthly and attends regular check in meetings with RAM as required;

Tracks the status of implementation of issues/corrective actions arising from audit reports and provides updates to Management, RAM and BAC;

Presents to Management the results from continuous audit & analytics each month;

Informs all concerned staff on changes in internal control and audit policies and procedures.

At least 90% of Audit Reports published within 30 calendar days of fieldwork close.

Audit Reports to BAC submitted at least 15 days prior to the meeting.

Monthly progress reports submitted within 7 working days of month end to RAM. Attendance of regular check in meetings organized by RAM.

Summary of issues / corrective action status sent to RAM and Management monthly.

(40%)

Audit Work

Carries out the Internal Audit Plan with the assistance of the Internal Auditors (if any) or on their own;

Performs testing or ensures testing done by Internal Auditors is as per required standards and latest Audit Program;

Prepares, reviews and issues all IAD audit reports after approval by the RAM;

Discusses the results of audits with respective head office /branch department managers and advices on appropriate corrective actions to improve conditions;

Ensures all audit testing is adequately documented and archived for the period required by VFI policy and local regulatory authorities;

Ensures data analytics is completed each month by the IAD as part of continuous audit and monitoring;

Independently appraises all operational functions of the institution;

Reviews and updates Audit Programs and the Audit Manual when there are changes to products, processes, regulations or systems.

100% completion of the approved Internal Audit Plan.

Number of Critical audit issues raised which result in change in the VFR.

Excellent quality testing, reports and work paper standards reflected by reduced number of coaching notes and feedback from RAM.

Monthly data analytics report

An up-to-date Audit Program and Audit Manual in place (updated at least annually).

(20%) Supervision and Training

Supervises, motivates and reviews the work of the Internal Auditors (if any);

Trains less experienced auditors to meet IAD audit standards;

Appraises and evaluates all IAD staff development plans;

Works to develop self and team members continuously;

Ensures all members of IAD complete the required number of CPE hours every year.

All staff appraisals conducted within deadlines.

Positive feedback obtained from staff during 360-degree feedback sessions.

Staff satisfaction within the internal audit department (if measured) over 90%.

Hours of CPE training spent in a year to maintain certifications.

Complete at least eight man-days of training per staff per year.

(5%) Assist in Fraud investigations and external audits.

Assists in the execution of external audits as well as examination to be conducted by government regulatory agencies and other stakeholder/raters;

Promptly investigates any fraud incidents escalated by management, staff, RAM, BAC or through Whistle Blowing channel;

Monitors implementation of issues raised by the external auditor’s management letters and Regulatory reviews.

Thorough fraud investigations completed and report prepared within 30 days of escalation to Internal Audit.

Quarterly updates on status of issues raised by external auditors and other regulatory reviews submitted to RAM, BAC and CEO.

(5%) Meeting Budget

Prepares the IAD budget in line with the Annual Plan.

Tracks performance against the budget and ensures that the budget is not exceeded.

Actual expenses do not exceed the budget without compromising on plan execution.

Variances are tracked at least quarterly.

(5%)

Quality Assurance

Supervises engagement planning, reviews team members’ work papers and draft reports prepared by team members to ensure consistent quality of work.

Facilitates an internal quality assurance review of the department’s work and activities to evaluate conformance with the Global Internal Audit Standards.

Review and coaching notes to team members from reviews done by IAM

Quality Assurance Assessment report prepared by the IAM at least annually

(5%) Relationship Building

Build strong working relationships with the CEO and Senior Management team of VFR;

Build strong relationship with the RAM and demonstrate leadership skills with IA team;

Build strong relationships with the BAC, external regulators / auditors.

Discussions and meetings are cordial and controlled.

Disagreements are ironed out at the RAM, RAD or RD level.

Other tasks assigned by Supervisor

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Minimum education, training and experience requirements to qualify for the position:

University degree in accountancy or business administration.

Professional accounting (CPA/ACCA) or MBA qualification required – CISA certification will be an added advantage; Candidates without a professional qualification will be considered exceptionally (requires approval of VFI Audit Director).

Excellent proficiency in the use of all Microsoft office applications especially Excel

Capability and willingness to take responsibility

A high sense of integrity

Determined personality with initiative, perseverance and the ability to motivate and manage the team.

Must be a committed Christian and able and willing to participate and lead in daily devotions.

Minimum of 5 years audit experience in banking supervision and/or microfinance (with a minimum of 2 years demonstrated strong leadership experience in planning, supervision and management of an internal audit department a must

Experience advising senior management and reporting to audit committees on risk management and monitoring a must

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Understanding of Orbit sun systems, eMerge, TMS or other relevant accounting and loan tracking software would be an advantage.

Good communication skills in English and Kinyarwanda.

Experience in systems analysis and audit would be added advantage

License, registration, or certification required to perform this position:

CA, CIA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent.

March 16th 2026

JOB ADVERTISEMENT

‘’Make a difference to thousands in the land of a thousand hills’’

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR), is Rwanda’s largest microfinance Institution. VFR is committed to the development of Rwanda through providing affordable financial services (savings and loans) to the less privileged throughout its 4 zones in Rwanda.

VFR is the institution where you can develop your expertise working with the best people worldwide in a dynamic, team focused high performance environment. If you are looking for interesting but challenging work where you can make a difference in the world, then VFR has the will to make it so.

VisionFund Rwanda (VFR) has zero tolerance to abuse and sexual exploitation of children and adults beneficiaries. We expect all our employees/affiliates to commit to protecting children and adult beneficiaries from harm and abide by our safeguarding policy.VFR needs to recruit experienced and qualified staff on the following position:

Internal Audit Manager

Reporting to: Regional Audit Manager / Board Audit Committee (BAC) / CEO

Type of the contract: Open Ended Contract

Job Purpose 

  • Support VFR accomplish its objectives, create, protect and sustain value by providing an independent, risk-based, and objective assurance over risk management, control and governance processes.
  • Monitor VFR’s compliance with the existing laws, rules and regulations in the country.
  • Monitor compliance with VFR’s and VFI’s standards, policies and procedures for financial, operational and social performance requirements.
  • Advise the VFR Board of Directors and VFR Management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal control systems and risk management

Perform any statutory function related to Internal Audit required by the regulators of VFR.

Main Responsibilities

% Time

Major Activities

End Results Expected

(5%) Planning

  • Develops and submits for approval to the BAC annual audit plan that outlines the activities to be undertaken by the Internal Audit Department (IAD) during the year.
  • Prepare amended internal audit plan and present it to the Audit Committee for approval in case of significant shifts in risk profile or significant changes in the operations of VFR.
  • Annual plan prepared before beginning of Q1 and approved by the audit committee

(15%) Reporting

  • Submits timely reports to management for all the audits conducted during the year;
  • Submits written audit reports & internal audit activity reports to the Audit Committee before every scheduled Board meeting;
  • Presents the audit activity reports during the BAC meeting every quarter;
  • Submits high quality progress reports to RAM monthly and attends regular check in meetings with RAM as required;
  • Tracks the status of implementation of issues/corrective actions arising from audit reports and provides updates to Management, RAM and BAC;
  • Presents to Management the results from continuous audit & analytics each month;
  • Informs all concerned staff on changes in internal control and audit policies and procedures.
  • At least 90% of Audit Reports published within 30 calendar days of fieldwork close.
  • Audit Reports to BAC submitted at least 15 days prior to the meeting.
  • Monthly progress reports submitted within 7 working days of month end to RAM. Attendance of regular check in meetings organized by RAM.
  • Summary of issues / corrective action status sent to RAM and Management monthly.

(40%)

Audit Work

  • Carries out the Internal Audit Plan with the assistance of the Internal Auditors (if any) or on their own;
  • Performs testing or ensures testing done by Internal Auditors is as per required standards and latest Audit Program;
  • Prepares, reviews and issues all IAD audit reports after approval by the RAM;
  • Discusses the results of audits with respective head office /branch department managers and advices on appropriate corrective actions to improve conditions;
  • Ensures all audit testing is adequately documented and archived for the period required by VFI policy and local regulatory authorities;
  • Ensures data analytics is completed each month by the IAD as part of continuous audit and monitoring;
  • Independently appraises all operational functions of the institution;
  • Reviews and updates Audit Programs and the Audit Manual when there are changes to products, processes, regulations or systems.
  • 100% completion of the approved Internal Audit Plan.
  • Number of Critical audit issues raised which result in change in the VFR.
  • Excellent quality testing, reports and work paper standards reflected by reduced number of coaching notes and feedback from RAM.
  • Monthly data analytics report
  • An up-to-date Audit Program and Audit Manual in place (updated at least annually).

(20%) Supervision and Training

  • Supervises, motivates and reviews the work of the Internal Auditors (if any);
  • Trains less experienced auditors to meet IAD audit standards;
  • Appraises and evaluates all IAD staff development plans;
  • Works to develop self and team members continuously;
  • Ensures all members of IAD complete the required number of CPE hours every year.
  • All staff appraisals conducted within deadlines.
  • Positive feedback obtained from staff during 360-degree feedback sessions.
  • Staff satisfaction within the internal audit department (if measured) over 90%.
  • Hours of CPE training spent in a year to maintain certifications.
  • Complete at least eight man-days of training per staff per year.

(5%) Assist in Fraud investigations and external audits.

  • Assists in the execution of external audits as well as examination to be conducted by government regulatory agencies and other stakeholder/raters;
  • Promptly investigates any fraud incidents escalated by management, staff, RAM, BAC or through Whistle Blowing channel;
  • Monitors implementation of issues raised by the external auditor’s management letters and Regulatory reviews.
  • Thorough fraud investigations completed and report prepared within 30 days of escalation to Internal Audit.
  • Quarterly updates on status of issues raised by external auditors and other regulatory reviews submitted to RAM, BAC and CEO.

(5%) Meeting Budget

  • Prepares the IAD budget in line with the Annual Plan.
  • Tracks performance against the budget and ensures that the budget is not exceeded.
  • Actual expenses do not exceed the budget without compromising on plan execution.
  • Variances are tracked at least quarterly.

(5%)

Quality Assurance

  • Supervises engagement planning, reviews team members’ work papers and draft reports prepared by team members to ensure consistent quality of work.
  • Facilitates an internal quality assurance review of the department’s work and activities to evaluate conformance with the Global Internal Audit Standards.
  • Review and coaching notes to team members from reviews done by IAM
  • Quality Assurance Assessment report prepared by the IAM at least annually

(5%) Relationship Building

  • Build strong working relationships with the CEO and Senior Management team of VFR;
  • Build strong relationship with the RAM and demonstrate leadership skills with IA team;
  • Build strong relationships with the BAC, external regulators / auditors.
  • Discussions and meetings are cordial and controlled.
  • Disagreements are ironed out at the RAM, RAD or RD level.
  • Other tasks assigned by Supervisor

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Minimum education, training and experience requirements to qualify for the position:

  • University degree in accountancy or business administration.
  • Professional accounting (CPA/ACCA) or MBA qualification required – CISA certification will be an added advantage; Candidates without a professional qualification will be considered exceptionally (requires approval of VFI Audit Director).
  • Excellent proficiency in the use of all Microsoft office applications especially Excel
  • Capability and willingness to take responsibility
  • A high sense of integrity
  • Determined personality with initiative, perseverance and the ability to motivate and manage the team.
  • Must be a committed Christian and able and willing to participate and lead in daily devotions.
  • Minimum of 5 years audit experience in banking supervision and/or microfinance (with a minimum of 2 years demonstrated strong leadership experience in planning, supervision and management of an internal audit department a must
  • Experience advising senior management and reporting to audit committees on risk management and monitoring a must

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

  • Understanding of Orbit sun systems, eMerge, TMS or other relevant accounting and loan tracking software would be an advantage.
  • Good communication skills in English and Kinyarwanda.
  • Experience in systems analysis and audit would be added advantage

License, registration, or certification required to perform this position:

CA, CIA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent.

item.title: Senior Procurement and supply chain officer at Pharo Foundation Rwanda
item.description:
Senior Procurement and Supply Chain Officer.

Kigali, Rwanda

Overview

Pharo Foundation (“the Foundation”) is a pioneering, mission-driven organisation working to build a vibrant, productive, and self-reliant Africa. Founded and fully funded by Pharo Management, an emerging markets hedge fund, the Foundation represents a new model of philanthropic capitalism: a private endowment using its own capital to design, fund, and operate development programmes with private-sector discipline and long-term commitment.

Over the next decade, the Foundation’s ambition is to deliver lasting impact across three interdependent missions:

Empowering the next generation through affordable, high-quality education.

Solving water scarcity by building and operating sustainable water infrastructure.

Driving economic productivity by unlocking jobs, investment, and innovation through both non-profit and for-profit ventures.

The Foundation operates in Ethiopia, Somaliland, Kenya, and Rwanda, employing more than 750 people. It combines a not-for-profit engine: Pharo Development, with a for-profit engine, Pharo Ventures, which builds and operates sustainable businesses to create jobs and advance economic self-reliance.

Opportunity

The Senior Procurement and Supply Chain Officer is responsible for managing end‑to‑end procurement and supply chain activities to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and compliant acquisition and delivery of goods and services. The role provides technical leadership on procurement, supports strategic sourcing and contract management, and coordinates closely with the operations & logistics department, and the finance department to optimize the overall supply chain.

Key Relationships

Role: Senior Procurement and supply chain officer

Location: Kigali, Rwanda

Report to: Country Director

Contract Type: Full time

Functional relationships: All Rwanda SLT

Duties and Responsibilities

Lead and manage the full procurement cycle, including requisition review, market assessment, tendering, bid evaluation, negotiation, contracting, and order placement in line with policies and regulations.

Develop and implement procurement and supply chain strategies, annual procurement plans, and category strategies to achieve value for money, quality, and timely delivery.

Coordinate closely with the operations & logistics department on delivery schedules, customs clearance, last mile- distribution, and resolution of delivery issues.

Manage supplier prequalification, selection, onboarding, and performance evaluation, maintaining an up-to-date vendor database and fostering strong supplier relationships.

Lead tender preparation and evaluation processes, prepare tender documents and evaluation reports, and make recommendations for award of contracts in line with approval frameworks.

Draft, review, and manage contracts and service level agreements, ensuring clear specifications, deliverables, payment terms, and performance indicators.

Monitor contract implementation, supplier performance, and compliance with terms, addressing disputes, variations, and claims where necessary.

Analyze spend, market conditions, and supply risks, and prepare regular reports and dashboards on procurement and supply chain performance for management decision-making-.

Ensure all procurement and supply chain activities comply with organizational policies, operating procedures, regulations, ethical standards, and audit requirements.

Coordinate with all departments to consolidate needs, support development of specifications and terms of reference, and provide guidance on appropriate procurement methods.

Maintain accurate and complete documentation and filing (manual and electronic) for all procurement and supply chain transactions, ensuring traceability and audit readiness.

Provide technical guidance, coaching, and supervision to procurement and supply chain staff, promoting best practices and continuous improvement.

Contribute to emergency or priority procurements by fast-tracking processes while maintaining- compliance and documentation standards.

Qualifications and Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; a professional qualification (e.g. CIPS) or master’s degree is an added advantage.

Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive experience in procurement and supply chain management, including at least 2–3 years in a senior or supervisory role.

Demonstrated experience managing competitive tenders, complex or high value- contracts, and strategic sourcing initiatives.

Proven experience working with ERP/procurement systems and strong skills in MS Excel and other analytical tools.

Strong knowledge of procurement principles, public/organizational procurement regulations, contract law basics, and supply chain best practices.

Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving- skills, with the ability to deliver value for money and manage risks.

High level of integrity, professionalism, and commitment to transparency, accountability, and ethical procurement.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with internal clients and external suppliers.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast paced- environment.

Leadership and team management- capabilities, including coaching and mentoring junior staff.

Personal attributes

Strong knowledge of supply chain and procurement best practices.

Excellent negotiation and supplier management skills.

Strong analytical and reporting abilities.

High level of integrity and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

Proficiency in MS Office and Dynamics 365 Business Central or ERP procurement systems.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Application procedure

We will review applications on a rolling basis. If we identify an outstanding candidate early in the process, we reserve the right to appoint before the deadline. For this reason, we encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible. Due to the high volume of applications, we regret that we will only contact shortlisted candidates.

item.title: Director Of Core Banking Systems & Applications at HOPE International
item.experience_level: Senior Professional Type: Full-time Department: Core Banking Systems & Applications Reports to: Senior Director of Technology Position supervises: Manager of Core Banking Systems & Applications
item.description:
Role Description

Application deadline: March 24, 2026

The director of core banking systems & applications will have responsibility for leading the organization’s core banking systems and applications strategy and execution across the global network of microfinance institutions. The director is responsible for staff, finances, and operations for the core banking systems department, coordinating and liaising with other global support staff and leadership to develop and improve the overall banking operations of the HOPE network.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda; other geographies considered,

Level: Senior Professional

Type: Full-time

Department: Core Banking Systems & Applications

Reports to: Senior Director of Technology

Position supervises: Manager of Core Banking Systems & Applications, Senior Applications Specialist, T24 Helpdesk Assistant Manager

Responsibilities

Promote and contribute to the fulfillment of HOPE International’s mission and vision.

Core Banking Systems Strategy

Create annual and multi-year strategic plans, team OKRs, and release cycles across all core banking software and applications.

Maintain the function’s maturity at a minimum “Measured” state in accordance with the adapted CMMI model across the HOPE-managed microfinance institutions.

Determine prioritization and implementation plans for global microfinance technology needs and initiatives.

Serve as a lead liaison between technical staff and business leaders to create technological solutions for operational goals and challenges.

Provide expert-level analysis on new technology products, services, digital channels, and process efficiencies to organizational leaders.

Team Management

Manage the core banking team. Set clear expectations, manage priorities, and guide the team toward shared goals with care for both people and outcomes.

Model Christ-like servant leadership, fostering a team culture of care and holistic development through mentoring, coaching, intentional delegation, and regular one-on-one meetings.

Provide regular, prayerful feedback that encourages growth, reinforces accountability, and builds on each person’s God-given strengths.

Encourage and lead direct reports in ways that deepen their connection to HOPE’s mission and reveal how their work contributes to God’s Kingdom.

Lead cross-functional teams in assessment, deployment, and management of core banking software and associated financial applications as a leading functional business analyst and expert-level software developer.

Direct the core banking system team’s second-level support delivery and helpdesk functions to ensure timely, accurate, and professional service delivery to microfinance staff and clients.

Responsible for ensuring systems, applications, and team procedures in development, test, and production environments adhere to internal policies and cyber security best practices.

Steward team resources responsibly. Determine and manage resources required for initiatives and development, completing semi-annual budget projections for core banking and application needs and informing business leaders in their creation of institutional budgets.

Center of Excellence

Provide expert-level consulting on new technology initiatives that would interact with banking software environments for the HOPE global network of programs and partners.

Lead training and development activities as needed for the organization’s microfinance staff and partners in core banking systems and applications.

Maintain expertise in recent releases of T24 MCB so as to serve the HOPE Network as a center of excellence for T24 best practices and functionality.

Qualifications

Personal confession of Christian faith and commitment to the mission and vision of HOPE International

Demonstrated desire to help people who have been brought low by poverty or other circumstances regain hope, dignity, and the ability to support themselves and their families

Bachelor’s degree in information or computer science or related field; advanced degree preferred

5-10 years of experience supporting core banking systems in commercial or microfinance banks, with specific experience with Temenos’ T24 system required

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in organizational leadership/management required

Experience in microfinance, banking, or financial technology services sectors, with demonstrated technical project management

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines

Creativity, flexibility, and resourcefulness

Ability to relate to, communicate, and motivate staff effectively; ability to communicate effectively across cross-cultural business and technical teams

Experience with the Microsoft suite required; other MIS and AI software packages preferred

Willingness and ability to travel internationally

Fluent in English; proficiency in French preferred

International cross-cultural experience preferred

  • Core Banking Systems Strategy

  • Determine prioritization and implementation plans for global microfinance technology needs and initiatives.
  • Serve as a lead liaison between technical staff and business leaders to create technological solutions for operational goals and challenges.

item.title: Malaria Field Officer at Pro-femmes/twese Hamwe (Pfth)
item.description:
JOB ANNOUNCEMENT

Position: Malaria field officer

Background

Pro-Femmes/Twese Hamwe (PFTH) is an umbrella organization of Rwandan Civil Society Organizations dedicated to advancing the status of women, peace, and development. Established in October 1992, PFTH currently represents 52 member organizations across Rwanda.

PFTH’s mission is to eradicate all forms of discrimination against women, promote their socio-economic, political, and legal status, and strengthen the institutional capacities of its member organizations through a sustainable development approach rooted in gender equality, peace, justice, and human rights.

To enhance its capacity, in partnership with Jhpiego and Rwanda BioMedical Centre (RBC) PFTH is seeking a dynamic and skilled 2 (two) Malaria Field officers to join its team in Northern Province.

Duty Station:

One of the Health Centre in the Northern Province with frequent travel to the field especially in Malaria hotspots.

Contract Type:

Fixed Term : 9 months, renewable upon availability of funds

Summary Scope of Work

The Malaria field officer supports malaria prevention, case management, and community-based malaria surveillance at district, sector, and community levels. They work closely with health facilities, Community Health Workers (CHWs), and district health teams to improve identification and response to malaria hotspots across Northern Province.

Reporting to the Malaria Provincial Coordinator ensures timely implementation of malaria activities, strengthens community and facility capacity, supports data-driven hotspot detection, and promotes adherence to national malaria guidelines.

Responsibilities

1. Malaria Technical Support

Provide field-level support for malaria case management, iCCM, HBM, and MiP.

Support CHWs and providers to follow national malaria guidelines and MFT protocols.

Participate in planning and delivering malaria prevention and surveillance activities.

Provide continuous technical assistance to health workers in identified hotspots to implement malaria interventions.

Assist health centers and community health workers staff through training and mentorship.

Strengthening community capacity for early malaria detection and prevention.

2. Hotspot Identification & Response

Monitor malaria trends and support community-based hotspot detection.

 Participate in hotspot mapping and targeted interventions.

Support test-and-treat, referral strengthening, and outbreak response activities.

3. Capacity Building , Field Supervision & Activity Monitoring

Train and mentor CHWs, health facility staff, CEHOs

Lead field-level malaria training and mentorship sessions

Conduct field visits to monitor malaria activities.

Ensure proper use of reporting tools, job aids, and malaria commodities.

Identify challenges and support corrective actions.

4. Data, Reporting, and Documentation

Support accurate malaria reporting at community and facility levels.

Participate in district data review meetings.

Document lessons learned, success stories, and field observations.

 Submit weekly, monthly, and quarterly updates.

5 . Administrative Support

 Support logistics for training, workshops, and field activities.

Assist with distribution of supplies, job aids, and training materials.

Support budgeting, planning, and financial documentation.

Required Qualifications

Diploma (A1) in Nursing, Clinical Medicine and Community Health

Valid license from Rwanda Council of Nurses, Midwives (NCNM) or Rwanda Allied Health Professions Council (RAHPC).

2–3 years of experience in malaria or community health programming.

Experience working with CHWs, districts, CSOs, or FBOs.

Strong understanding of Rwanda’s health system and malaria program.

Ability to train and supervise field teams.

 Good data management and reporting skills.

Fluency in Kinyarwanda and English

Proficiency in MS office applications.

Willingness to travel 85% of the time.

Application Instructions

Interested candidates should submit their application including:

Cover letter

Curriculum Vitae

Academic documents

Relevant certificates

item.title: Meal Coordinator at Murika Development Partners (MDP)
item.description:
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT

Murika Development Partners (MDP) is a Local Non-Government Organization whose mission is to

catalyze holistic transformation of the poor and foster resilience and socio-economic growth of local

communities in partnership with the church and other organizations. Murika Development Partners (MDP)

wishes to recruit a qualified and well-experienced candidate to fill the position of MEAL Coordinator in the Programs Department. The job description and requirements are as follows:

Job Title:

MEAL Coordinator

Department

Programs

Position type

Full Time

Grade

Reporting line

Reports to: Programs Manager

Duty station

Head Office, Kigali

Organization profile 

Murika Development Partners (MDP) is a legally registered National Non-Government Organization (since December 2025), fully Rwandan-led and dedicated to catalyzing holistic transformation among vulnerable communities. MDP tackles the root causes of multi-dimensional poverty in partnership with the church, ensuring solutions are locally owned and sustainable. Building on 30 years of proven impact through World Relief’s church-based programs in Rwanda, MDP inherits tested tools and knowledge while advancing a locally led model. By mobilizing community networks, MDP empowers families to overcome economic, social, physical, emotional, and spiritual poverty, and equips them to design, lead, and scale solutions that endure beyond external support.

Job summary

The MEAL Coordinator is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and analysis of Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) processes to enhance program effectiveness and impact. This role involves collecting and managing data, utilizing metrics to assess performance, conducting evaluations, and fostering a culture of learning through capacity building and training. In addition, the MEAL Coordinator ensures adherence to ethical standards and compliance with organizational policies while facilitating transparent communication of findings to stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. Data Collection and Management (30%) 

Design and refine data collection tools and methodologies to capture program outcomes and impacts accurately.

Conduct field visits to collect quantitative and qualitative data while ensuring adherence to ethical and methodological standards.

Enter, clean, and maintain datasets using appropriate data management systems and software.

Support the development and maintenance of databases for efficient storage and retrieval of MEAL information.

2. Metrics Analysis and Utilization (30%) 

Collaborate with program teams to identify and track relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) aligned with program goals.

Analyze data to assess program performance and trends, providing insights and guidance for decision-making.

Develop dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate program metrics to stakeholders.

Ensure timely processing, analysis, and sharing of program data with relevant partners.

Provision of quarterly and monthly summarized metrics reports.

3. Assessments and Evaluations (20%) 

Support the planning and execution of evaluations for various programs, including baseline, midterm, and end-line assessments.

Participate in developing evaluation frameworks and methodologies and assist in drafting comprehensive evaluation reports.

Conduct literature reviews and contextual analyses to inform assessment designs and evaluation processes.

Relate regularly evaluation results to program actions to demonstrate progress and highlight areas for improvement.

4. Reporting, Accountability, and Compliance (15%) 

Prepare timely MEAL reports summarizing key findings, lessons learned, and best practices.

Contribute to the development of donor reports by providing accurate MEAL information.

Assist in establishing feedback mechanisms to gather input from beneficiaries and ensure accountability to affected populations.

Ensure all MEAL activities comply with organizational policies, donor requirements, and ethical standards.

5. Capacity Building and Learning (5%) 

Provide training for staff, partners, and field teams on MEAL principles, tools, and best practices.

Facilitate learning sessions to disseminate evaluation findings and encourage evidence-based decision-making.

Develop and support training materials and resources to capture program insights and innovations.

Collaborate with program teams to ensure learning outcomes are integrated into program design and implementation strategies.

6. Additional responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive; the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks that are reasonable and aligned with the job incumbent’s skills and experience.

Job specification requirements 

Qualifications & Experience Required

Essential skills 

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Development Economics, or a related field with a minimum of 3 years, preferably with an international NGO, in roles that include successful report writing, document preparation, process planning, and monitoring and evaluation.

Experience:

Proven experience in data collection and management, including designing and implementing data collection tools.

Proven track record in statistical analysis software (e.g., SPSS, R, Stata) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is advantageous.

Prior experience in conducting evaluations and assessments is essential, including participatory approaches and methodologies.

Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to assess program performance and trends.

Ability to synthesize complex data and provide actionable insights for decision-making.

Proficient in data management software (e.g., Excel, Access, or similar) and database development.

Experience with designing data collection methodologies and tools.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information clearly to various stakeholders.

Ability to develop reports, dashboards, and visuals that effectively communicate findings and metrics.

Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with program teams, partners, and other stakeholders.

Ability to provide training and capacity-building support to diverse audiences.

Strong time management skills and the ability to handle multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

Detail-oriented approach to ensure accuracy and quality in all MEAL activities.

Core competencies

Program Coordination

Skills in coordinating various program activities, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Collaborative Skills

Ability to work collaboratively with other teams and partners to achieve common objectives.

Data Management

Proficiency in collecting, analyzing, and reporting program-related data for decision-making.

Reporting

Ability to collect and organize data systematically for reporting purposes.

Project coordination

The ability to execute project plans that meet specific objectives within defined timelines and budgets.

Time Management

Skills in managing time effectively to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

Community Outreach

Ability to engage and mobilize community members for participation in programs and initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timeliness and accuracy of data collection and database maintenance.

Number and quality of data collection tools designed and implemented effectively.

Number of relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) identified and tracked aligned with program goals.

Quality and timeliness of produced dashboards and visualizations communicated to stakeholders.

Successful execution of baseline, midterm, and end line evaluations within the set timelines.

Quality and comprehensiveness of evaluation reports, including actionable recommendations.

Number of training sessions conducted and feedback from participants on the effectiveness of training.

Timeliness and quality of MEAL reports submitted to relevant stakeholders.

Number of feedback mechanisms established and the responsiveness to beneficiary input.

Working conditions

The MEAL Coordinator role operates within a structured yet dynamic environment that requires flexibility and adaptability in various working conditions. This position combines a mix of office-based responsibilities and fieldwork, ensuring a comprehensive approach to the monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning processes within the organization.

Office Setting: The role is based primarily in the office, utilizing standard office equipment and software for data management, analysis, and reporting.

Field Visits: Regular travel to various program sites is required, allowing for firsthand data collection and stakeholder engagement. Field visits may involve working in diverse conditions, including rural locations, and require adherence to ethical and methodological standards during data collection.

Standard Hours: Work hours are generally from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday to Friday, with occasional flexibility required to accommodate program needs, training schedules, and meetings with stakeholders outside of standard office hours.

Flexibility: Flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate field visits, training sessions, and stakeholder meetings, which can extend beyond regular office hours.

Safety Precautions: When conducting field visits, adherence to health and safety protocols is critical.

Travel Safety: Staff members must exercise caution while traveling to program sites, particularly in remote areas, and should be aware of the local context and any potential risks.

  • Analyze data to assess program performance and trends, providing insights and guidance for decision-making.
  • Develop dashboards and visualizations to effectively communicate program metrics to stakeholders.
  • Ensure timely processing, analysis, and sharing of program data with relevant partners.
  • Provision of quarterly and monthly summarized metrics reports.

3. Assessments and Evaluations (20%) 

  • Support the planning and execution of evaluations for various programs, including baseline, midterm, and end-line assessments.
  • Participate in developing evaluation frameworks and methodologies and assist in drafting comprehensive evaluation reports.
  • Conduct literature reviews and contextual analyses to inform assessment designs and evaluation processes.
  • Relate regularly evaluation results to program actions to demonstrate progress and highlight areas for improvement.

4. Reporting, Accountability, and Compliance (15%) 

  • Prepare timely MEAL reports summarizing key findings, lessons learned, and best practices.
  • Contribute to the development of donor reports by providing accurate MEAL information.
  • Assist in establishing feedback mechanisms to gather input from beneficiaries and ensure accountability to affected populations.
  • Ensure all MEAL activities comply with organizational policies, donor requirements, and ethical standards.

5. Capacity Building and Learning (5%) 

  • Provide training for staff, partners, and field teams on MEAL principles, tools, and best practices.
  • Facilitate learning sessions to disseminate evaluation findings and encourage evidence-based decision-making.
  • Develop and support training materials and resources to capture program insights and innovations.
  • Collaborate with program teams to ensure learning outcomes are integrated into program design and implementation strategies.

6. Additional responsibilities

  • The duties and responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive; the role holder may be required to perform additional tasks that are reasonable and aligned with the job incumbent’s skills and experience.

Job specification requirements 

Qualifications & Experience Required

Essential skills 

  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Social Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Development Economics, or a related field with a minimum of 3 years, preferably with an international NGO, in roles that include successful report writing, document preparation, process planning, and monitoring and evaluation.
  • Experience:
    • Proven experience in data collection and management, including designing and implementing data collection tools.
    • Proven track record in statistical analysis software (e.g., SPSS, R, Stata) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is advantageous.
    • Prior experience in conducting evaluations and assessments is essential, including participatory approaches and methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to assess program performance and trends.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data and provide actionable insights for decision-making.
  • Proficient in data management software (e.g., Excel, Access, or similar) and database development.
  • Experience with designing data collection methodologies and tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Ability to develop reports, dashboards, and visuals that effectively communicate findings and metrics.
  • Strong collaborative skills to work effectively with program teams, partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide training and capacity-building support to diverse audiences.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to handle multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.
  • Detail-oriented approach to ensure accuracy and quality in all MEAL activities.

Core competencies

Program Coordination

Skills in coordinating various program activities, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Collaborative Skills

Ability to work collaboratively with other teams and partners to achieve common objectives.

Data Management

Proficiency in collecting, analyzing, and reporting program-related data for decision-making.

Reporting

Ability to collect and organize data systematically for reporting purposes.

Project coordination

The ability to execute project plans that meet specific objectives within defined timelines and budgets.

Time Management

Skills in managing time effectively to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

Community Outreach

Ability to engage and mobilize community members for participation in programs and initiatives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Timeliness and accuracy of data collection and database maintenance.
  • Number and quality of data collection tools designed and implemented effectively.
  • Number of relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) identified and tracked aligned with program goals.
  • Quality and timeliness of produced dashboards and visualizations communicated to stakeholders.
  • Successful execution of baseline, midterm, and end line evaluations within the set timelines.
  • Quality and comprehensiveness of evaluation reports, including actionable recommendations.
  • Number of training sessions conducted and feedback from participants on the effectiveness of training.
  • Timeliness and quality of MEAL reports submitted to relevant stakeholders.
  • Number of feedback mechanisms established and the responsiveness to beneficiary input.

Working conditions

The MEAL Coordinator role operates within a structured yet dynamic environment that requires flexibility and adaptability in various working conditions. This position combines a mix of office-based responsibilities and fieldwork, ensuring a comprehensive approach to the monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning processes within the organization.

  • Office Setting: The role is based primarily in the office, utilizing standard office equipment and software for data management, analysis, and reporting.
  • Field Visits: Regular travel to various program sites is required, allowing for firsthand data collection and stakeholder engagement. Field visits may involve working in diverse conditions, including rural locations, and require adherence to ethical and methodological standards during data collection.
  • Standard Hours: Work hours are generally from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday to Friday, with occasional flexibility required to accommodate program needs, training schedules, and meetings with stakeholders outside of standard office hours.
  • Flexibility: Flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate field visits, training sessions, and stakeholder meetings, which can extend beyond regular office hours.
  • Safety Precautions: When conducting field visits, adherence to health and safety protocols is critical.
  • Travel Safety: Staff members must exercise caution while traveling to program sites, particularly in remote areas, and should be aware of the local context and any potential risks.

item.title: Coffee Cupping And Processing Specialist at The National Agricultural Export Development Board (NAEB)
item.company: The National Agricultural Export Development Board (NAEB)
item.description:
JOB ADVERTISMENT FOR NAEB VACANT POSITION FOR RECRUITMENT

The National Agricultural Export Development Board (NAEB) would like to recruit self-motivated and

qualified candidates to fill the following position.

POSITION: COFFEE CUPPING AND PROCESSING SPECIALIST

Job Profile

Job Description

Key Competences

Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Biotechnology, Food Science, Chemistry, Agriculture economics and Agri-business

Shall hold at least one of the following certifications, including but not limited to: Q Grader, Q Processing, SCA Sensory Skills – Professional, SCA Green Coffee – Intermediate and ISO 17025.

Proven experience in working with coffee post-harvest facilities such as coffee washing stations, warehouses, dry mills, coffee cupping laboratories and roasting plants for at least 5 years

Proven experience in coffee cupping or quality assurance preferred.

Strong analytical and reporting skills.

Under the overall guidance and

supervision of the Quality Assurance and Regulatory Division Manager, the Coffee Cupping and Processing Specialist will perform the following duties: 

Supervision of a team of cuppers and report to Quality Assurance and Regulatory Division Manager on performance of sample collection, coding, roasting, cupping and storage of reference samples

Ensure proper

documentation of Quality Assurance and Regulatory Division Standard Operating Procedures in collaboration with Sampling and coding officer, Quality Assurance and control specialist so that cupping laboratories are ready for accreditation and QMS re-certification

Prepare training program for coffee cuppers and submit for approval by supervisor

Coordinate sample preparations including roasting and grinding, sensory laboratory equipment preventive maintenance and environmental control of the lab to ensure reliable cupping results.

Conduct professional sensory evaluation (cupping) of coffee samples in line with international protocols (SCA and CQI standards).

Coordinate cupping, physical analysis and record keeping of cupping results to ensure timely delivery and produce of reliable results

Collaborate with other laboratory staff to ensure impartiality and avoid bias or direct collaboration between exporters or other external stakeholders

Inspection of coffee post-harvest facilities including coffee washing stations, warehouses, dry mills, coffee cupping laboratories and roasting plant

Prepare required narrative, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reports from Coffee cupping lab and submit to supervisor

Review of coffee Export documents including contracts, invoices and related requests.

Support training, calibration, and quality benchmarking activities.

Strong teamwork and organizational abilities

Coordinate Best of Rwanda coffee competition and any other regional or international coffee competitions activities, including preparation of cupping sessions, identification and request of required consumables, ensuring smooth implementation of key activities from sample submission until shipment of winning coffee samples and entire lots.

To undertake other duties assigned by the direct supervisor

Timely and

impartial cupping reports.

Properly

coded and traceable coffee samples.

Well-documented sampling records for export and cupping sessions.

Contribution to the integrity and reputation of Rwanda’s coffee exports.

Analytical and problem-solving skills;

Strong technical skills;

The ability to work well under pressure;

Attention to details;

Team working skills;

Organizational and team management;

Interpersonal and communication skills;

Timely and impartial cupping reports (monthly, quarterly, and annual reports).

Properly coded and traceable coffee samples.

Well-documented sampling records for export and cupping sessions.

Contribution to the integrity and reputation of Rwanda’s coffee exports.

Well-coordinated national and international coffee competition including Best of Rwanda coffee competition.

Fluent in English and/or French.

item.title: Sales & Administration Coordinator (Shipping Industry) at Sheer Logic Management Consultant
item.description:
Position Title: Sales & Administration Coordinator (Shipping Industry)

Department: Sales

Location: Rwanda

Reports To: Sales Manager / Direct Sales Team

Compensation: RWF 1,022,975 per month

About the Role 

We are seeking a proactive and motivated Sales & Administration Coordinator to support our

commercial team in Rwanda. This role is ideal for someone looking to build a foundation in shipping,

logistics, and commercial operations, with hands-on exposure to inside sales, customer

engagement, and administrative support.

As part of the sales team, you will begin with internal-facing tasks and gradually progress to field sales

activities, accompanying Sales Executives for customer visits, market mapping, and business

development activities.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Inside Sales Support 

Assist in handling customer inquiries via phone, email, and walk-ins.

Share rate quotations, service information, schedules, and shipment updates with customers.

Follow up on leads, quotations, and pending opportunities using the CRM system.

Support the preparation of commercial proposals and tenders.

Conduct basic sales analysis and provide weekly reports to the sales manager.

2. Administrative & Coordination Support 

Maintain and update customer records, contracts, and documentation in CRM and internal

systems.

Support the sales team by preparing meeting notes, visit reports, and presentation materials.

Assist in scheduling customer visits, internal meetings, and team activities.

Coordinate with operations, documentation, and customer service teams to ensure smooth execution of shipments.

Handle general office administrative tasks as required.

3. Field Sales Exposure (Gradual Integration) 

Accompany Sales Executives for client visits, onboarding discussions, and market intelligence activities.

Participate in customer service reviews, route development conversations, and retention meetings.

Observe and begin leading supervised customer interactions as competence grows.

4. Market Research & Commercial Intelligence 

Gather insights on competitors, freight trends, customer segments, and emerging opportunities.

Contribute to internal market reports and commercial strategy discussions.

Qualifications & Requirements 

Education 

Pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields.

Skills 

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Excellent organizational and analytical abilities.

Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

Ability to multitask and manage time efficiently.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Personal Attributes 

Eager to learn and willing to take initiative.

Customer-focused with a positive attitude.

Professional, dependable, and team-oriented.

Interest in the logistics/shipping industry is a strong advantage.

What We Offer 

Hands-on experience in the global shipping and logistics industry.

Exposure to sales strategies, customer engagement, and commercial operations.

Mentorship from experienced sales professionals.

Opportunities to transition into a full-time role based on performance.

item.title: Marketing, Products & Strategic Projects Manager at KT Rwanda Networks Ltd
item.description:
KT Rwanda Networks Ltd (KTRN LTD)

KG 7 Avenue, 7th Floor Kigali Heights Building

PO Box 5440, Kigali – Rwanda

Email: [email protected]

JOB ADVERTISEMENT:

Background:

KT Rwanda Networks, Ltd (“KTRN Ltd”) is a licensed company that has been incorporated under the laws and regulations of the Republic of Rwanda. The company is engaged in the business of providing & installing 4G LTE advanced technology within Rwanda.

In order to effectively accomplish its business objectives, KTRN Ltd is looking for a qualified and competent candidate to fill the vacant position below:

Position: Marketing, Products & Strategic Projects Manager (1):

Roles & Responsibilities:

The marketing, products & Strategic Projects Manager will be responsible for digital marketing, Products & analysis, Project coordination, retailer support, market intelligence, branding, and website management.

Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and other online channels to drive engagement, brand awareness, and business growth

Analyze product performance, conduct detailed competitor benchmarking, identify market gaps and opportunities, and provide insights to support product development, pricing, and positioning strategies that enhance the company’s competitive advantage

Collect and interpret market data and industry trends, and prepare market intelligence reports to support strategic decision-making.

Manage the company website, including content updates, design coordination, and analytics monitoring.

Ensure consistent brand identity and messaging across all marketing channels.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to prepare project proposals and tender bids, ensuring timely and compliant submissions.

Provide product training, marketing support, and promotional guidance to retail partners.

Monitor retailer performance and implement strategies to improve sales and strengthen brand presence.

Track and report on the performance of marketing campaigns, product outcomes, and project deliverables

Qualifications, Experience, Skills & Competencies required:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Business Information Technology, Information Technology, or a related field.

Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in the telecommunications industry, with exposure to product development, Sales, project management, marketing, or retail operations/support.

Extensive knowledge and hands-on experience in digital marketing, including analytics, social media management, campaign planning and execution, website/CMS administration, and brand development to drive engagement, visibility, and business growth.

Ability to understand telecommunications products, market dynamics, and conduct product comparison and analysis, as well as support product development to strengthen the company’s market positioning.

Ability to respond to project tenders, prepare bidding documents, and demonstrate strong project management skills, including coordinating cross-functional teams and delivering projects within deadlines.

Ability to manage and update company websites and perform basic artwork or marketing design (e.g., banners, promotional materials, digital assets) will be considered an added advantage.

item.title: Finance Manager at Mvend
item.description:
1. Background Information

Job Title: Finance Manager

Department: Finance

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer/ Board Directors

Direct Reports: Project Accountant, Reconciliation & Liquidation Accountant

Contract terms: Fixed-term Contract

2. Who we are

MVend Ltd is a Rwandan Financial Technology (FinTech) company with over 10 years of experience in payments integration across East Africa. Since its incorporation in 2013, MVend has led the drive toward digital payments by developing and integrating innovative solutions that connect businesses with payment service providers.

Through its flagship product Gwiza, MVend digitizes the operations of savings groups (VSLAs), helping members build credit histories and access micro-loans. Over 3,800 savings groups across Rwanda are currently using the Gwiza App.

MVend is also a key partner in the KATAZA Project, led by the Development Bank of Rwanda (BRD) and supported by the Mastercard Foundation, promoting financial inclusion and access to digital financial services nationwide.

3. Purpose of the Job

The Finance Manager oversees MVend’s financial operations to ensure accuracy, compliance, and sustainable performance. The role is both strategic and hands-on. They are responsible for managing daily financial activities while progressively strengthening financial systems, digital reporting, and data-driven decision-making.

4. Key Responsibilities:

Financial Leadership & Management 

Lead day-to-day financial operations including accounting, budgeting, reporting, and reconciliation.

Provide financial guidance and insights to management and the Board to support strategic decision making.

Supervise and mentor finance staff to ensure accuracy, accountability, and growth

Drive continuous improvement and build capacity within the finance team.

Financial Management & Control 

 Lead budgeting and forecasting processes, including variance analysis and regular reviews.

Oversee cash flow management and ensure prudent resource allocation.

Monitor and control financial risks through timely, accurate data and reporting.

Supervise reconciliation and settlement operations to minimize errors and aged items.

Work with management to draft quarterly and annual budgets for MVend Limited

Compliance & Reporting 

 Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in line with IFRS, RRA, RSE, donor requirements, and MVend standards.

Support and coordinate audits (internal & external) and implement audit recommendations.

Ensure full tax compliance and proper documentation of all transactions.

Maintain long-term financial health of MVend Limited as per the IFRS and local policies

Process Improvement & System Strengthening 

Recommend and implement practical improvements to financial workflows, reporting tools, and reconciliation processes.

Draft effective and efficient internal controls and documentation standards for Management and/or Board approval while maintaining monitoring aspects of the same.

Collaborate with the tech team to support integration of financial workflows with operational systems.

Relationship Management 

Liaise with auditors, banks, donors, and regulatory bodies to ensure transparent and effective financial relationships.

Work cross-functionally with Operations, HR, Project and Tech departments to ensure accurate reporting and financial alignment.

5. Performance Indicators/KPIs

Establishment of structured financial processes and reporting systems.

Compliance with tax, audit, and donor requirements.

Timeliness and accuracy of financial statements and reconciliations.

Reduction of audit queries and compliance risks.

Team performance and adherence to financial controls.

Successful implementation system improvements.

Budgeting accuracy and variance control.

6. Working Relationships

Internal: CEO/Executive Director, Senior Management Team, Operations, Tech, HR, Customer Support.

External: Auditors, regulatory bodies (RRA, RSE), funders, banks, vendors.

7. Professional, Academic qualifications and experience

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

CPA/ACCA qualification required.

Experience managing financial operations in a fintech or similar field.

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in financial management, preferably in startups, NGOs, or fast-growing organizations.

Proven experience stabilizing or restructuring finance functions.

Strong accounting and compliance knowledge (IFRS, tax, audit).

Hands-on management style with the ability to build processes and lead small teams.

8. Core competencies

Financial planning, budgeting, and reporting

Internal controls and compliance

Team leadership and mentoring

Reconciliation oversight and risk management

Process improvement and systems thinking

Team leadership and mentoring

Analytical and data interpretation skills.

9. Behavioral competencies 

High integrity and professionalism

Strong initiative and ownership mentality

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Analytical and problem-solving abilities

Calm under pressure; structured and disciplined.

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems

item.title: Cleaning Services Supervisor at Kigali Multiservice Cooperative (KMC)
item.description:
KIGALI MULTISERVICE COOPERATIVE (KMC)

Location: KK 517 ST, Kicukiro-Zinia, City of Kigali, Rwanda

Vacant position: Cleaning services Supervisor

Position type: Full time

Application deadline: 24th March 2026 at 6:00 p.m.

About us: Kigali Multiservice Cooperative “KMC” is a dynamic cooperative committed to empowering our members through sustainable economic development, ethical business practices, and inclusive growth. It has been in operation since 2009 and operates across multiple sectors, including service delivery in catering & onsite restaurant, cleaning, transport.

Role overview: We are seeking a Cleaning Services Supervisor to supervise our cooperative cleaning services in our sites and areas of operation. The ideal candidate will be passionate about Environmental, Public Health, occupational safety and risk assessment while drafting the required procedures.

Key Responsibilities Summary

Team supervision: Assign and prioritize cleaning tasks, monitor staff performance, provide training and mentoring, and manage attendance, discipline, and staffing adjustments when needed.

Health, safety & environmental Compliance: Enforce safety procedures, ensure compliance with workplace safety regulations (SHE/OSH), report hazards or incidents, and promote safe work practices.

Quality control & inspection: Conduct regular inspections, ensure adherence to cleaning standards and SOPs, identify issues, and take corrective actions while maintaining inspection records.

Inventory & Resource Management: Monitor and manage cleaning supplies, equipment, and PPE, forecast stock needs, report faulty equipment, and optimize resource use.

Customer service & reporting: Communicate with clients and departments, handle cleaning requests or complaints, maintain activity logs and reports, and complete administrative tasks.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in environmental sciences, Public Health, chemistry or Biology or any related.

Minimum 3 years of experience in operation management and team supervision and capability building.

Strong operational leadership, communication and organizational skills.

An experience within cleaning service provider companies, waste handling and circularity would be an advantage.

Should understand Rwandan cooperative operating principles and framework.

Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English or French. Knowledge of both languages would be an asset.

item.description_html:
JOB ADVERTISEMENT

Job Title: Finance and Accounting Officer

Organization: Luxembourg Development Agency

Duty Station: Kigali, Rwanda

Application Deadline: 25th March 2026

Start Date: 01st May 2026

Contract type: Open-Ended Contract, full-time

Contract length: N/A

Submit: LuxDev Human It System

1. Background

LuxDev, the Luxembourg Development Cooperation Agency, is responsible for implementing the country’s bilateral development programmes across Africa, Latin America, Asia, and Europe. Cooperation between Luxembourg and Rwanda began in 1989 with an initial healthcare initiative. Following a renewed commitment to strengthen these ties, LuxDev re‑established its presence and opened its Rwanda office in 2022, reinforcing long‑term collaboration in key areas such as rural development, Technical and Vocational Education & Training (TVET), sustainable agriculture and climate resilience, inclusive and innovative finance, and private‑sector innovation. LuxDev’s work in Rwanda is closely aligned with national priorities and contributes directly to the country’s broader transformation agenda.

2. DEPARTMENT / WORKPLACE

  • Operational Pool, Country Office in Rwanda, in support to projects under implementation.

3. WORK ORGANISATION

  • This position is a full-time position, based in Kigali. It requires occasional travels countryside.

4. POSITION ON ORGANISATIONAL CHART

  • Reports to the Head of Administration and Finance (HAF).
  • Member of the Operational Pool.

5. JOB PURPOSE

  • Support the HAF in the establishment of finance procedures and management of financial resources.

6. DUTIES AND MAIN TASKS

  • Assist in the development and validation of technical files (management control);
  • Assist in the development and validation of operational partnership agreements (OPAs);
  • Carry out transfer accounting, reconciliations and consolidations;
  • Prepare cash/bank reconciliations and monitor bank accounts;
  • Maintain, manage and monitor projects’ bank accounts;
  • Analyse and process all financial transactions (commitments) of projects, including checking receipt of goods/services/works and related invoices, and processing of payments, in line with Alphabase procedures of LuxDev;
  • Prepare financial statements and other financial documents required by projects’ relevant staff, Country Office and HQ, in a timely manner, as per LuxDev procedures;
  • Report any discrepancies in the financial reports to the top management;
  • Enter accounts and input records of projects’ expenditure in the accounting system following the charts of accounts;
  • Prepare on time, ledgers, balance sheets, expense justification reports, and accounting and financial reports;
  • Maintain all appropriate financial records and files (up-to-date and chronological) in line with LuxDev procedures;
  • Assist in control and revision of the projects’ budgets, as and when required, in consultation with LuxDev Country Office and LuxDev Headquarters (HQ);
  • Process all tax related issues (including exemptions) in accordance with LuxDev and Government of Rwanda procedures;
  • Ensure compliance with relevant Rwanda taxes laws and regulations;
  • Comply with the financial methods, procedures, and internal management tools;
  • Co-ordinate with LuxDev Country Office regarding all financial issues;
  • Brief LuxDev staff on general finance matters relevant to their position and tasks;
  • Work in conjunction with LuxDev’s partners finance departments, providing assistance and validating their financial reports;
  • Facilitate the auditing process of projects when internal and external auditing is conducted, and follow up on any recommendations;
  • Finalise all outstanding finance matters associated with projects;
  • Attend regular meetings of the Operational Pool team and participate actively in discussions, particularly in relation to finance and matters;
  • Other duties assigned by the Head of Administration and Finance (HAF), Controller of Administration and Finance (CAF) and/or Resident Representative (RR) in line with project’s objectives.

7. COMMUNICATIONS

Internal contacts

  • Has daily contacts with HAF and staff within Country Office and within the Operational Pool;
  • Has regular contacts with HQ on finance matters;
  • Has regular contacts with the projects’ teams to advise and provide support on all finance matters.

External contacts

  • Has regular contact with government counterparts for specific financial follow ups;
  • Has occasional contact with various public administrations for specific financial matters.

8. Education and/or work experience

  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Accounting, Finance, Business Administration);
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience in accounting and finance;
  • Previous experience in similar position in the Development Cooperation area in various contexts (bilateral aid, international organisations, NGOs);
  • Proven experience in partners’ grant management;
  • Fluency in English, French and Kinyarwanda in written and spoken;
  • Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel) as well as good understanding of IT solutions and systems;
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills, attention to details, fast-paced, responsive, proactive, and organized;
  • Experience in handling sensitive information, using discretion and confidentiality.
